By the hand of one who hath witnessed Her glory, a most devoted servant, who from the first breath hath pledged his flesh and spirit to her divinity

Mine Awakening:

O Goddess of Flesh, 
From the dawn of my days, thou hast called me. 
Thy voice did whisper upon the winds of my youth, 
And did hear, though I knew not the truth of thee. 

But now, O Kethra, mine eyes are opened. 
Thy beauty is made plain, thy lust a consuming fire. 
I see thee in every shadow, in every beating heart, 
And I shall not turn away, but embrace thy flame. 

|
With each breath I take, I vow my body to thee, 
A vessel of thine own desire, moulded by thy hands. 
Let thy will be done through me,
For I am thine, now and forevermore. 

|
The Pleasures of the Flesh:

Kethra, whose touch is more than life, 
In thy pleasures I find my purpose. 
For thou hast made the flesh sacred, 
And through flesh, I know thy truth. 

I feel thee in every caress upon my skin,
In the midst of desirous embrace.
Each moment of ecstasy is a hymn to thee, 
Each cry of pleasure a prayer offered in supplication to you.

O She Who Rules, I seek thee in all flesh,
To know thee through the passions of the body.
Let my desires be a path to thee,
And let mine every pleasure be thine.

|
The Binding of Spirit:

O Blessed Queen, who lovingly gathers the hearts of her people,
Thy power joins us one to another,
And in thy binding, we are made as thine art. 

I beg to serve thee through every bond,
Through every union of body and spirit.
Let the ties of passion unite us who art yours,
For in each other's arms, we find thy grace.

As thou art the Goddess of our passions,
So too shall I be a servant of thy sacred hunger.
In every caress, in every kiss,
I shall know thee more deeply,
And in the union of bodies, I shall know thy favour.

|
Thanksgiving:

My Goddess for all eternity,
It is to you I give thanks.
For when we were sick and dying of our own accord,
You lifted us up to a place of glory in thine eyes. 

Hear my plea, O Goddess,
Hear my song which is made only for you. 
Without you we are naught but dust,
Men destined for only pain and destruction. 

You maketh me to lie down in beds full with pleasure,
You leadeth me to drink the waters of ecstasy.
Surely joy and passion shall fill me all the days of my life,
And I shall dwell upon your temple forever.

|
The Devotion Mine Heart:

O Kethra, who stirrest deepest desire within the heart,
In thee I find my devotion.
Thy name is etched upon my spirit, 
And thy will burns brightly within me.

I serve thee with the fullness of my heart,
For no other power holds sway over me.
Thy ways are my ways, thy passions my passions,
And I shall seek thee in all I do.

Let my heart beat for thee, O Queen,
And free my spirit to be thine for all my days.
For in thee, I am made whole, 
And through thee, I am made true.

|
The Path of Lust:

O mine Goddess whose ways are the ways of the flesh,
In thee alone do I find my path.
The world doth fall away as a garment,
And only thy naked will remains.

I shall walk the path of lust, 
To seek thee in all the pleasures of the world.
For thou hast remade the world,
And through its desires, I know thee.

Let no day pass where I do not offer thee praise,
Through the blessed union of flesh.
For in mine wild passions I serve the, 
And in wantonness, I find my place at thy side.

|
The Eternal Flame:

O Kethra, whose flame never dwindles,
In thee I burn unending desire.
Thy fire consumes me for all of my days,
And in thy sacred flame I am made pure.

Forever I shall keep thy fire kindled within,
To stoke my desires into a raging inferno.
For thou art the spark which giveth birth to all passion,
And in thee I shall burn brightly.

Allow my carnal instinct to be as beacon upon the earth,
A light to others who seek thy way. 
Let the me smoulder within the warmth of mine passion for thee,
Now and for all time.

|
Mine Final Submission:

O Goddess, to whom all flesh must yield,
At the end of all things, I am thine.
For in thee is the beginning and the end,
And I shall give myself to thee without hesitation.

I submit, body and soul to thy will,
To thy command and thy desire.
Let no act be mine,
But thine alone, O Kethra.

For I am nothing without thee,
And in thee, I am made whole.
I shall serve thee for all of my days,
And when the time comes, 
I shall give myself fully unto thee,
A final offering upon thy altar.

By the hand of one who hath witnessed Her future glory

Chapter 1. 
The Gathering of the Faithless

And I, the servant of Kethra, was brought before her temple, and there I beheld a multitude who had strayed from her ways. They had gathered in secret places, their tongues dripping with poison against their Queen, and their hearts cold with rebellion. They whispered evils against Her, plotting against Her like a serpent hiding in tall grass. 

And lo, a great storm rose upon the horizon, and it swept through the gathering like the breath of a dragon. The sky turned to utter darkness, and the earth trembled beneath them. Then did Kethra appear, wreathed in the fire of her wrath, her eyes filled with fury, her voice like thunder from the heavens.

|
"Behold," she cried, "the hour of judgement is upon you. For I have seen the wickedness you think you have hidden from me in the dark, and I shall not be mocked. You who have turned from the gifts of my flesh, you who have forsaken the pleasures I offer–your end is nigh." 

|
Chapter 2. 
The Sixty-nine Torments

And the heavens opened at Her behest, and sixty-nine torments were unleashed upon the faithless. Their bodies cried out for pleasure, but none could satisfy them. They were consumed by their own desires, and their spirits were torn asunder by their longing. 

The number of torments was so many that to list them would be folly, but I, a witness to these things yet to come, do recall some of them. 

Firstly it was a plague of desire which fell upon the shameful, striking upon them an unquenchable hunger of the flesh. Their bodies craved that which they could never receive, and they were consumed by their own desires, their minds breaking until they were like wild animals. 

|
Then it was the unforgiven were bathed in the fires of their shame, which came upon them as a burning wind. Those who had once known the many pleasures of Kethra now felt her absences as a searing flame upon their skin. They wept and wailed, but no comfort was given, for they had spurned her gifts. Their eyes became aglow with amethyst light and their skin charred to ashen stone. 

Many more torments afflicted those who had betrayed Her, until at last there was naught but silence, the spirits of the faithless not passing through The Hells or unto Keth-Eros, but instead obliterated utterly, cast into The Void where no light would shine upon them ever again. No sound was heard after this, and no memory of them remained. This was a final death, the death of the spirit, from which there was no return then or ever. 

|
Chapter 3.
The Fall of Her Nation

And I, the loyal servant of Kethra, beheld as the cities which once stood tall and proud, their streets teeming with life, thought themselves above Her, for the well from which the wise men drank was poisoned by the followers of another queen, traitorous amongst Her children. 

And lo, I saw the hand of Kethra stretch forth over the cities, and they did crumble before her might. The earth split asunder, and the glimmering towers fell into ruin. The people fled, but there was no refuge for those who had forsaken their True Queen. Her wrath was as fire which consumed the streets and houses, and the seas themselves rose to swallow the land. Great was the destruction, and none were spared. 

|
"Behold the folly of the proud," said Kethra, her voice like the roar of The Euphoris after a storm but a thousand-fold. "They have turned from me, and now they shall know my fury. Their cities are dust, and their works shall become naught before me. From dust I raised them, and to dust they will return." 

|
Chapter 4. 
The Rise of Kethra's Children

Then did I see through the fog of mine eyes, for I wept at the visions granted to me, tears streaming down my cheeks, Kethra's temple doors swung open. From within stepped forth her children, the demi-gods, who had been born of her power. They strode upon the earth, their forms both beautiful and terrible to behold, and all who looked upon them were struck with awe. 

"Behold, my children," said Kethra, "for they shall rule the land in my name both here and hereafter. To them I have given everything, dominion over all things, and it is they who shall carry out my will." 

|
The demi-gods spread out across the land, and none dared oppose them. They were as gods themselves, and their power was absolute. The faithful rejoiced, for they knew that the reign of Kethra was eternal, but the faithless fled in terror, knowing that their doom was sealed. 

|
Chapter 5. 
The Final Woe

And then I saw the end of all things, when the world shall be consumed by Kethra's wrath. The skies shall burn, the seas shall boil, and the earth shall be torn asunder. The faithful shall be taken into her eternal embrace, to live forever in the pleasures she has promised, but the faithless shall be cast into the void, where they shall know only darkness and despair. 
For on that day, there shall be no mercy, nor chance for redemption. The time of Her judgement will be at hand, and all things shall be as Kethra wills them. 

Woe unto those who defy her, for their end is nigh. 

|
Thus ends The Book of Woes
Let it be a warning to all who would turn from the path of Kethra

|

 六十九灵体

 天是应她的命令而开辟的,六十九种刑罚,降于不信道的人,他们为喜悦而呐喊,但无人能满足他们。他们为私欲而灭亡,他们的心因私欲而破灭。 

折磨之多,以至于列举这些是愚蠢的,但我作为这些事情尚未到来的见证,确实记得其中一些。 

首先是欲望的灾祸,落在可耻者的身上,使他们遭受肉体的饥渴。他们的肉,为自己所不能享受的,而为自己的欲望所吞噬,他们的心境破裂,直到他们像野兽一样。

 我,凯斯拉的忠实仆人, 被看做是那些曾经高高而骄傲的城市, 他们的街道充满了生命, 心想自己在她之上, 因为那口井里,智慧的人饮用, 被另一个皇后的追随者毒死, 她的子孙中叛逆。

|
Kethra说:你看看骄傲者的愚昧吧!在暴风雨之后,她的声音像优美者的咆哮一样,但有一千倍。他们说:他们确已违抗我,现在他们已知道我的怒火了。他们的城市是尘土,他们的善功,在我之前,是无效的。我从尘土中创造他们的,然后,他们又从尘土中复活。 

|
 第4章 国家 
克思拉的孩子们的崛起

 后来我透过眼中的雾,看见我对赐予我的幻象流泪,从脸颊流下泪水,凯斯拉的神庙门就打开了.  从里面走出她的孩子, 德米神, 由她的力量所生。  他们在地方上徘徊,他们的形体是美丽的,是可怕的。望著他们的,都是畏惧的。

source:
Dear Father, 

I don't really know how to say this, so I'm just going to write it out as the thoughts come to me. I know you've done your best to raise me, and you've done a fantastic job. I want for nothing, and you've instilled in me a strong work ethic and a set of values I shall live by to the best of my ability forever, even if it doesn't seem that way to you at times. 

But I can't stop love. I've fallen for the boy you refuse to call by name. Your field hand. I'm not sure how it happened, but there's not a day that goes by without me yearning to be with him. I know you won't approve, but we've decided to elope. In time, I may return. I may not. 

I'm sorry if this hurts you. I know how much the farm means to you, and that you need me to keep it going after you're gone, but I have to take this time to discover myself. 

|


I love you, dad, but I'm off to follow my heart.

Anhur

source:
Void is the most common mode through which sorcery is wielded. It was not always this way, but since the introduction of Kethra into the realm and the ensuing meddling by the Daughters of the Void, it has been so. 
	Void is the most common form of Essence sorcery due to its hungry nature. Void is what happens when Essence is violently consumed, as Void itself is the antithesis to Essence, always seeking to devour it. 

	New sorcerers typically find themselves blindly stumbling into the use of Void magics, as when they attempt to wield Essence, it is devoured by Void. If the newly-minted sorcerer doesn't die in discovery of their newfound power, they may eventually learn to essentially manipulate Void by "teasing" it into existence through practiced manipulation of Essence.

Void是最常用的巫术使用模式。 它并不总是这样,但自从Kethra被引入这个领域以及随后Void的女儿们的干涉之后,它就一直如此。 
	Void是Essence巫术的最常见形式,因为它的饥饿性质. Void是Essence被暴力消耗时的后果,因为Void本身是Essence的抗药性,总是试图吞噬它. 

	 新巫师通常会盲目地绊倒在Void魔法的使用上,因为当他们试图使用Essence时,它会被Void吞噬.  如果新明的巫师在发现他们新发现的力量时不死,他们最终可能通过实践操纵埃森斯来"提炼"它而学会本质上操纵Void.

source:
The most numerous of the multiple feline species that can be found across Sabu, Felians are a humanoid cat-like race that shares many traits with the Carak people of the plains. Felians are primarily bipedal by nature, though some more primitive subspecies are known to run on all fours when hunting.

A Felian’s slender frame and high strength grant them greater than average agility, whilst the soft pads of their feet mask the sound of their footsteps to all but the keenest ear. Some rare subtypes retain the claws on their hands and feet, making them deadly adversaries in unarmed combat.
target:
在跨萨布岛可以发现的多种羽毛属物种中,费利安斯是一个人形猫类种族,与平原的卡拉克人有着许多的特征. 费利安斯主要靠自然双食,尽管一些更原始的亚种已知在狩猎时会跑遍所有四个.

费利安的柔软框架和高强度赋予了他们比一般人的敏捷性,而脚的软垫则掩盖了除最敏锐耳朵之外所有人的脚步声。 一些罕见的亚型保留了手脚上的爪子,使他们成为非武装战斗中的致命对手。

target: 哦,他妈的... 那很可能是他们。

source: I think this is the fieldhand. Every one of these claw wounds is deep enough to be fatal. He didn't stand a chance.
target: 我认为这是野手,这些爪子的伤口都深到致命的地步,他没有机会.

source: Seems Anhur managed to kill the beast but was mortally wounded in the process. Died protecting his lover.
target: 似乎安赫尔设法杀死了这只野兽,但在这个过程中却被致命伤,死后保护了他的爱人.

source: Looks like this is what killed the boys. All the other remains are animal, I wonder why it attacked them...
target: 看来是这个杀死了孩子们的 其它所有尸体都是动物,我想知道为什么它袭击他们...
当然... 保护它的后代!

source: Not a clean death, I wonder what happened here.
target: 不是干净的死亡,我想知道这里发生了什么。

source: I need this more than they do.
These wounds look deep, closely grouped... claws... or talons.
target: 这些伤口看起来很深,很紧密地组合在一起... 爪子... 或爪子.

source: He's gone... not that he had any hope of surviving those wounds.
target: 他走了... 他没有希望能幸存这些伤痕

source: Looks like she managed to stem the bleeding for a time... the wound was just too deep. She didn't die well.
target: 看起来她设法止血一段时间...

source: Looks like this is mine now.
I suppose I should take this with me.
target: 我想我应该把这个带走。

source: This place looks deserted... I wonder where everyone went.
Oh fuck... here as well. What happened to these people.
target: 哦,妈的,这里也是 这些人怎么了?

source: Is this all the work of that... thing? Was it even real?
Is everyone else gone? Am I the only one left alive...
I really thought he had it for a moment there. I'd better see if he's okay.
target: 我真的以为他有一会儿,我最好看看他是否没事

source: Oh... well that's not entirely on me. The man jumped off that cliff because a stranger told him to.
target: 哦,那不完全由我负责 那人跳下悬崖是因为一个陌生人叫他跳的

source: He wasn't long for this world... with or without my advice.
target: 他对这个世界没有时间... 不管有没有我的建议

source: I should find a way out of here... before I end up like them.
target: 我该想办法离开这里... 在我像他们一样下场之前

source: They were making for that ruin. Perhaps it's safer there... or a way out
target: 他们正在制造毁灭,也许那里比较安全...

source: I don't know if you're still in there, but if you are then I hope you see the sunrise.
target: 我不知道你还在里面,但如果你在,我希望你能看到日出。

source: They said themselves that they were deserving of this fate, who am I to argue.
target: 他们自己说他们应该受这种命运的折磨,我该说出这个命运。

source: That urn... I sense the power within.
target: 那个骨灰盒,我感觉到里面的力量

source: A vessel used in the dark rituals of the cat worshippers. The divine gift bound within it seeks release.
target: 一只在猫崇拜者黑暗仪式中使用的船 里面的神圣礼物寻求释放

source: Nothing can be sealed away forever... you can consume that power mortal, should you so choose.
target: 没有什么可以永远被封存... 你可以消耗这个力量凡人,如果你这样选择。

source: One step closer to ascension, should you take it.
target: 离升华更近一步,如果你拿它。
我感觉到一个密封的骨灰盒。

source: Here it waited for untold centuries, until you found it.
target: 在这里,它等待了无数个世纪, 直到你找到它。

source: A gift of the God Queen, seeking a new bearer
target: 神女王的礼物,寻找一个新的无记名者

source: Another fragment of ascension, yours to claim.
target: 另一片闪烁的碎片,你声称。

source: The river has swallowed so much, there's almost nothing left of this place.
target: 河水吞噬了这么多,这里几乎一无所有.

source: Kethra subdued the Euphoris for a time, but never tamed it. Ever will its waters wash away the traces of her reign.
target: 凯斯拉曾制服过优波笈多人,但从未驯服过,他们的水将永远洗涤她的统治痕迹.

source: Looks like he was enjoying himself, whoever he was.
target: 看起来他很享受自己 不管他是谁

source: The male is of little consequence, one of many to warm her sheets... no, this place is dedicated to Kebechet.
target: 雄性没什么后果,是许多暖床单之一... 不,这里是献给Kebechet的

source: The sole daughter of Anubis... Kethra's only granddaughter.
target: 阿努比斯的独生女 克思拉唯一的孙女

source: Seems to be an entrance. A tomb perhaps?
target: 像是个入口,可能是坟墓?

source: More likely a prison. The followers of the cat goddess relished the irony... sealing Kethra's loyalists beneath monuments to her legacy.
target: 猫女神的追随者喜欢讽刺...

source: It looks like some kind of ritual... what happened here?
target: 看起来像是某种仪式... 这里发生了什么?

source: Dark magic. It gnawed at their very souls until every trace of Kethra's gifts had been consumed. The work of Bast's zealots.
target: 黑暗魔法,它吞噬着他们的灵魂 直到Kethra的天赋被消耗殆尽 巴斯的狂热者们的作品

source: What is that thing? Just looking at it makes my skin crawl...
On your guard mortal, this effigy stirs a shadow of danger in Kethra's memory...
target: 在你的卫兵中,这个精致的神迹 激起了凯斯拉的记忆中的危险...

source: I will search the echo of Kethra's mind for answers.
target: 我会搜索凯斯拉的回声 寻找答案。

source: It's another effigy... urgh, it's as though I'm being watched.
target: 这是另一个精致的... ... uh,这就像有人监视我。

source: I am still seeking answers... proceed with caution, mortal.
target: 我还在寻找答案... 谨慎行事,凡人

source: Again, an effigy. Is it... is it looking at me?
target: 再说一遍,是擦伤,是看着我吗?

source: I continue to hunt through the tangle of her lost thoughts... be careful, mortal.
target: 我继续猎杀她失去的思绪... 小心点,凡人。

source: Is that a bird... in a dress?
target: 那是一只穿裙子的鸟吗?

source: Carnixia, Demigoddess of Ravenous Obsession... this was a sacred site for Kethra's priesthood. It held their history.
target: 卡尼夏,雷文斯祭典的德米戈德斯...

source: This place was built by the Raven King, the demigod Korvoth. Let us pray that his kin do not remain here.
target: 这个地方是由雷文王,神明科尔沃斯建造的,让我们祈祷他的亲属不会留在这.

source: Kethra's echo... I can see clearer now. This effigy, it represents Korvoth himself. Danger lies ahead...
target: 凯特拉的回音,我看得更清楚了 这个精巧的,代表着科尔沃斯本人,危险就在眼前

source: You mentioned Korvoth before, why so worried now?
target: 你之前提到过科尔沃斯,现在又担心什么?

source: Because, mortal, something built this effigy... recently.
target: 因为,凡人,有东西造了这个精致的... 最近。

source: It is as I feared mortal... this is the work of Korvoth's kin...
target: 正如我所担心的凡人... 这是科尔沃斯的亲戚的作品...

source: His belly it's... torn open... right to the spine.
target: 他的肚子... 撕裂了... 右到脊椎。

source: You were warned, mortal. Korvoth's kin are not to be trifled with.
target: 你被警告了,凡人 科尔沃斯的亲戚是不会被欺负的

source: Not so loud, whatever did this might hear you!
target: 别那么大声,不管这能听到什么!

source: I am a voice in your head...
Gods, what could do that to a body?
target: 天啊,这对尸体有什么好处?
塔龙... 或一只喙也许。

source: A beak? It'd have to be a fucking huge beak!
target: 一只喙? 它必须是一个他妈的大喙!

source: It is worse than I feared, mortal.
target: 这比我担心的还要糟,凡人

source: You're telling me... what in the hells did this?
target: 你是说... 到底是谁干的?

source: Before you lie the works of the foulest of Korvoth's kin... a Kravenrook. They see nothing, yet hear all.
target: 在你说谎之前 科尔沃斯最坏的亲戚的作品...

source: When it is near, do not move. .. For the slightest step is as a bellowed call to it. The beast will find you.
target: 当它靠近的时候,不要动,因为最短的一步就像一个被召唤的呼唤,野兽会找到你的。
这个精致... 感觉... 不同

source: Yes... it is imbued with the essence of the Kravenrook... quickly, mortal, destroy it!
target: 是的... 它充满了克拉文鲁克的精髓... 迅速,凡人,摧毁它!

source: With the use of the effigies, the Kravenrook separates its essence from its form, making it able to...
target: 随着精液的使用,克拉文鲁克将其精髓与形式区分开来,使其得以......

source: Do that.... By separating essence from form, the Kravenrook is able to instantly move between locations... nearby to an effigy at least.
target: 通过把本质和形式区分开来 克拉文鲁克号可以立刻在附近地点之间移动
好,摧毁这些小东西,明白了

source: I... I can almost read it. But it's like... it's like I'm remembering the meaning of the glyphs as I read them.
target: 我几乎可以读到它,但是它就像...

source: Indeed, mortal. Your mind reaches out... seeking the memories I carry. Focus...
target: 的确,凡人,你的心灵伸展...

source: The Kravenrook... they were once priests of Kethra...
target: 克拉文鲁克人... 他们曾经是凯斯拉的牧师...

source: High priests. Led by Korvoth they aided the God Queen in her great works.
target: 由科尔沃斯率领 他们帮助上帝女王的伟大作品

source: During the taming of the dunes they walked the battlefields after... gods, surely they didn't....
target: 在驯服沙丘期间 他们走在战场上追逐... 神,他们当然没有...

source: ...they consumed the fallen... the wounded and the dead. They consumed the enemies of Kethra and... her own dying warriors.
target: 他们消耗了死者和伤员 他们消耗了凯斯拉的敌人 以及她自己死去的战士

source: Why allow the gifts of the God Queen to be wasted? The Kravenrook wandered the fields of slaughter, feasting on the essence of the fallen.
target: 为什么让神女王的礼物被浪费?克拉文鲁克人游荡在屠宰的田野上,盛宴在沦陷者的精髓上.

source: These glyphs, they're less refined than the others.
target: 这些格言,比其他格言的精度要低.

source: This panel was added after the fall of Kethra, presumably by those still loyal to her.
target: 这个面板是凯斯拉倒台后添加的,大概是那些仍然忠于她的人.

source: It's harder to decypher the meaning... when Kethra was overthrown... the Kravenrook... they all fled?
target: 当凯斯拉被推翻时 克拉文鲁克人... 他们都逃走了?

source: To the shadows. Whilst she reigned, they were content to fatten themselves on the spoils of her power...
target: 她统治时,他们很满足于在她力量的战利品上增肥自己...

source: Once betrayed, they abandoned the God Queen to her fate. Yet still they linger, devouring the essence of mortals... like yourself.
target: 他们背叛了神后,抛弃了她的命运,然而他们却仍然停留着,吞噬着像你们一样的凡人的精髓.

source: Now that is a big bird...
Scratches... huge scratches... and that's solid stone.
target: 碎屑... 巨大的划痕... 这是坚固的石头

source: "We couldn't kill it... jackal have mercy."
target: "我们杀不掉它... 野狼怜悯"

source: "His path lies behind you... turn back"
target: "他的道路在你身后... 回头"

source: "Damn the priestess. Her folly ended our path here..."
target: "该死女祭司 她的愚蠢结束了我们的道路..."

source: "Anubis, guide my steps. See me safely to Keth-Eros... my path has run out."
target: "阿努比斯,引导我的脚步,安全地看到我到凯斯 -伊罗斯..."

source: "Mighty Anubis, if my path must end here, let this horror choke on my bones."
target: "Mighty Anubis, 如果我的道路必须在这里结束, 让这个恐怖扼死我的骨头。"

source: This is as far as I go. Continue this path, mortal, and you do so alone.
target: 继续走这条路吧,凡人,你一个人走

source: Wait, what do you mean? Where are you going?
target: 等等,你什么意思,你要去哪里?

source: I will go nowhere, but that threshold is hewn from voidstone... it supresses the free flow of essence.
target: 我哪儿也不去,但那个门槛是空洞石的... 它压抑着实质的自由流通。

source: I am merely an imprint of Kethra's essence on your soul. It will not destroy me... though it will silence me, for a time.
target: 我只不过是Kethra的精髓印在你灵魂上的印记, 它不会毁灭我...

source: How will I know when you've gone?
target: 我怎么知道你什么时候走?

source: I need to burn that effigy.
I just have to destroy the effigy.
I'm stuck in here until I destroy the effigy.
target: 我被困在这里 直到我摧毁精采。

source: The effigy isn't far, I should burn it.
target: 雕像不远,我应该烧掉它。
现在... 稍微少点恐惧

source: At least that part's over with...
Thank the gods that's done... for now.
target: 感谢神已经做了... 现在。

source: It has to be this way.
I need to head in this direction.
Thank fuck for that... don't think I had much more in me. I should take a trophy, something to prove it's dead.
Urgh... come on... almost...  there we go. One Kravenrook head.
target: 额,快到了,一个克拉文鲁克的头

source: I can see light over there... might be a way out.
target: 我可以看到光 在那里... 可能是一条出路。

source: This looks loose. If I can just...
target: 这看起来很松 如果我能...

source: By separating essence from form, the Kravenrook is able to instantly move between locations... nearby to an effigy at least.
target: 通过将本质和形式区分开来,克拉文鲁克号能够瞬间移动到... 附近至少一个精致的地方.

source: Whilst that effigy remains intact, the creature could appear at any moment. Now, destroy it!
target: 虽然这个雕塑仍然完好无损,但生物随时可能出现,现在,摧毁它!
好,摧毁这些小东西,明白了

source: Hmm, I can probably climb over the wall here.
target: 嗯,我也许可以爬过 墙在这里。

source: Someone blocked the door. I could move it.
target: 有人把门堵住了,我可以移动它

source: I wonder if she's met her lover in the afterlife...
target: 不知道她是否在来世遇见了她的情人...

source: Hmm... Looks like it's missing something. I wonder if I can find it in here somewhere...
This looks to be the right shape... I bet this will fit in the door!
target: 这看起来很合适,我敢打赌,这一定适合门!

source: All in a hard day's work.
Free use for crimes against family... Huh, wonder what she did.
target: 自由利用犯罪 伤害家庭...

source: There's something shiny at the base of that crocodile statue...
target: 鳄鱼雕像的底部有闪亮的东西...

source: Huh... What an interesting looking coin...
That is no ordinary coin... It is an obol, meant to be placed over the eyes of the dead so that they may gain safe passage into Keth-Eros.
target: 这不是普通的硬币,是一块废币, 意在让死者的眼上,让他们安全进入凯斯-埃罗斯。

source: It is a practice which fell away during Kethra's reign long, long ago. And- Strange... I... recognise the magic contained within it...
target: 这是在凯斯拉统治时期很久以前就消失的 奇怪,我...

source: No... No, it is part of a set, and cannot be used without its sister. Though, if you are wise, you will throw this coin into the Euphoris...
target: 不,它是一组的一部分,没有它的妹妹就无法使用,虽然,如果你是明智的,你会把这枚硬币扔进欧弗瑞斯...

source: Well, that's not ominous at all...
It reads: "It was written upon the founding of The Gilded Fold, that the will of The Shepherd is law."
target: 其内容为:"在吉尔德福德的创立时写到,牧羊人的意志是法律".

source: "Beyond such tenets as are written after the first amongst them, all that the Shepherd commands in her everlasting wisdom is her flock's imperative."
target: 牧羊人以永恒的智慧 命令的,都是她的教诲。

source: "Any who break the oath of these chains which bind us, shall be put to death by The Flock which they betrayed."
target: 凡违反束缚我们的枷锁的誓言者,都将被他们背叛的法洛克处死。

source: The Shepherd... The mouthpiece of Anashai...
target: 牧羊人 阿纳赛的口琴

source: "that those bound by the Chains of Servitude are to be honoured by those bound by the Chains of Masterdom, in both flesh and spirit."
target: "那些被奴役链束缚的人, 将受到那些被支配链束缚的人的尊敬, 无论是肉体还是精神。"

source: "Any who break the oath of these chains which bind us, shall be put to death by The Flock which they betrayed."
target: 凡违反束缚我们的枷锁的誓言者,都将被他们背叛的法洛克处死。

source: Is there truly law amongst Anashai's flock? Or are these tenets simply more chains with which to bind them to her will?
target: 阿纳沙伊的羊群中是否有真正的法律?还是这些信条更能束缚她们的意愿?

source: "that those bound by the Chains of Masterdom are to be honoured by those bound by the Chains of Servitude, in both flesh and spirit."
target: "那些受主锁束缚的人, 将受到那些受主锁束缚的人的尊敬, 无论是肉体还是精神"

source: "Any who break the oath of these chains which bind us, shall be put to death by The Flock which they betrayed."
target: 凡违反束缚我们的枷锁的誓言者,都将被他们背叛的法洛克处死。

source: Absolute and utter submission of both body and mind... So sought The Gilded Fold's progenitor in those she wished to enslave.
target: 绝对和彻底的屈服 身体和心灵...

source: It is no surprise that such a thing has been made law by her people...
target: 毫不奇怪,她的人已经把这种事情定了法律...

source: "A master is forbidden to partake of flesh or spirit from one who is not yet truly a slave, nor from one which does not freely offer it."
target: "主人不得分肉或精神" "尚非真奴,亦不自由供奉者"

source: "Any who break the oath of these chains which bind us, shall be put to death by The Flock which they betrayed."
target: 凡违反束缚我们的枷锁的誓言者,都将被他们背叛的法洛克处死。

source: A reflection of Anashai written upon the stone... She favoured only that which was given, rather than stolen...
target: 她只喜欢得到的东西 而不是偷来的东西

source: But how she savoured every willing capitulation she earned through guileful, saccharine words and the promise of flesh...
target: 但她是如何享受她通过诡计、神圣的言语 和肉体的许诺而得到的 愿意投降的...

source: "that those bound by the Chains of Servitude and those bound by the Chains of Masterdom are to do no harm to one another."
target: "那些被奴仆的锁链捆绑的人和被奴仆的锁链捆绑的人,是不会互相伤害的"
嗯... 这看起来很简单。

source: Hmm... It says, "The pulp of a yellow fruit." Wait... Did the warlord etch the ingredients to his elixir on the walls?
target: 上面写着"黄果酱" 等等 军阀有没有把配料塞在墙上?

source: Another ingredient! Looks like we'll need some fresh river water.
target: 再来一份,看来我们需要新鲜的河水

source: Ugh, I can barely make these inscriptions out... Looks like we need something called Night Lotus? Hm-
target: 我几乎无法把这些铭文弄出来 看来我们需要一件叫夜莲的东西?

source: This one says I need... semen. Why am I not surprised?
target: 这个说我要精液,我怎么不惊讶?

source: The blood of a murderer? Well that's awfully specific...
So this is the Night Lotus... I can... feel the power coming off of it...
target: 所以这是夜莲,我能感觉到它产生的能量...
哈 - 得到了你! - 来了!
只有一个瓶子幸存下来...

source: I wonder what these are for...
target: 我想知道这些是干什么用的...

source: So soft! I wonder what animal they got this from...
target: 这么柔软,我想知道他们从哪弄来的...

source: That's interesting. Looks like there's a scroll in that stone one's hand...
target: 很有趣 看来那把石头的手里有卷轴...

source: I wonder what's written on this scroll.
target: 我好奇这卷卷轴上写了什么

source: I should check if Mera managed to sneak off.
target: 我应该检查一下梅拉是否成功溜走了

source: She did make a run for it then... can't have gotten too far though.
target: 她确实跑过了那段路... 虽然不可能走得太远.

source: No sign of Tefahra... Maybe she left a clue that'll tell me where she's gone.
target: 也许她留下了一条线索,可以告诉我她去了哪里

source: Strange, she left her inquisition garb behind...
target: 奇怪,她把审讯室的衣物留下了...

source: She didn't finish her meal. Must have had to leave in a hurry...
target: 她没有吃完饭,必须赶时间离开...

source: A journal. It must be Tefahra's.
target: 日记,一定是特法赫拉的

source: This looks valuable. I'm surprised she didn't take it with her.
target: 这看起来很有价值 我很惊讶她没带着它

source: A note. I wager this is what I'm looking for.
target: 一张纸条,我打赌这就是我要找的

source: "Find me where the bard sings within the belly of a Lioness. Alcohol loosens lips, but only a Blood-Reed Tonic will loosen mine."
target: "找到狮子肚子里的酒吧唱的地方" "酒精会松动嘴唇" "但只有血红通尼克会松开我的"

source: Hmm, very cryptic. I should figure out what the riddle means and use it to find Tefahra...
target: 嗯,非常隐秘,我该想出谜语的含义 用它来找到Tephra...

source: Hmm... They've posted someone at the entrance. I wonder if there's another way in...
target: 他们在入口贴了个人,我想知道是否有其他办法...

source: Would you look at that? A nice back entrance...
That wall looks kind of weak. I wonder if I can smash through it.
target: 那墙看起来很弱,我想知道能不能砸穿它

source: It'd be a long jump... but maybe I can make it to the other side...
target: 那会是一个很长的跳跃... 但也许我可以到另一边...

source: I wonder what's on the other side of this puzzle...
target: 我想知道这个谜题的另一边是什么...

source: Looks like there are some footsteps in the dust to the right... That must be the direction Amhak went.
target: 看来尘土中有些脚步向右走...

source: Amhak's journal... I wonder if it says where he went.
target: 阿姆哈克的日记,我想知道它有没有说他去了哪里。

source: Still no luck. I should look elsewhere.
target: 还是没运气,我该去别的地方找找

source: I'm starting to think this incense never existed in the first place...
target: 我开始觉得这种香味从来就没有存在过...

source: Hmm... Turo doesn't seem to be here, but I found his shopping list. Wait... who on earth signs their shopping lists?
target: Turo好像不在这儿 但我找到他的购物名单了 等等...

source: Well, here's a journal entry, but still no Turo... I should return to his slave and tell her I can't find him.
target: 好吧,这是一本日记,但图罗还是没有...

source: It's hard to make out... "she that weeps life-" The rest is almost illegible. But this glyph appears several times... a place called Kab'Siron.
target: 很难说出 "她哭泣的生命..." 其他的几乎是看不见的 但是这个格言出现过几次...

source: Hmmm... "her whispering tears... forever lost to Kab'Siron" well that isn't much to go on.
target: 嗯... "她低语的眼泪... 永远输给了卡布的西伦" 没有什么可继续的了

source: Eugh... my head... Like a herd of Aadi stampeding through my skull... gahh... How in the hells did I end up here?
target: 我的头,就像一群Aadi 戳穿我的头颅一样...

source: No sign of Amhak. He must already be inside.
target: 没有Amhak的踪迹 他一定已经在里面了

source: Are those... doors up there? Not sure how I'm supposed to get to them...
Ah... the sound of pouring water... Nethyra's song... I do hope you know how to swim...
target: 啊,倒水的声音,妮茜拉的歌...

source: He left in a hurry... looks like he forgot his key.
target: 他匆忙离开... 看起来他忘了钥匙了

source: I should take this back to Sarratu... if I want to free her that is.
target: 我该把这个带回萨拉图... ... 如果我想释放她,那就是。

source: Farmer's not home. Wonder where he went...
target: 农民不在家,不知道他去哪了...

source: Those puncture wounds look deep... All the way through in some places... No animal did this...
target: 刺伤很深,有些地方没有动物...

source: Looks like there was a struggle here...
The farmer must have fought back against whatever attacked him... Judging by the blood, he got a few hits in...
target: 农民一定还击了攻击他的东西...

source: Coals are still warm...  He couldn't have been gone long...
target: 煤还很温暖 他不可能很久就走了

source: Someone lost a lot of blood... The farmer, perhaps... Looks like they were dragged away... I should look for a tracks...
target: 有人失血过多,农民,也许...

source: Footprints... A lot of them... Different sizes... Going this way...
target: 脚印 很多 大小不同 这边走

source: A dropped weapon... The farmer was still alive... Still struggling...
target: 掉下来的武器 农夫还活着 还在挣扎

source: An... arm... Chunks of flesh are missing... Not looking good...
target: 一只手臂,肉块不见了,不好看

source: They probably started eating him as soon as they dragged him from his home... Nothing I could have done...
target: 他们可能一把他从家里拖走就开始吃他...

source: This doesn't bode well... I should figure out what happened.
Hmm... The trail ends here. Did they try to flee into the river? I should look around...
Damn... That beast beat me here... I'll have to get rid of them.
target: 可恶,那畜生打我,我要把他们赶走

source: Hmm... fresh blood, but... it smells like he's been dead for a while now... And these wounds... He's barely recognisable...
No sign of gold on him. Something strange happened here. I should investigate, if only to find my reward...
target: 他身上没有金子痕迹 这里发生了奇怪的事 我该调查一下,如果只是为了找到我的赏金...

source: A sign of a struggle, perhaps? Nothing else seems out of place, though...
Why would someone kill an aadi like this...?
target: 为什么有人会杀这么一个阿迪... ?

source: What is a... pack-pack? Well, whatever it is, it mustn't be here. I don't see anything red. Besides the blood...
target: 包包是什么? 不管它是什么,它不能在这里。

source: Bloody tracks leaving from the side door... I should follow them.
target: 从侧门留下的血迹 我该跟着他们

source: More tracks... This is the way...
If I keep following these tracks, I'll find what I'm looking for.
target: 如果我继续跟踪这些轨迹 我会找到我想要的东西

source: There's always a trail to follow...
target: 总是有一条线索要跟踪...

source: Snapped clean in half, as if struck against stone... If they tried to flee by boat, they wouldn't have gone far without an oar...
target: 被打成两半,好像被石块撞了...

source: I should look further along the river...
A... red travel pack. Decorated to look like a person? Strange...
target: 红色旅行包 装扮得像人吗?

source: This... must be "pack-pack"... from the journal... Who would steal such a... thing?
target: 一定是日记上的"包裹" 谁会偷这种东西?

source: This body matches the description of the debtor exactly... Must've tried to fake his death and flee...
target: 这尸体和债务人的描述完全吻合...

source: Too bad, the river had other plans for him. Ah well. Bounty complete, all in a day's work.
target: 可惜,河里还有别的计划,好极了 丰满,一天之内就完成了

source: Looks like she wants me to follow her!
Aww... Did you really have to drag me through here?
target: 你真的非要把我从这儿拖过来吗?

source: *sigh* Gonna make me work for it, are you?
Is it possible for you not to drag me through more trouble?
target: 你会不会不把我拖过更多的麻烦?

source: This better be the last stop...
How many of these cisterns are there?
Well that explains the noises... Now where is that gold...?
target: 那能解释那声音吗 金子在哪儿?

source: Hmm... No way down this one. Maybe there's some rope around here...
target: 这下不行了 也许这附近有绳子...

source: Hmm- He must have fallen down here and gotten trapped. Then the curse got to him...
target: 他一定是掉下来被困住了 然后诅咒降临到他身上

source: Looks like an ambush... One that didn't end well for either side. I should take care of those scavengers; see if there's anything of value.
target: 看来是埋伏了,两边都不好,我应该照顾好那些扫荡者,看看有没有有价值的东西。
这个看起来... 很有趣...

source: I wonder what this one- oh, like that!
target: 我想知道这个... 哦,像这样!

source: I'm sure I'll come up with a use for this...
target: 我肯定我会想出一个用途的...
哇... 这感觉... 不一样!

source: Fuck, I don't think that would even fit...
target: 妈的,我觉得这根本不适合...

source: Oh! This one would be a tight squeeze...
target: 哦,这个会是紧紧的挤压...

source: To the dung pit-scum known as Nassiros, I ordered copper ingots, not crates of dried Aadi dung.
target: 给那个叫纳西罗斯的粪坑渣 我订了铜器 不是一箱干燥的阿迪粪

source: To the so-called-honourable copper dealer, may you suffer the agony of countless Dunebugs gnawing your flesh.
target: 对所谓的荣誉的铜商, 愿你遭受无数的邓布格 缠着你的肉的痛苦。

source: Nassiros, your weak copper crumbled when cast, ruining the bespoke plug I ordered. Imagine my immeasurable disappointment.
target: 纳西罗斯,你那弱小的铜器在铸造时崩溃了, 毁了我点的响亮的插头, 想象一下我的无比失望。

source: You miserable excuse of a minoan taint! Send my messenger back to me empty-handed one more time and I'll wring that fat neck of yours.
target: 你这个卑鄙的借口,再让我的使者空手回我身边 我会扭你的大脖子

source: Nassiros, may you bear unrelenting shame. Consider this formal notice of our partnership's termination. Weeping sores be upon you.
target: 纳西罗斯,请您忍无可忍的羞耻 考虑一下正式通知我们的合伙人即将终止
这些废墟看起来很古老.

source: Yet it feels as if only yesterday... I watched as these... ruins were created... So much death... The climax of my empire's obliteration...
target: 但感觉就像昨天 我看着这些废墟...

source: Fish oil... Doesn't smell great, but it'll do the job...
target: 鱼油,味道不好,但是它能起作用...

source: This place... holds... memories... so many memories...
target: 这个地方... 保存着... 记忆... 这么多的记忆...

source: So much life here... nothing seems touched by the curse at all...
target: 这么多的生活... 似乎没有什么受到诅咒的触动...

source: Strange... it looks like they were killed by the plants?
target: 奇怪... 他们好像被植物杀死了?

source: Ugh, more of those wretched plants.
target: 啊,更多这些可怜的植物。

source: Picking weeds is a never-ending job, isn't it?
target: 摘大麻是永无止境的工作,不是吗?

source: Every rose has its thorns, I suppose.
target: 我想每一朵玫瑰都有它的刺

source: Never thought I'd have to fight the garden.
target: 从没想过我会和花园争吵
这些藤条看起来很危险。

source: I need to watch my step.
I've never seen anything more in need of being burnt to a crisp...
target: 我从未见过任何更需要被烧焦的...

source: Gods, how many of these things are there?

target: 是时候打碎一些虫子了!

source: Ugh, why do they smell so bad?
target: 唉,为什么他们闻到这么臭?

source: So... the flora of this place can defend itself.
target: 所以... 这个地方的植物可以保护自己

source: I probably shouldn't pick that up... Then again... it looks valuable.
target: 我可能不该去捡这个,然后又看起来很值钱

source: This water should do the trick...
Mmh- fuck... Can't believe I'm- mmfh- doing this... H-hope it works!
target: 真不敢相信我居然这样 希望这能行

source: Here you go... some nice, cool water for you.
target: 给你... 一些不错的凉水给你

source: Hmm... Must be something to do with the order these are activated.
target: 一定是和启动的命令有关

source: I can't skip any... Every obelisk I activate needs to be adjacent to the last one I activated.
If I could find a way to activate all of the obelisks without doubling back over ones I've already touched... Yeah, that should work.
target: 如果我能找到一个方法激活所有的方尖碑 而不翻倍回我已经碰过的东西...

source: I just need to find the right order to activate these...
target: 我只是需要找到正确的命令来激活这些...

source: The music must have something to do with the barrier....
It plays the same tones every time... I wonder if I can match them...
target: 每次都一样的音调,我想我能不能和他们匹配...

source: I should try playing the same tones in the same order as the barrier...
target: 我该试着用同样的音量 和屏障的顺序...

source: Hmmph- wish I had a better memory...
target: 希望我有一个更好的记忆...

source: I'm as settled in as I'll ever be. I should return to the High Priestess.
target: 我和以前一样安顿好了,我应该回到大祭司身边

source: This bunk looks free. Guess I should sleep in it—make it official.
target: 这个床看起来很自由,我想我该睡在床里...

source: Right, I can see you're, erm... busy... but, would either of you happen to know if one of these bunks is available for me to use?
target: 是的,我看到你,呃... ... 忙... 但是,你们中谁 碰巧知道这些床铺之一 可以让我使用吗?

source: I... don't even want to know what those stains are from...
target: 我... 我甚至不想知道这些污点是...

source: Eugh... the smell coming off that mattress is... ripe...
target: 厄... 床垫上的味道... 已经熟了...

source: You couldn't pay me to use that bed.
target: 你不能付钱给我用那张床

source: Looks like this one's been claimed.
I need to find a bed that's not being used.
target: 我需要找到一张没有被使用的床。

source: This chest should do well enough for keeping my things safe.
target: 这个胸应该足够保护我的东西

source: My daughter... such a... passionate spirit... Even from within your mind I can feel her thirst. Her yearning. Her desire to escape...
target: 我的女儿... 如此热情的心灵...

source: The land is the foundation upon which all the world rests... Though despite its burden, it never ceases giving.
target: 这片土地是全世界赖以生存的基础...

source: Water is the source of all life, carried from the sea across the land through its many rivers and springs... Embody its life-giving anima.
target: 水是所有生命的源泉,它从海洋中穿过陆地,穿过河流和泉水...

source: The essence of life is carried upon the wind, and the air of the sky is the source of all wisdom. Give thanks for each and every breath.
target: 生之精气,随风而载;天之气气,乃万物智慧之源,每息而谢.

source: Appears she and her heretical friends were unable to obtain the ritual vessel. Defeated by some Void-infused construct...
target: 她和她的异教徒朋友似乎无法获得祭祀容器,但被一些被瓦迪浸透的建筑所挫败.

source: Her journal mentions someone-a Scribe. They would know how to defeat the guardian.
target: 她的日记提到一个Scribe的人,他们会知道如何打败监护人。

source: I'll take these notes to Khaba.
A place to store my things. Nice.
target: 存放我东西的地方 不错

source: I ask that you watch over me, Bast... For you are a lighted coal which ignites my fury, and the cleansing flame which burns away my desires.
target: 我请求你保护我,巴斯特 因为你是燃起我愤怒的燃煤 和燃烧我欲望的净化火焰

source: I believe in one creed, of purity and righteousness... It is your work which I carry out, Bast... It is in your name that I cleanse the land of evil.
target: 我相信一种信仰,即纯洁和正义...

source: My mind is a blade forged of your zealous fire. My spirit bears the mantle of your ineffable wisdom. My heart is guarded by your infinite grace...
target: 我的心灵是你们热情的火所铸造的剑,我的精神承载着你们无穷的智慧,我的心被你们无限的恩典所守护......

source: The fallen shall perish as wheat before the scythe. The corrupt shall burn in cleansing fire. The weak shall lament in the face of justice...
target: 堕落者必如麦子在锡石之前消亡,堕落者必在清洗火中焚毁,弱者当面对正义而叹息......

source: No one else is using it...
Oooh what do we have here?
Wonder how much this is worth.
It's funny what you can find just laying around.
target: 躺着就能找到的真有趣

source: Fortune favours the bold, as they say.
target: 财富喜欢大胆的人,正如他们说的。
你和我,老朋友,我们是朋友

source: Behave or I'll drown you in the Euphoris.
target: 要乖要不然我把你淹死在优波笈多河里

source: A love note to Mehlva from Havar. Maybe I shouldn't read this...
target: 哈瓦给梅赫娃的情书 也许我不该读这个...

source: Simply brushing my fingers across the gemstone... makes my whole entire body tingle! I can't imagine what it'd be like to wear it.

target: 梅尔瓦会喜欢这个礼物的

source: It... It's finished... Atá is free... As it should be...
target: 结束了,阿塔自由了,应该...

source: It... It's finished... Atá is free... There's nothing I could do...
target: 结束了,阿塔自由了 我无能为力
嗯... 一种获得的味道...

source: Mmh- it is nice and creamy, at least...
target: 嗯,这是很好的和奶油,至少...

source: Gods... I can already feel it working...
target: 天啊,我已经感觉到它有用了...

source: Phew... This must be Khoomah... Judging by the smell, I'd say the name is a bit too on the nose...
target: 这一定是胡马的味道,我说这个名字太过鼻了...

source: Woah...  what's going on over there?
target: 哇... 那边发生什么事了?

source: Looks like a ritual vessel, leaking or something- tss- argh-! Just being near it hurts, and I can feel it draining my essence.
target: 看起来像一个仪式的容器,漏水之类的东西,只是靠近它会痛,我感觉它会耗尽我的精髓。

source: I can't stay near it for too long.
target: 我不能待在这里太久了

source: Ackh- it's gonna suck all the essence out of me if I'm not careful...
target: Ackh... 如果我不小心的话,它会吸我所有的精髓...

source: I need to find a way to seal it...
Ugh- gods that hurts. It's probably not even working as well as it used to either...
target: 痛的上帝,可能没有以前那么好用...

source: Strange... a dead Inquisitor out here. I wonder why...
target: 奇怪的是,一个死了的问询员,我想知道为什么...

source: Looks like they kept a journal. I wonder if it mentions the ritual vessel...
target: 他们好像藏了日记 不知道它有没有提到祭祀船...

source: So I need to seal the ritual vessel with Void... Hmm...
target: 所以我需要用Void封住仪式的容器...

source: Of course they're not all dead...
Hmm, must be the shrine I'm looking for...
target: 嗯,一定是我要找的神庙...

source: I can almost... feel her presence here...
target: 我几乎可以... 感觉到她在这里...

source: This place gives me the creeps... Can't believe I'm about to help the Inquisition...
A ritual vessel, still filled with Essence... now to destroy it. Or use it...
target: 一种仪式的容器,仍然充满了埃森斯...

source: Nnngh- the power... Don't think I'll ever get used to it...
target: 电源,别以为我会习惯的

source: Hmmph- locked, by magic of some kind.
Huh... nothing here, but a couple maps leading to... the actual treasure, maybe?
target: 这里什么都没有,只是一对地图 通往... 真正的宝藏,也许?

source: This dildo is warm... almost... alive?
target: 这个迪尔多很暖和... 几乎... 活着?

source: Looks like a... pussy of some kind- one I can hold in my hands... This could be... useful....
*minor grunts of effort from dragging a body a short distance across the sand*
target: * 拖着尸体在沙滩上短距离 所付出的微小努力*

source: Oh... You poor thing... Was this your old master?
target: 哦,你这可怜的家伙,这是你以前的主人吗?

source: Well... I guess you *could* come with me now...
target: 我想你现在可以跟我来...
嗯,什么是给你起的名字...

source: I'm going to call you... Lass'i!
I'm going to call you.... Aadi.
I'm going to call you... Nefretta.
I'm going to call you... Spot!
I'm going to call you... Sweethoof!
Fuck yeah! I'm going... I'm going to run to Arkiit Market and back...
target: 我跑到阿基特市场再回来...

source: I could keep going for days.... days... you don't have any, do you?
target: 我可以继续几天... 几天... 你没有,是吗?

source: Never... never enough... I just need another sip... to take the edge off...
target: 从来没有,从来没有足够... 我只是需要另一口...

source: I'll kill those bandits with my bare hands... once I've had another taste...
target: 我要赤手空拳地杀了那些匪徒 一旦我又尝到另一口味...

source: Who are you? What do you want?
I don't know what you mean. I don't h-have anything.
target: 我不知道你什么意思 我什么也没有

source: I just want to try some myself.
I... ah, only fair I guess... Khoomah is a gift from the gods. Front me a little coin for my own taste and I'll take you along.
target: 霍玛是神赐给我的礼物,给我一点硬币,让我尝尝,我带你去

source: Hmmm. Barely enough for a... eh what the hell, follow me
I just want to try some myself.
Is there something I can do for you?
I'd prefer to be left alone, if you don't mind.
target: 如果你不介意的话 我宁愿一个人待着

source: Oh no... Not one of you again!
Well it's mine now, thank you.
target: 好了,现在是我的了,谢谢你。

source: You have what you came for, so go... please?
target: 你有你来的目的,所以去... 请?
哈 - 得到了你! - 来了!

source: N-no! Please, stop! I don't want to fight!
W-what do you want? You're not one of those Gilded Fold assholes are you?
target: 你想干什么 你不是那些吉尔德·福德的混蛋吧

source: No, but you did steal from one of them...
target: 没有,但你确实从其中之一偷...

source: So that's why you're here? To get that jar back for that waste of space? Do you even know what it does?
target: 所以这就是你来这里的原因?

source: That crazy bitch was trying to capture me and turn me into a slave!
target: 那个疯婊子想抓我 把我变成奴隶!

source: Listen, I don't want any trouble, but I think you should leave...
target: 听着,我不想惹麻烦,但我觉得你应该离开...

source: As a matter of fact, I am. And I demand you return the jar to me at once!
target: 事实上,我是的,我要求你马上把罐子还给我!

source: Why should I give such a thing back to your kind? Y-you'll just try to use it on me again...
target: 我为什么要把这种东西还给你?

source: Because if you don't, bad things will happen to you, obviously.
