target: 现在把艾森斯拉进去 把你学到的魔法投到这里,我可以在这里见证你

source: Magnificent... Truly, magnificent... Go now, gird yourself with more power. I will remain here to offer guidance whenever you have need of it.
target: 伟大的,真正的,伟大的,现在,用更多的力量来赋予自己,我会在这里指导你需要它的时候。

source: Endure your hardships with grace, for it is through them your character is forged.
target: 用恩典来忍受你的痛苦,因为通过他们,你的性格是伪造的。

source: Live each day as if it were your last, but also, plan as if you will live forever.
target: 每天都要活 就像你最后一样 也得计划好... 仿佛你会永远活着一样

source: Happiness depends on your attitude towards life, not on what life brings to you.
target: 幸福取决于你对生活的态度,而不是生命给你带来什么.

source: As the palm tree in a sand storm, you must recognise the ability to endure torment outlasts the ability to deliver it.
target: 作为沙暴中的棕榈树, 你必须认识到承受痛苦的能力 超过提供它的能力。

source: Never trust a Minoan wearing a smile.
target: 千万别相信一个戴着微笑的米诺安人

source: Appear weak when you are strong, and strong when you are weak.
target: 身强时视弱,身弱时视强.

source: The journey measured in days begins with a single step.
target: 以天为单位的旅程从一个步骤开始。

source: Blood in the sand means danger at hand.
Allow your desire to find its place, lest you be caught in the curse's embrace.
target: 让你的欲望找到它的位置 以免你陷入诅咒的怀抱中

source: Remember, that with great power, comes great responsibility.
target: 记住,拥有强大力量,责任重大。

source: To defeat a Felreq is one thing. To absorb its Essence is another. And for a Formless to do so... Incredible...
target: 打败费勒克是一回事 吸收其爱森思是另一回事

source: I don't know about any of that, I was only defending myself... Who are you anyway? I didn't see you before.
target: 我不知道,我只是在为自己辩护...

source: The more important question is, who are you? Do you even realise what you've done?
target: 更重要的问题是,你是谁,你知道你做了什么吗?

source: I'm confused... Did I do something wrong?
target: 我很困惑 我做错什么了吗?

source: On the contrary, what you did was astounding. Perhaps... Yes, perhaps there is hope, afterall...
target: 恰恰相反,你所做的令人惊叹,也许...

source: Hope? Hope for what? I'm just trying to get this mask off...
target: 希望什么希望 我只是想把面具脱下来...

source: Of course, of course. With the Essence you absorbed from the Felreq, you can do just that...
target: 当然,当然了,用你从费勒克河吸收的神情,你可以...

source: Find me at The Shrine of Ascension on Tal'Senet. And do so quickly, Vessel.
target: 在阿森松圣殿的塔勒赛内特找到我,快点,船只

source: It is done. Fate, disrupted, like a stone cast into a still pond.
target: 命运被打乱了,就像一块石头扔进静水池里

source: I speak of you, Vessel. I can feel the beginnings of a great power emanating from your spirit, as embers yearning to become a roaring inferno.
target: 我说的是你,船,我能感觉到你精神中产生的强大力量的开始,就像爱默思成为咆哮的地狱一样。

source: Is this... some kind of riddle?
What you have done should be impossible. Impossible for all but The Goddess herself. Only she can manipulate Essence as you have.
target: 你所做的应该是不可能的,除了女神自己 其他人都不可能,只有她能像你们一样操控艾森斯

source: Indeed. Flowing through all things, it is the source of life itself, the very fabric of the spirit and the fuel for sorcery.
target: 的确,它贯穿于一切,是生命本身的源泉,精神的结构以及巫术的燃料。

source: In all the history of Sabu, and perhaps the entire world, only Kethra and an exceptionally few others have been capable of doing such a thing as you have.
target: 在萨布的所有历史中,也许整个世界,只有凯斯拉和极少数其他人有能力做你曾经做过的事情.

source: You harvested the Essence of the Felreq, poured it into the shrine, and then shattered what should have been otherwise unbreakable fetters.
target: 你收割了费勒克神的神迹, 把它倒进神殿, 然后粉碎了本来是无法解开的脚镣。

source: You have been reborn of your own volition.
I still don't understand. I'm just... being... me.
target: 我还是不明白 我只是...

source: Perhaps, though now Kethra is free from her tomb, it is only a matter of time before she visits vengeful death upon all of Sabu.
target: 也许,尽管现在Kethra已经摆脱了她的坟墓,但她只是时间问题,她要到萨布全岛进行报复性的死亡。

source: And only you, Vessel, may stop her...
Wait... you expect me to take on a goddess? Me?
target: 等等,你指望我当女神吗?

source: In time, yes... But before then, you must travel the land and harvest Essence, returning here periodically to empower The Shrine of Ascension.
target: 在那之前,你必须游历这片土地,收获埃森斯, 定期回到这里,赋予阿森松圣殿权力。

source: As you now understand, the shrine allows you, a Vessel, to achieve a multitude of forms, each born of Kethra's many creations from during her reign.
target: 你们现在知道,神社允许你们,一艘飞船, 实现多种形式, 每个形式都是Kethra在她统治期间创造的。

source: With enough Essence stored within, it is my belief that the shrine will allow you to take on a form equal to, or perhaps even greater, than Kethra's own.
target: 我相信,只要Essence有足够的钱 能够让你以与Kethra相同甚至更大的形式出现
但是 为什么 为什么是我

source: Because... You are The Vessel. Only you are capable of doing what must be done.
target: 因为,你是"船",只有你有能力做必须做的事

source: Now, before I answer anymore of your questions, I wish to speak to you of sorcery.
target: 现在,在我回答你的问题之前,我想和你谈谈巫术。

source: Yes. It is the manipulation of Essence to perform seemingly miraculous feats. Much like what the Felreq used in its attempts to destroy you.
target: 是的,是Essence的操纵 来完成看起来奇迹般的功绩 就像Felreq在试图摧毁你时所用的

source: Is that something I can learn to do?
Indeed, though you must learn sorcery not through study, but through acquisition. It has been an age since sorcery was taught...
target: 的确,虽然你必须学会巫术,不是通过学习,而是通过获得。

source: Now, such powers are only obtainable by new practitioners through the absorption of a dead practitioner's memory, or rather, their Essence.
target: 现在,这种能力只能由新业者通过吸收一个死去的业者记忆,或者说,他们的Essence来获得.

source: It is this fact which gives me cause to envy you, Vessel... You are capable of easily absorbing sorcerous knowledge as well as Essence.
target: 我嫉妒你 船 你和艾森斯一样能轻易吸收巫术知识

source: Can you teach me how to use it, then?
I can, though you require little from me. Approach The Shrine of Ascension, and commune with it.
target: 我可以,尽管你对我的要求很少 接近阿森松圣殿,并与之共进

source: You will find that with the expenditure of Essence into the stone, you may gain the ability to use a sorcery attained from defeating uniquely powerful foes.
target: 你会发现,用Essence的花费 进入石头, 你可能获得的能力 使用巫术 通过击败 独特的强大敌人。

source: It is my belief you have unlocked such a potential sorcery from the Felreq whose Essence you harvested. Go, and see for yourself.
target: 我相信你们已经从费勒克的魔力中解开了 这么潜在的魔法,你们自己去看看吧

source: There is always time for questions, Vessel.
I noticed you were able to teleport to the shrine somehow. Is that something I can do too?
target: 我注意到你通过某种方式 传送到神社,我也能做到吗?

source: Ah yes, Korvoth's Sceptre. It is an artifact that is attuned to this place, allowing me to travel here on a whim. Though, it is only here it will take me.
target: 科尔沃斯的权杖,是一件适合这个地方的文物,允许我一时冲动地旅行到这里,不过它只是在这里,它会带我走.

source: I would give it to you, Vessel, but... unfortunately, it was carried off by a karrow. The beast carried its prize over Mehden and into the mountains.
target: 我本想给你的,但很不幸,它被一只小牛带走了 那只野兽把它的奖品带到了梅登和山上

source: If you can find it, you may keep it.
target: 如果你能找到,你可以留着它

source: Can I get some guidance from you, Amara?
target: 阿玛拉,我能从你那里得到一些指导吗?

source: For what do you require my counsel?
I was wondering if you had any wise words you could share with me.
target: 我想知道你有什么明智的话 可以和我分享

source: You have taken the first step upon your fated path, Vessel... There will be no turning back for you now.
target: 你踏上了注定的道路 船们 不会再回头了

source: No one is free, who is not master of themself... or... their desires.
target: 没有人是自由的,谁不是他们的主人自己... 或他们的欲望。

source: Then you should satisfy your needs, but take care not to dwell on such trivialities in the face of your greater purpose.
target: 那你应该满足你的需要, 但不要在面对你更大的目的时 沉浸在这种琐事中。

source: Keep company with those who will help you keep your mind clear of such distractions.
target: 和那些会帮你的人在一起 让你的头脑远离这种分心

source: Whoever has control over their own desire, has the power of gods.
target: 谁能控制自己的欲望,谁就拥有神力.

source: If it is within your control to... settle such arousal, then be done with it.
target: 如果你能控制住... 解决这种激动,那就用它吧

source: You must discover an outlet for your urges.
target: 你必须发现一个出口 为你的愿望。

source: Do not allow Kethra's corruption to take root.
target: 别让凯斯拉的腐败根深蒂固

source: It's nothing... you did what you had to... Go now.
target: 没什么,你做了你必须做的事...

source: Transfer his Essence into the Shrine of Ascension, and witness but a taste of the change you shall bring to Sabu.
target: 把他的艾森斯移到阿森松圣殿去 见证一下你给萨布带来的改变

source: Where can I find more Essence?
target: 哪里能找到更多的艾森斯吗?

source: As you know, Essence flows through all living things. It is the force of life which forms the spirit. It compels both body and mind, and is coloured by desire.
target: 正如你们所知,艾森斯流遍一切生物,是生命的力量,它形成了精神,它强迫身体和心灵,并被欲望所染色。

source: Creatures both large and small, sentient and otherwise, contain Essence. The greater the mind, the greater the spirit, the greater the Essence.
target: 生既大小,神灵异类,皆能抑制艾森斯,心智越大,精神越强,艾森斯也越强.

source: Thus, there is no better source of Essence than the demi-god children of Kethra. Their Essence is also unique from that which dwells within mortals.
target: 因此,没有比凯斯拉的神童更能说明问题,他们的神灵也与凡人所居住的神灵不同。

source: It is their Essence you will need to unlock the true potential of the Shrine of Ascension.
target: 你们需要释放阿森松神社的真正潜力。

source: How do I get demi-god Essence?
target: 我该怎么得到神明的爱森斯?

source: The same way you gather all other Essence. You must slay them... The demi-gods...
target: 就像你收集其他艾森斯一样 你必须杀了他们...

source: Find them in their hiding places... Cull them... Every last one that you can bring yourself to kill, and reap from them their power. It is the only way.
target: 把他们藏在藏身的地方,把他们关起来, 把他们从他们那里夺走,这是唯一的办法。

source: I... wouldn't even know where to begin.
target: 我甚至不知道从何说起

source: Fear not, Vessel, for I am here to guide you in all things...  You must seek out Pahnu, lord of primal truths and warden of untamed wilderness.
target: 别害怕,船,因为我是来指导你的一切的...

source: His temple, unknown to most, even during Kethra's reign, lies upon sacred ground beyond the desert, in a place where sand gives way to fertile soil.
target: 他的神庙,大多数人都不认识,甚至在凯斯拉统治时期,就位于沙漠以外的圣地上,一个沙子让位于肥沃土壤的地方.

source: Go... Reap that which Kethra has sown. There is no other way to stop her.
target: 去,去抢Kethra所买的东西,没有别的办法可以阻止她了

source: Where do I get more demi-god Essence?
target: 我从哪里得到更多的神明爱森斯?

source: In this, I am afraid, I cannot help you. The demi-gods have hidden themselves from the world. From me.
target: 恐怕我帮不了你 邪神隐藏了自己

source: You must scour Sabu to find them...  deep beneath the earth, atop the highest plateaus, or even hidden in plain sight.
target: 你必须扫荡萨布才能找到他们... 在地底深处, 在最高高原上,甚至隐藏在眼前。

source: It is your duty to find them, collect their Essence, and empower the Shrine of Ascension. It is the only way to save our world from the coming storm.
target: 你有责任找到他们,收集他们的艾森斯,赋予阿森松圣女权力,这是拯救我们的世界免遭即将到来的风暴的唯一办法。

source: I'm... Well, erm... I need sex... badly...

target: [查 哪里能找到更多的艾森斯?

source: [Quest]Where can I get more demi-god Essence?
target: [问]哪里可以得到更多的demi -god Essence?

source: I'm... Well, erm... I need sex... badly...
Beware, stranger, it is not safe for you here.
target: 小心,陌生人,你在这里不安全

source: As I tread upon The Path, you guide my steps, O' Jackal,  sweeping away the fog, and showing me the way...
target: 当我踏上道路时,你指引我的脚步,奥・杰克尔, 扫清雾霾,并指示我...

source: Hands off! Only those walk The Path may touch the reliquary.
target: 把手拿开 只有那些走过的路才能触摸到灵光

source: So... this is the reliquary you mentioned?
target: 所以... 这就是你提到的纪念品?

source: Indeed. It must be brought to The Great Temple in Wased-Heq before it's too late.
target: 的确,它必须送到瓦塞德-赫克的大圣殿 以免太迟

source: Have you spoken to the captain?
Good. Even after all you have done for us, I have a request of you.
target: 好,你为我们做了这么多事,我还是有你的要求的

source: Come with me... I wish to speak with you away from the others.
target: 跟我来,我想和你谈谈 远离其他人。

source: I take it you have decided to carry the reliquary to Wased-Heq?
target: 我猜你已经决定把遗物带到Wased-Heq了?

source: Perhaps a blessing would convince you to aid me?
target: 也许祝福能说服你帮我?

source: Blessing? What sort of blessing do you mean?
The kind of blessing that leaves you trembling in ecstasy...
target: 那种祝福让你在摇头丸中颤抖...

source: Come, lay with me. Experience the pleasure offered to those who serve The Jackal.
target: 来,和我躺在一起 体验那些为杰克服务的人的快乐

source: Take the reliquary and make haste to the temple. Go... before that thing returns...
target: 带上回肠器,快点去庙里,快去...

source: May The Path be your guide, traveler.

target: 控制你自己! 控制自己! 控制自己! 控制自己!

source: You'll regret striking a priestess of The Jackal!
target: 你会后悔的 袭击了《小丑》的女祭司!

source: If you know what's good for you, you will flee this place.
target: 如果你知道什么对你有好处, 你会逃离这个地方。

source: We were savagely attacked by a fearsome creature. At least I think it was a creature... More likely some form of wraith.
target: 我们被一个可怕的生物野蛮攻击 至少我觉得它是一种生物...

source: It killed so many... Luckily, a strike from Asim caused it to flee, but I fear it will soon return with a vengeance.
Did you get a good look at the creature that attacked you?
target: 你仔细看过攻击你的生物了吗?

source: Unfortunately, no. I was safeguarding the reliquary while my coterie fought to protect me, as is their duty.
target: 不幸的是,不,我是在保护养家糊口的人 而我的美食者为了保护我而战斗,也是他们的职责

source: I am Ameni, a priestess of The Jackal and bearer of the reliquary
target: 我是阿门尼,杰克尔的女祭司 和继承人

source: This isn't the time for jokes...
target: 现在不是开玩笑的时候...

source: That remains to be seen. One of our scouts went looking for a way off the island, but has yet to return...
target: 我们的一个侦察员去寻找离开小岛的路,但还没有回来...

source: The captain of the warriors believes we can make a stand here, but it's a fool's errand without proper armaments.
target: 武士队长相信我们可以在这里站立,但是没有适当的武器,这是傻瓜的差事.

source: What exactly happened to your weapons?
I've answered enough of your questions. Leave me... I must meditate upon The Path. It always provides a way...
target: 我已经回答了你的问题 离开我 我必须思考一下"道路"

source: All of you were shipwrecked here?
Unfortunately, yes. The Euphoris is often cruel to those who attempt to sail its waters.
target: 不幸的是,是的,优波笈多人常常对试图航行其水域的人残忍.

source: Now the sacred reliquary may never reach the Wased-Heq peninsula...
target: 现在神圣的复活节 可能永远无法到达瓦希德-赫克半岛...

source: I could take the reliquary for you, I made it here after all.
target: 我可以帮你拿回药,我还是在这里做的

source: No! Ahem.... I mean, no. Only those of The Path may touch it, and only a priestess such as I can properly inter it.
target: 不,不,只有"道路"的人才能碰它 只有我这样的女祭司才能插进去

source: You should know, traveller, it is uncouth to interupt a priestess during her prayers...
target: 旅行者,你应该知道,在女祭司祈祷时 打断她很不礼貌...

source: I just don't see why prayer would help when there's a monster out there.
target: 我只是不明白为什么祈祷会帮助 当有一个怪物在那里。

source: I see... You must be new to these lands, so I will forgive your insolence.
target: 明白了,你一定是新来的这片土地, 所以我会原谅你的傲慢。

source: I pray for a great many reasons. I pray for strength, protection, wisdom, and above all, to honor Anubis.
target: 我为许多原因祈祷,我祈祷力量,保护,智慧,最重要的是,为阿努比斯致敬.

source: Just between you and I, it seems to me that the captain can't keep his eyes off you.
target: 就你我之间,我觉得船长 无法不注意你

source: Anyone who lays with a priestess of The Jackal often becomes a thrall to such an erotic embrace.
target: 和《小丑》的女祭司上床的人 常常会成为这种色情拥抱的折磨

source: Oh, so you mean the two of you are... like...
target: 哦,所以你的意思是你们两个是... 像...

source: Of course... though surely you have something more important you wish discuss.
target: 当然... 虽然你肯定有更重要的事要讨论

source: I found enough boats for your party, they're not far from here.
target: 我找到足够的船 为你派对, 他们离这里不远。

source: You did so without being slain by that thing... well done.
target: 你这样做没有被那东西杀死... 做得好。

source: Let the captain know of your discovery. We shall make preparations to head for the boats at once.
target: 让船长知道你的发现 我们会马上准备出发

source: I found the weapons you asked for, they were at the place your vessel ran aground.
target: 我找到你要的武器了,它们就在你的船搁浅的地方。

source: You've impressed me... Not an easy feat. Did you bring them with you?
target: 你给我留下了深刻的印象,不是一件容易的事,你带他们一起来的吗?

source: Please, let the captain know. We must make preparations for our stand.
target: 请让船长知道 我们必须准备我们的立场

source: The creature is dead, I've slain it.
It wasn't easy, but yes. Here, I have the beast's head as proof.
target: 虽然不容易,但是是的,这里,我把野兽的头当作证据。

source: You have my gratitude... I felt certain we would all... no matter, that has passed now.
target: 我很感激你 我觉得我们一定...

source: Show the captain proof of your kill so he may prepare the warriors for our journey.
target: 向船长出示你杀人的证据 这样他就能为我们的旅程做准备了

source: Now we may speak, but lower your voice.
target: 现在我们可以说话了,但小声点

source: I must ask a favor of you the others wouldn't understand...
target: 我必须请你帮个忙 其他人不会明白的

source: I fear it's merely our presence which has caused the thing to attack us.
target: 恐怕正是我们的存在 才导致它袭击了我们

source: Even though you have been extremely helpful, and may have saved our lives...
target: 虽然你帮了大忙,也许救了我们一命...

source: I still worry we may fall to another onslaught, making all we have fought and died for to have been for nothing.
target: 我仍然担心我们可能会陷入另一场攻击, 把我们所有的斗争和死亡都变成白费力气。

source: I wish for you to take the reliquary to Wased-Heq in our stead.
target: 我希望你能代替Wased -Heq 代替我们

source: They can never know the truth...
target: 他们永远不能知道真相...

source: Won't they immediately notice that the reliquary is missing?
target: 他们不会立即发现 遗物不见了吗?

source: They will not. The reliquary box contains within it a concealed smaller box. This is the true reliquary.
target: 他们不会的,那圆箱里面有个小盒子,这是真正的圆箱。

source: I will keep the larger container with us while you take the smaller one.
target: 我会把更大的容器 和我们一起,而你拿较小的。

source: I will await you at the Great Temple of Anubis where the relic is to be interred.
target: 我会在阿努比斯大殿等你 在那里,遗物将被夹住。

source: I thought only those who walked The Path could touch it?
target: 我以为只有走过这条路的人才能碰它?

source: You are correct... However, as a priestess, I grant you my blessing to carry it.
target: 你说得对,但是,作为一位女祭司, 我祝福你来携带它。

source: So I don't have to swear an oath to the Jackal or something?
target: 这么说我不必向杰克发誓什么的?

source: No, although I do hope one day you will find yourself walking The Path.
target: 不,虽然我希望有一天你会发现自己走在路上。

source: I have made up my mind.
I am glad to hear it.
target: 我很高兴听到这个消息。

source: I've decided to take the reliquary for you.
I knew you would... I believe the Jackal had your path cross ours for this very purpose.
Before we continue along our paths, I offer you a blessing of both flesh and spirit...
target: 在我们继续前进之前,我为你们提供肉体和精神的祝福...

source: An offering given by those who serve The Jackal.
target: 侍奉杰克的人献的礼物

source: I've decided that it's not a task I can agree to right now, I'll think on it though.
target: 我决定这不是我现在可以同意的任务 但我会考虑的

source: I understand your trepidation. To carry such a sacred relic can be a burden...
target: 我明白你的惊恐 携带如此神圣的遗物可能是一个负担...

source: It will remain here, for you to take, should you so choose.
target: 如果你愿意的话,它会留在这,给你。

source: Now we may speak, but lower your voice.
target: 现在我们可以说话了,但小声点

source: I need to ask a favor of you that may be hard for you to understand...
target: 我要请你帮个忙,也许你很难理解...

source: I recieved a vision while you were away... Difficult to discipher, but one thing was made abundantly clear...
target: 你离开的时候我恢复了视力 很难辨别 但有一件事非常清楚

source: A vision... wait, was I in it?
target: 一个幻象... 等等,我在里面吗?

source: Our paths are meant to lead here, to a carnal embrace... lay with me.
target: 我们的路是通往这里, 到一个肉体拥抱... 和我躺在一起。

source: This is the will of The Jackal...
I could carry it there for you...
I found some boats you could use...
target: 我发现一些船 你可以使用...

source: I have made up my mind.
I will have to think about it...
Of course, I have them here.
N-no no! You lot stay down there! No fresh meat for you today!
target: 不 不 你们都呆在下面 今天不准吃新鲜的肉

source: Thank The Jackal you came along! I climbed up to get the ritual vessel and a bunch of those- whatever they are- started crawling out of the walls.
target: 我爬上去拿礼器和那些东西...

source: Silly me left my weapon at home. Heh...
target: 傻子,我把武器丢在家里了

source: Yeah, why- Oh the time! My sisters sent you after me, didn't they? Thanks for the rescue friend, but I need to get going or else I'll be late for my shift!
target: 是啊,为什么,时间到了,我的姐妹们派你来抓我,不是吗?

source: I'll see you back at the camp then, yeah? Until then!
target: 在那之前,我会在营地见你的

source: It's good to see you again friend. Before we talk, though, my sister Astari wants to have a word with you...
target: 很高兴再次见到你朋友,不过,在我们谈话之前,我妹妹阿斯塔里想和你谈谈...

source: Listen... I just want to say thank you again, for everything.
target: 听着 我只想再次感谢你所做的一切

source: And you're humble too. Now that's a rare find!
target: 你也很谦卑,现在这真是难得的发现!

source: Saving people is what I do.
Is it really? Well then I'm sure glad you came along!
target: 是吗 那我很高兴你来了

source: You'll just have to owe me one.
target: 你只需要欠我一个人情

source: Oh, sure I guess that's fair. Not sure how you repay someone for something like this, but... We'll figure it out!
target: 哦,我猜这很公平,不知道你如何报答别人,但是...

source: Seeing as you're one of us now,  how would you like to help me hunt down some more of those ritual vessels?
target: 既然你现在是我们的一员了, 你想怎样帮我追寻一些那些仪式上的船?

source: That's great to hear! I think we make a pretty good team, don't you? Anyway, I'll be gathering some information on where the next vessel is hiding.
target: 很高兴听到,我想我们合作得很好,对吧?

source: Come find me at The Rampant Lioness on Tal-Senet in a couple of days. I'll wait for you there. See you soon.
target: 几天后到塔勒赛内特的狮子宫找我 我会在那边等你,再见

source: Yeah, your sister already asked me to.
target: 是的,你妹妹已经让我这么做了。

source: Oh... I guess I shouldn't be surprised. She's always worried about me. Anyway, I'll be gathering some information on where the next vessel is hiding.
target: 哦,我猜我不该惊讶 她总是担心我 无论如何,我会收集一些信息

source: If you're interested, come find me at The Rampant Lioness on Tal-Senet in a couple of days. I'll wait for you there. Hope to see you soon.
target: 如果你有兴趣,几天后来塔勒赛内特街的狮子街找我,我在那里等你,希望很快见到你。

source: Oh... Well, okay then. Suppose I can't force you to... Anyway, I'll be gathering some information on where the next vessel is hiding.
target: 好吧,好吧,如果我不能强迫你...

source: If you're interested, come find me at The Rampant Lioness on Tal-Senet in a couple of days. I'll wait for you there. Hope to see you soon.
target: 如果你有兴趣,几天后来塔勒赛内特街的狮子街找我,我在那里等你,希望很快见到你。

source: Saving people is what I do.
It's good to see you, friend. I was just about to head inside for a drink. Care to join me?
target: 很高兴见到你,朋友,我正要进去喝一杯,可以一起吗?

source: Sure, I could use a drink.
I'd prefer to stick to business.
It's good to see you, friend. I was just about to head inside for a drink. Care to join me?
target: 很高兴见到你,朋友,我正要进去喝一杯,可以一起吗?

source: Sure, I could use a drink... Lead the way.
Great. You'll love the atmosphere of this place. Follow me...
target: 好极了,你会喜欢这里的气氛的,跟我来...

source: Thanks for the offer... but I'd prefer to get on with the task at hand.
target: 谢谢你的提议... 但我更愿意继续完成手头的任务

source: Oh, of course of course... In that case, follow me and I'll show you what I've found so far.
target: 哦,当然了,那样的话,跟我来,我会告诉你我找到的

source: Lioness, two drinks for my friend and I...
target: 狮子座,两杯 我的朋友和我...

source: Amhak? It is you! And you're not... dead? Whatever am I saying, it’s good to see you again. What can I get you?
target: 阿姆哈克,是你,你没死,我说什么,很高兴能再见到你,需要什么?

source: Likewise, Damaris. You look well! Better than well, actually... I'll take a Lybossan Firewine, if you still have some.
target: 戴玛里斯,你看起来不错,我还要一杯莱博桑葡萄酒

source: You're in luck, sweetheart, I do have a little left... And for your friend?
target: 你走运了,亲爱的,我还有一点时间...

source: Alright, I'll fetch those drinks. Shan't be a moment.
target: 好吧,我去拿那些饮料,马上就好

source: ...not like it was anyone's fault... but afterwards the entire thing had to be rebuilt.
target: ...这不像是任何人的错... 但之后整个事情必须重建。

source: Every. Last. Stone. I heard the High Priestess was furious... Heh... Another drink?
Sure, I could go for another drink.
target: 当然,我可以去再喝一杯。

source: It's been fun, but... I think we should call it here.
target: 很有趣,但是... 我想我们应该叫这里。

source: You're probably right... Back to the task then. I'll show you what I've found so far, follow me...
target: 你可能是对的 回到任务中来 我会告诉你我到目前为止找到的 跟我来

source: ...but, it didn't actually happen though. I mean... it couldn't possibly...
target: 但是,它并没有发生,我的意思是,不可能...

source: What part of "true story" confuses you?
target: "真实的故事"的哪一部分让你困惑了?

source: How in the hells would that even fit?
It did look snug, but they slathered him up with Girin-Da oil first... and whilst we're on the topic of pleasurable liquids, another drink?
target: 看上去不错,但他们先把他和吉林达油打成一片... 而我们却在谈论愉快的液体, 再来一杯?

source: Good to see you again, friend.
target: 很高兴再次见到你,朋友。

source: What have you managed to find?
A couple of artefacts, they're over on the table. The glyphs on both are an older script that I can't read... maybe you'll have better luck?
target: 几件工艺品,放在桌子上 上面的格言是我看不懂的旧剧本,也许你运气会更好?

source: [Quest] It seems we're heading to Kab'Siron.
target: [腾讯]似乎我们要去卡布的西龙。

source: The scroll and the carving, both mention Kab'Siron... that's our only lead.
target: 卷轴和雕刻 都提到卡布·西龙 这是我们唯一的线索

source: Alright, that's a start at least. I'll mark it on your map and meet you there!
target: 好吧,这至少是一个开始,我会在地图上标注它,然后在那里等你!

source: What do you know of Kab'Siron?
target: 你对卡布·西龙了解多少?

source: Well, like plenty of Sabu it's a crumbling ruin of some sort. I think it's the burial site of a demigoddess, but I'm no scribe.
target: 就像很多萨布人一样 简直是一片破碎的废墟 我想那是神灵的埋葬地点 但我不是文士

source: Likely to be any nasty surprises in there?
target: 里面有什么令人讨厌的惊喜吗?

source: Can't say I'd be surprised if there were, but I've never set foot there myself. Why do you ask?
target: 不能说如果有,我会很惊讶,但我从未亲自踏过那里,你为什么问?

source: The text mentioned "She that weeps life"
target: 文中提到"她哭泣的生命"

source: The text mentions "She that weeps life". Do you know who that might be?
target: 短信提到"她哭泣的生命" 你知道那是谁吗?

source: Sounds like it could be Nethyra? The scribes I obtained the tablet from said she was, and I quote, "the demigoddess of falling water".
The night is still young, I could use another.
target: 晚上还年轻,我需要另一个。

source: As could I... Something stronger this time...
target: 我也可以... 这次更强壮的东西...

source: You're in luck... I know where Damaris keeps the good stuff...
target: 你运气好 我知道达玛里斯把好东西放哪了

source: ...once again she donned the frock, spread her lips and gobbled his cock...
target: ...她又把球踢开, 张开嘴唇,挖他的鸡巴...

source: You are a true poetess Nenu! This song... I should teach it to all the other blades...
target: 这首歌我该教给其他刀片

source: You should teach it to all the other blades!
Nevermind that for now, another drink!
To good times in warm company!
target: 在温暖的陪伴中,为美好时光干杯!

source: We should all sneak into the eternal orgy... can you imagine? Gods I wish I could go...
target: 我们都应该潜入永恒的狂欢...

source: I think you've all probably had enough...
target: 我想你们都已经喝够了...

source: Ahh! How dare you suggest I can't hold my drink... look I'm holding it right now.
target: 啊,你竟敢建议我喝不下...

source: I can attest to that! Now if you'll all stand still for a moment...
target: 我可以证明,现在如果你们都别动...

source: You're all so beautiful... we should drink to that... another round...
target: 你们都这么漂亮... 我们应该再喝一杯...

source: Bottoms up... just like Damaris! Ahahaha!
target: 干杯 就像达玛里斯一样!

source: Good to see you again... Lets... go easy on the Firewine next time.
I'm surprised to see you up and about. That poet girl drank you under the table!
target: 看到你醒过来我感到很惊讶 那个诗人把你喝在桌子下!

source: Good. Let's stick together... This place is amazing, isn't it? You know I think I even saw some aquedu- ohh look!
target: 好,让我们一起来,这地方很棒,不是吗?

source: Interesting... I haven't the slightest idea what these symbols mean... We should start bringing a scribe with us, don't you th- ahhh-!
target: 有趣的是,我不知道这些符号是什么意思...

source: Oh thank the Jackal you're alright! I saw the water coming up through the floor and feared the worst...
target: 哦,谢谢你的杰克,我看到水从地板上冲过来,最怕的是...

source: This is it... A ritual vessel containing the spirit of Nethyra...
target: 这是包含内希拉精神的祭器

source: ...Let my tears wash away the unworthy...
target: 让我的眼泪洗掉那些不值得...

source: Well, that was a close call, but we did it. We got the vessel! My sisters aren't going to believe it!
target: 差点打到,不过我们成功了,我们找到船了,我妹妹不会相信的!
雨,雨,雨,雨,雨,雨,雨,雨,雨,雨...

source: My anguish will wash you away!
Weep for the lost... Share my pain!
target: 哀伤失落者,分享我的痛苦!

source: The torrent is unrelenting... Without mercy...
.....Yeah..... Don't worry about me, now. I'll, erm... find my way out of here. Looks like there's a tunnel that leads... somewhere...
target: 别担心我 我会找到我离开这里的路 似乎有条隧道通向...

source: You be safe. I'll find my way to you, eventually...  I think...
target: 你会安全的,我会找到路的,最终...

source: You should take that Ritual Vessel back to my sisters, they'll know what to do with it. I'm gonna stay here, just for a little... catch my breath.
target: 你应该把那艘礼仪船带回我的姐妹们那里,他们会知道该怎么处理它。

source: I'll head back to Tal'Senet and see if I can find us another lead on a ritual vessel.... At this rate Anubis will be with us again in no time!
target: 我马上回塔勒赛内特 看看能不能在仪式船上再找到一条线索

source: To Anubis himself, for guiding our paths to this table!
target: 敬阿努比斯自己, 指引我们走向这个桌!

source: I didn't realise this was a toast to Damaris!
target: 我没想到这是为达玛里斯干杯!

source: Tight holes begging to be filled!
Let's drink to the warmth of a lovers bed!
To the warmth of a lover's bed!
May no rest ever be found there!
target: 愿在那里永远找不到休息!

source: There's no point in denying what we both want... let's fuck.
target: 否认我们两个想要的是没有意义的 让我们做爱吧

source: But I need to keep searching for the next... I h-haven't... Gods do I want you though...
target: 但我需要继续寻找下一个...

source: To be honest with you, right now I've nothing... Absolutely nothing. But I won't give up!
target: 老实说,现在我什么也没有,但我不会放弃的!

source: Maybe you could see if my sisters need something from you in the meantime?
target: 也许你可以看看 如果我的姐妹需要的东西 同时你?

source: We could go again... if you want to
target: 我们可以再去... 如果你想

source: I'm ready for more... if you're up for it
target: 我准备好了,如果你愿意的话

source: You're too good at that... fuck... ruined sex for me with anyone but you!
target: 你太擅长了... ... 他妈的... 毁了我的性爱 除了你!

source: That was great... I don't think sex with anyone else has even come close!
target: 那太好了 我觉得和别人做爱都没来得及

source: By the Jackal, impale me already...
What are you waiting for? Stretch me open!
target: 你还在等什么 把我拉开
被阿努比斯... 他妈的你硬了!

source: I need to be inside you...
By the Jackal, ride me already...
What are you waiting for? Slide onto me!

target: 阿努比斯... 你他妈的很紧!

source: You might want to sit down for this. I wasn't, and I hit my head pretty hard when I got the news, heh-.
target: 你也许想坐下来,我可没有, 我听到消息时头撞得很厉害,嘿...

source: The High Priestess herself has personally invited us to come see her at the Temple of Anubis!
target: 大祭司本人亲自邀请我们到阿努比斯圣殿去看她!

source: Yeah! You, me, and Amansi. Astari is going to be so furious when she finds out she wasn't included...
target: 你,我,还有阿曼西,阿斯塔里会很生气的,当她发现自己没有被包括进来时...

source: Anyway, Amansi and I are going to head there right away now that you've been told. We'll meet you there, okay?
target: 总之,我和阿曼西马上去那儿,我们在那里碰头,好吗?

source: I heard about what happened at the ruins. You did the Path proud, my friend. I just wish I could have been there with you.
target: 我听说了废墟上发生的事,你为道路骄傲,我的朋友,我只希望我能和你在一起。

source: Yeah... Oh well! Things are looking up for us, though. You're never going to believe it.
target: 是的,但事情在寻找我们,你绝对不会相信的

source: [Quest]Did you have something to tell me?
There you are, friend. I've been looking for you!
target: 朋友,你来了,我一直在找你!

source: Well, I guess this is goodbye...
C'mere. Don't fret, we'll... save a spot for you.
target: 别担心,我们会为你留个位置的

source: I know this is the will of Anubis and all, but... why does it feel so hard?
target: 我知道这是阿努比斯的遗嘱 但是... 为什么感觉这么难?

source: Pfft- hah, that's the spirit! Alright my friend, let's not drag this out any longer than we have to. Until next we meet, hmm?
target: 好了,我的朋友,我们不要拖拖拖拉拉,直到下次见面为止
在那之前 再见,阿曼西...

source: I heard about what happened at the ruins. You did the Path proud, my friend. I just wish I could have been there with you.
target: 我听说了废墟上发生的事,你为道路骄傲,我的朋友,我只希望我能和你在一起。

source: Did you have something to tell me?
You might want to sit down for this. I wasn't, and I hit my head pretty hard when I got the news, heh-.
target: 你也许想坐下来,我可没有, 我听到消息时头撞得很厉害,嘿...

source: The High Priestess herself has personally invited us to come see her at the Temple of Anubis!
target: 大祭司本人亲自邀请我们到阿努比斯圣殿去看她!

source: Yeah! You, me, and Amansi. Astari is going to be so furious when she finds out she wasn't included...
target: 你,我,还有阿曼西,阿斯塔里会很生气的,当她发现自己没有被包括进来时...

source: Anyway, Amansi and I are going to head there right away now that you've been told. We'll meet you there, okay?
target: 总之,我和阿曼西马上去那儿,我们在那里碰头,好吗?

source: Yeah... Oh well! Things are looking up for us, though. You're never going to believe it.
target: 是的,但事情在寻找我们,你绝对不会相信的

source: [Quest]Did you have something to tell me?
Hail traveller. Might you aid an old man?
target: 旅行者万岁,你能帮个老家伙吗?

source: Is there not a soul who can give me what I need?
target: 难道没有一个灵魂能给我我想要的东西吗?

source: So many dead... Dying shouldn't be this hard...
target: 死了这么多人 死也不应该这么难

source: No proud warriors left in all of Sabu... I am doomed.
target: 萨布没有光荣的战士了 我死定了

source: You fight with skill. I hope it is enough.
target: 你精明地战斗 我希望这足够了
最后,一个值得尊敬的对手!

source: You're holding back, aren't you? Don't!
Impeccable footwork! You'd make a fine Blade!
target: 脚手不差,你会做一个很好的刀锋!

source: Today, is a good day to die!
Thank you for stopping to speak with me, traveller.
target: 谢谢你停下来跟我说话 旅行者

source: I am an old man... and have seen enough for many lifetimes. All that remains for me is a death worthy of The Path.
The Path. It means something different to each of us. For me, it is the call of the warrior.
target: 路,我们每个人都不一样,对我来说,这是战士的号召。

source: The end of my journey must come at the edge of a worthy opponent's blade, with a weapon in my hand.
target: 我旅程的结束必须来到一个值得尊敬的对手的刀刃的边缘,手里拿着武器.

source: So... You want to die? Are you asking me to kill you?
I am asking that you grant me one final fight. An honourable duel to the death.
target: 我请求你给我最后一次决斗 一场光荣的决斗

source: That's a big thing to ask of a complete stranger. I'll erm... I'll think about it?
target: 问一个完全陌生的人是件大事 我会考虑的?

source: I'm curious about you... Can you tell me about yourself?
target: 我很好奇,你能告诉我自己吗?

source: There isn't much to tell. I'm a simple man who has lived a lifetime of bloodshed and war.
target: 没有什么好说的,我是一个简单的人,一生都在流血和战争中度过.

source: I spent most of my life as a soldier--A warrior of The Path, known as a Blade of Anubis.
target: 我花了我的大部分时间 作为一个战士 - 一个战士的路径, 被称为阿努比斯的刀。

source: My original band of brothers and sisters, though, now rest in the halls of Keth-Eros, have fallen in battle or been claimed by old age.
target: 虽然我最初的兄弟姐妹乐队,现在在凯斯-埃罗斯的大厅休息,已经陷入战火或被老人所宣称.

source: I am the last of my kind... Forced to witness the end of a glorious era giving way to corruption and weakness.
target: 被迫目睹一个光荣时代的结束 以腐败和软弱为代价

source: Okay, I'll do it... I'll fight you.
target: 好吧,我会的,我会跟你打的

source: Very well. May the victor carry honour in life, and the fallen carry honour into the halls of the dead.
target: 很好,愿胜利者在生命中带着荣誉,而堕落者将荣誉带入死者的大厅.

source: I'm sorry, this is just suicide. I won't help you do this.
target: 对不起,这只是自杀,我不会帮你的

source: I understand. It is likely you would die in the process, anyway.
target: 我明白,但你很可能在这过程中会死

source: What's so wrong with growing old and dying in your sleep? I don't get it.
target: 长老在睡梦中死去有什么不对?

source: It is my choice. I don't expect you to understand.
target: 这是我的选择 我不指望你能理解

source: Sorry, I need some time to think about this...
target: 对不起,我需要一些时间来考虑...
我理解... 说吧 I understand...
需要什么? 需要什么吗?

source: I won't help you kill yourself.
Why does it have to be this way?
I just need to rest a while.
target: 我只是需要休息一会儿

source: Don't worry, I'll get you out of this.
target: 别担心,我会救你出去的

source: Ahhoooh...Huh! Where am I? What is... t-thank you stranger... I was hooked up to this thing for s-so long... my mind...
target: 啊,我在哪里,什么是T -谢谢陌生人,我和这个家伙在一起太久了...

source: How are... how are you here? How did you f-find me?
target: 你怎么样 你怎么找到我的

source: Medjai asked me to find out why you left, which led me here.
target: 梅德杰让我查你为什么离开, 让我来到这里。

source: I'm glad... glad someone cared enough to come looking... please, I have one more favour to ask of you.
target: 我很高兴... 很高兴有人足够关心 来找... 请,我还有一件事要求你。

source: Don't tell anyone about... all this. I have already suffered enough humiliation to last a lifetime. Do not add to it.
target: 不要告诉任何人这一切,我已经承受了 足够一辈子的耻辱,别添麻烦

source: Very well. It'll be our secret.
Thank you. I have little to offer.... please, take what you want of my belongings. Sekerti kept them in a chest over there.
target: 谢谢,我没什么好说的 请拿走你想要的东西 Sekerti把它们藏在那边的箱子里

source: They deserve to know the truth.
Have I not suffered enough? Word will spread. Everyone will know it was my seed they craved...
You have saved me from one torture only to deliver me into another. Once recovered I'll head back to town... to my walk of shame.
target: 你把我从一次折磨中解救出来 只是为了把我送进另一次折磨中

source: Medjai asked me to find out why you left, which led me here.
target: 梅德杰让我查你为什么离开, 让我来到这里。

source: Very well. It'll be our secret.
They deserve to know the truth.
Sorry, erm... we're not looking to buy anything.
target: 对不起,呃... 我们不打算买任何东西。

source: Hey, uh what are you doing?
target: 嘿,呃,你在做什么? 怎么样?

source: Mmh- this is so much better than living in that dreary cave.
target: 嗯... 这比住在那个沉闷的洞穴里好得多

source: Gods am I lucky to have such a sexy owner...
target: 上帝,我幸运有一个这么性感的主人...

source: Hey! What the fuck is this? What did you do to me? Let me out of this cage!
target: 嘿,这是什么,你对我做了什么?

source: My new home? You can fuck right off with that! I'm not staying here! Who do you think you are?
target: 我的新家,你可以马上滚蛋,我不会呆在这里的,你以为你是谁?

source: I'm the one who rightfully captured you... Your new owner.
target: 我才是抓住你的人 你的新主人

source: Well... you may not think so now, but you'll be glad this happened... eventually.... I think... Just give it some time.
target: 你现在可能不这么认为 但你会很高兴的 最终...

source: What? Hey, no! I didn't agree to this! Let me out of here!
target: 嘿,不,我不同意,让我出去!

source: What the fuck is this place? Get me out of here!
target: 这他妈是什么地方 把我弄出去

source: Can't you hear me? I can't stay here, please!
You bastards are all sick! Sticking me in a cage and forcing me to watch people fuck all day and all night...
What's a girl gotta do to get some cock around here anyway? Wait, what the fuck am I even saying? Sun must be getting to me...
target: 一个女孩必须做什么 才能在这里得到一些鸡巴?

source: All these sexy people... at least my eyes have something to do...
target: 所有这些性感的人... 至少我的眼睛有事情要做...

source: It's so... hot in this cage...

target: 呃... 我的阴部湿透了...

source: Please... just let me out. I won't go anywhere, I promise! I just need to fuck s-someone- anyone...
target: 请放我出去 我保证我哪儿也不去

source: Of course! Do you submit to me?
Mmmh- finally I can serve you! You know you could have let me out sooner...
target: 我终于能为你服务了 你知道你本可以让我早点出来...

source: You belong to me now. That's all that matters.
target: 你现在属于我了 这才是最重要的

source: What? You're selling me? You can't do this!
target: 什么 你要出卖我 你不能这么做

source: Don't worry, I'm sure wherever you're going next will be just fine.
target: 别担心,我敢肯定,无论你要去哪里 下一个会只是罚款。

source: You're a prick, you know that?
Oh please tell me you've come to fuck me...
target: 哦,请告诉我你是来操我的...

source: I have. You know what to do, slave.
target: 是的 你知道该怎么做 奴隶

source: I need you to play some music for that woman over there. I'll take you to her.
target: 我要你为那边那个女人演奏一些音乐 我带你去见她

source: No need. I'm pretty sure I know exactly who you're talking about. But hold on, I don't play for free...
target: 不需要,我确定我很清楚你在说什么 但等一下,我不免费玩...

source: Where did you learn to play music?
Oh, uh, huh... Most people don't bother to ask. I travelled with the Celestial Sands Ensemble as a matter of fact.
target: 大部分人不用问,我其实是跟天沙星座一起旅行的

source: I learned under the legendary Sepi. Probably the most memorable years of my life...
target: 我在传说中的赛皮下学的 可能是我一生中最难忘的几年...

source: It'll cost ten gold per song.
Perfect. I'll go tend to Nisu's ears then...
target: 好极了,我去照顾下尼苏的耳朵...

source: I... Don't have any gold on me. I'm not even the one who wants the music. Can't you do this one as a favour?
target: 我身上没有金子,我连音乐都不想要,你就不能帮个忙吗?

source: *sigh* Fine... They do say you can't put a price on music. I'll tend to Nisu's ears for you... just this once mind!
target: 好吧,他们说你无法为音乐付出代价 我会照顾妮苏的耳朵...

source: I... Don't have any gold on me. I'm not even the one who wants the music. Can't you do this one as a favour?
target: 我身上没有金子,我连音乐都不想要,你就不能帮个忙吗?

source: *sigh* Fine... They do say you can't put a price on music. I'll tend to Nisu's ears for you... just this once mind!
target: 好吧,他们说你无法为音乐付出代价 我会照顾妮苏的耳朵...

source: [Quest]I need you to play some music.
target: 我需要你演奏一些音乐。

source: Where did you learn to play?
Hold it! How did you get in here?
target: 等等 你怎么进来的?

source: I found a gap in the wall... it was a bit of a squeeze but I popped right in.
target: 我发现墙上有个缺口... 有点挤,但我直接插进去了

source: Damnit all... Another hole in our defenses that thing can exploit...
target: 可恶,我们防御系统又一个洞

source: Wait... what thing? What's out there?
target: 等等 什么东西 外面有什么

source: I don't know... Look around you. We are beset by death itself...
target: 看看你周围 我们被死亡本身困扰着

source: If you care at all for your own life, you'll leave the way you came.
target: 如果你关心自己的生活, 你会离开你的方式。

source: I suppose I should thank you for pointing it out.
target: 我想我应该感谢你指出这一点。

source: Watch yourself. That which hunts us may return at any moment.
target: 小心,猎杀我们的东西随时可能回来

source: We await whatever fate The Jackal has in store for us. Victory or death.
target: 我们等待着杰克对我们的命运 胜利或死亡

source: This may be the last I see of you for a while. Safe journey, Asim.
target: 这是我最后一次见到你,一路平安,阿西姆

source: You are to part ways with us then? May the Jackal guide your steps.
target: 那你要和我们分道扬镳?

source: Should you find yourself in Wased-Heq, seek me out. I shall make good on my debt.
target: 如果你发现自己在Washed -Heq, 找我,我会还清我的债务。

source: You are a fool to fight me!
You will pay dearly for that!
target: 你会为此付出高昂代价的!

source: You'll have to try harder than that to defeat me!
target: 你一定要更努力地打败我!

source: I overheard some of your conversation with my priestess. Forgive her tone, much rests upon her shoulders.
target: 我无意中听到你跟我的女祭司谈话 请原谅她的语气 她的肩膀上有很多东西

source: I am Asim, Captain of the Blades of Anubis. I lead the warriors here in the defense of our priestess and her relic.
target: 我是阿西姆,阿努比斯的刀锋队长 我带领战士们在这里保护我们的女祭司和她的遗物

source: What exactly happened? How did you end up like this?
target: 到底发生了什么 你怎么变成这样

source: We wrecked, not far from here. Before we had a chance to regroup we were set upon.
target: 我们在这里不远处就被撞倒了 在我们有机会重新集结之前

source: I didn't get a good look at the thing, but it moved with unnatural speed.
target: 我没有得到一个很好的看 东西,但它移动 以非自然的速度。

source: Many fell in the chaos that ensued... I scarcely landed a blow against it before it vanished into the night.
target: 许多人陷入了混乱之中...

source: Now we must ready ourselves for its return. It means to finish us off before we learn its weakness...
target: 现在我们必须做好返回的准备,这意味着在我们发现它的弱点之前就把我们消灭......

source: How can you be so certain?
It is what I would do.
What will you do now, what choices do you have?
target: 你现在要做什么,你有什么选择?

source: I see only two options before us. Stand and fight, or escape this place before the thing finds us...
target: 我看见我们面前只有两个选择 站起来战斗,或者趁发现我们之前逃离这个地方...

source: The wilds are full of dangers, stay true to The Path.
target: 野兽充满危险,要忠于"道路".

source: Captain... of what army? There are more dead warriors around here than living ones.
I will not stand here and be insulted by one such as you. It is thanks to me that any of us are still alive.
target: 我不会站在这里受到你这样的人的侮辱,因为有我,我们中任何人都还活着。

source: Rescuing so many wounded whilst fighting that creature... your warriors are lucky to have you.
target: 在与那怪物战斗时救出这么多伤员 你的战士们很幸运能有你

source: If only I were faster... stronger... so many need not have died...
target: 如果我更快... 更强壮... 这么多人不必死...

source: ..my Priestess would not be burdened so...
The Priestess mentioned boats, that you needed some as a means of escape?
target: 牧师提到船, 你需要一些作为逃跑的手段?

source: Yes, travelers and fishermen often moor boats along the coast...
target: 是的,旅行者和渔民经常在海岸边拖拖拖拉拉的船...

source: I sent scouts but they did not return. I fear the worst and I cannot spare any more blades...
target: 我派了侦察兵,但他们没回来 我最怕的是,我不能再留下刀片...

source: If we were to find some boats, we could leave this place... my priestess could complete her sacred task.
target: 如果我们找到一些船 我们可以离开这个地方 我的女祭司可以完成她的神圣任务

source: The Priestess said you are without proper arms with which to fight this thing?
target: 牧师说你没有合适的武器来对付这个?

source: Indeed, we have little in the way of arms at present.
target: 事实上,我们目前几乎没有武器。

source: Our weapons were lost in the wreckage of our ship, no doubt they're scattered along the riverbank by now.
target: 我们的武器在舰船残骸中丢失了,毫无疑问现在它们已经散落在河岸一带.

source: We need those swords... spears.... and some means to bind our wounds. Then we shall make our stand...
Let the hunter come... let him become the hunted. Let him find the bared fangs of the Jackal that await him here...
target: 让猎人来,让他成为猎人 让他找到在这里等着他的恶棍的尖牙

source: I'm just one person... why can't you seek these things yourselves?
target: 我只是一个人... 为什么你不能自己去寻找这些东西?

source: We are too few already... If I further diminish our force here then our fate is certain.
target: 已经太少了 如果我进一步减少我们的力量 那么我们的命运是肯定的

source: Besides, if we are to die here then I prefer to fall side by side with my warriors.
target: 而且,如果我们要死在这里,那我宁愿和我的战士们并肩作战。

source: Judging by the look in your eye, I'd wager you have some good news.
target: 从你眼睛的表情来看 我敢打赌你一定有一些好消息

source: I managed to find some boats you could use.
target: 我找到一些你能用的船只

source: Excellent news, where are they located?
They're moored by a jetty, not far along the coast. You should be able to see them from the summit.
target: 他们停泊在海边的海堤上 你应该能从山顶上看到他们

source: Well done friend, we will get the wounded on their feet and ready ourselves to move.
target: 做得很好,我们会让伤者站起来 准备行动

source: My warriors and I owe you a debt of gratitude. If ever you find yourself in Wased-Heq, seek me out.
target: 我的战士们和我欠你们一份感激之情 如果你发现自己在Washed-Heq,就来找我吧

source: The weapons were near the wreck, I have them here.
target: 武器就在沉船附近 我这里有

source: So you have! You owed us nothing, yet chose to help us in our time of need. You are honorable beyond measure, friend.
target: 你欠我们什么,却选择在我们有需要的时候帮助我们,你实在是光荣无比,朋友。

source: I have nothing to give you in return but my thanks, and to owe you a debt of gratitude.
target: 我除了感谢外,没什么可以回报你的,我欠你一个感激之情。

source: If ever you find yourself in Wased-Heq, seek me out.
target: 如果你发现自己在Washed -Heq, 找我出来。

source: Your warriors are safe, the beast is dead.
target: 你的战士安全了,野兽死了

source: You slew the creature... alone? Impossible!
target: 你一个人杀了这个生物?

source: Take a look, I have the thing's head...
I can't believe it... You must have the blood of The Jackal himself in your veins!
target: 难以置信,你的血管里一定有杰克的血!

source: I don't know about that... It was a tough opponent. It could've gone either way.
target: 我不知道 对手很强壮 也有可能是那样的

source: My warriors and I owe you a debt of gratitude. If ever you find yourself in Wased-Heq, seek me out.
target: 我的战士们和我欠你们一份感激之情 如果你发现自己在Washed-Heq,就来找我吧

source: You led many to their deaths.
You saved the lives of these warriors.
Why not get the things you need yourselves?
target: 为什么不拿回你们自己需要的东西?

source: I found some boats you could use.
target: 我找到一些你可以用的船了 我找到一些你用过的船了

source: The time for an offering to The Jackal is upon us!
He calls to me... Calls for me to honour him...
target: 他打电话给我,要我尊重他...

source: Blessed are those who submit to the will of The Path.
You have witnessed what gifts are bestowed upon those who walk The Path.
target: 你们确已见证了给行走者所赐予他们的恩典。

source: Sorry, I couldn't find the incense- Oh...
Not to worry, we can perform the ritual without it. Now... Bend over and offer yourself to me. The Fifth Step is upon us.
target: 不用担心,我们没有它就可以进行仪式 现在,弯腰,向我献身,第五步就要到了

source: Do not tarry... The sacred oils will not last forever.
target: 不要拖延,神圣的油不会永远存在

source: Do you not wish to please The Jackal?
This tight hole! mmmnh- Such a precious offering!
target: 这么紧的洞 多么珍贵的祭品

source: So eager... I... I'm- mmh- not going to last much longer!
Mmmh- of all of the rituals... this is my favourite...
target: 嗯... 在所有的仪式中... 这是我最喜欢的...

source: Yes... take me into you... It is the will of The Jackal...
target: 是的,带我进去,这是杰克的旨意

source: The ritual usually goes... better than this...
target: 仪式通常... 比这个好...

source: Prepare to be filled with his gift- hnnnnngh-!
target: 准备装满他的礼物... ... Hnnnnh!

source: Come, offer yourself to me again.
Have you come to tread The Path with me?
target: 你是来和我一起走"道路"的吗?

source: The Jackal will be most pleased with our offering.
I am but a humble servant of The Jackal who seeks pleasu- I mean seeks to please him, of course.
target: 我不过是一个卑微的仆人 寻找求情的杰克 当然,我是说寻求取悦他

source: Before we begin, there are some items needed for the ritual to take place properly.
target: 在我们开始之前,有些物品需要,以便仪式能够正常进行。
需要什么? 需要什么吗?

source: Firstly, I need The Sacred Oils of Preparation. You may find them near here, usually close at hand for use by the priestesses...
target: 首先,我需要《准备的圣油》,你们可以在附近找到它们,通常近在眼前,供女祭司们使用。

source: What kind of ritual is this going to be?
Ah, a curious mind, I see. We prepare for "The Ritual of the Fifth Step". There are many steps upon The Path, and this is one of them.
target: 啊,一个好奇的头脑,我明白了,我们准备了"第五步的礼仪",在路径上有许多步骤,这是其中之一。

source: I have the oils you asked for.
Perfect. I'll take that off your hands, and then send you on your way to find the next item we need.
target: 好极了,我把你的手拿掉 然后送你去寻找我们需要的下一件东西

source: We will also need a Sacred Rug of Repose...
target: 我们还需要一只雷波斯的圣鲁格...

source: I'm on it... I'll find this rug.
Oh, you will be... I mean, erm, yes good good, very good. I await your return with great eagerness.
target: 哦,你会的,嗯,是的,很好,非常好,我非常渴望地等待你的回来。

source: Are all of these items I'm gathering for you really... sacred?
target: 我为你们收集的这些东西真的... 神圣吗?

source: Of course they are... Though, they are only sacred for those who faithfully walk The Path.
target: 当然,虽然,他们只是 神圣的,那些忠实的走道的人。

source: One who does not follow The Jackal could never truly benefit from the mysteries surrounding the sacred items, nor the rituals they are used in.
target: 不跟随"杰克尔"的人 永远无法真正受益于围绕圣物的神秘 以及它们被用于的仪式

source: I found the rug you need.
target: 我找到你们需要的地毯了

source: Good work. We are so close now to beginning the ritual... All that remains is the Sacred Incense of Insight.
target: 我们快开始了仪式了 剩下的就是神的洞察力

source: There should be some incense around here somewhere. Sacred incense... it's probably near wherever you found the oils.
target: 附近应该有香料 圣香...

source: Okay, I'll find the incense for your ritual.
target: 好吧,我会找到香 为你仪式。

source: Our ritual, my friend. Our. We will share in the glorious rites of Anubis, together...
target: 我们的仪式,朋友 我们一起参加阿努比斯的光荣仪式...

source: Are you a priest of Anubis?
target: 你是阿努比斯的牧师吗?

source: Keth-Eros, no... No, I am no priest...  b-but all who tread The Path may partake in such... rituals.
target: Keth Eros 我不是牧师 但是所有走上"道路"的人 都会参加这种仪式

source: I only honour him... will you join me or would you spit on the path I- ...err, Anubis, has laid for you?
target: 我只是敬重他... 你会加入我吗? 还是你会吐口水...

source: What kind of ritual is this?
Renshet sent me to ask about the missing shipment.
target: 任谢特派我来问失踪的货.

source: I could certainly use the help searching for it. The shipment was supposed to be coming into town from the main road.
target: 我肯定需要帮忙找找,这批货应该是从主要公路运来的。

source: If you follow the path out of the village you should find it... what remains of it at least.
target: 如果你走出村子的路 你应该找到它... 至少剩下的部分。

source: The courier for the shipment was a female felian, grey fur.
target: 运送货的快递员是一只雌性羽毛灰毛。

source: I'll see what I can find
Both Renshet and I appreciate it.
I found this note in the shipment salvage.
target: 我在运货时找到这个纸条

source: A note? I don't know anything about that, I just help out with heavy lifting. You'll need to ask Renshet I'm afraid.
target: 我什么都不知道,我只管举重,你需要问任雪,我怕

source: I found this amulet on one of the raiding bandits.
target: 我在突袭的匪徒中找到这个护身符

source: I've seen something like this before... might be from one of the bandit clans in the area.
target: 我之前见过类似的东西... 可能是来自这个区域的一个土匪部落

source: Helps work out who was friend or foe after a fight, keep track of the dead. Bandits often carry something marked with the clan's sigil.
target: 帮助查清打斗后谁是朋友或敌人,追踪死者,匪徒们经常携带带有氏族锡吉尔标志的东西.

source: I don't recognise this particular symbol though. Try asking the overseer.
target: 我不认识这个符号 问问监工

source: Renshet will certainly want to hear about this. Can you go and tell them for me. I'm in the middle of something at the moment.
target: 任谢肯定想听听这个,你能帮我告诉他们吗,我现在正忙着呢

source: I found a hidden compartment of Khoomah here...
target: 我在这里发现了一个隐藏的 霍马的隔间...

source: I have no idea what you're talking about... It must just be some addicts stash or something. Show me, I'll dispose of it for you.
target: 我不懂你在说什么 一定是一些瘾君子的藏品

source: Time to rethink your answer about the Khoomah.
target: 是时候重新考虑你对霍玛的回答了

source: Hey now! No reason to be like that.. I can't... ah... okay, okay! I do know a little, alright?
target: 嘿,现在,我没有理由这样 我不能...

source: Every shipment we get from the supplier has a compartment with hidden jars of Khoomah.
target: 我们从供应商那里得到的每批货 都有藏着胡马罐子的隔间

source: No idea who puts them in there or where they come from. Renshet doesn't even know they are in the shipments.
target: 也不知道是谁放的 也不知道他们从哪里来 任舍不知道他们在运货里

source: I just take them out of the crate, distribute them to the dealers, then send back the coin in the same compartment.
target: 我只是把它们从箱子里拿出来, 分发给经销商, 然后把硬币送回同一舱。

source: You're sure you don't know where they come from?
target: 你确定你不知道他们从哪里来?

source: Positive. Whoever is making this stuff is getting filthy rich off of it.
target: 肯定的,谁做这些东西 越来越脏 从它。

source: They aren't going to risk that by revealing themselves to someone like me.
target: 他们不会冒这个险 把我这样的人暴露出来

source: If you can figure out exactly where that missing shipment was coming from, then you can probably see who's packing the jars.
target: 如果你能确切地找出 丢失的货是从哪里来的, 那么你可能可以看到是谁包装的罐子。

source: Renshet sent me to ask about the missing shipment.
target: 任谢特派我来问失踪的货.

source: I found this note in the shipment salvage.
target: 我在运货时找到这个纸条

source: I found this amulet on one of the raiding bandits.
target: 我在突袭的匪徒中找到这个护身符

source: I found a hidden compartment of Khoomah here...
target: 我在这里发现了一个隐藏的 霍马的隔间...

source: [Intimidate] Time to rethink your answer about the Khoomah.
target: 是时候重新思考你对霍玛的回答了

source: The only true will, is the will of The Jackal.
target: 唯一真正的意志是"杰克"的意志.

source: So... I think you're the sister of Amhak's that wants to speak with me?
target: 所以,我想你是阿姆哈克的妹妹 谁想和我说话?

source: Yes, I am. And please, forgive any confusion. Having an identical twin is not without its downsides. You may call me Astari.
target: 是的,请原谅我的困惑 拥有一个相同的双胞胎不是没有它的缺点 你可以叫我阿斯塔里

source: What did you want to speak with me about?
I simply wish to thank you for bringing my brother back alive. He told me what you did, and was quite eager for me to give you the proper recognition.
target: 我只想感谢你把我哥哥活着带回来 他告诉我你做了什么,而且非常渴望我给予你应有的承认。

source: You're not... exactly like your sister, are you?
Hah... No, I am not. Though her... demeanour has its uses in furthering the goals of The Path...
How... Refreshing. To find such an honourable spirit is rare indeed.
target: 多么的新鲜,找到这么光荣的精神是罕见的。

source: I'm curious... What happened to the ritual vessel we found?
target: 我很好奇 我们发现的祭祀器呢?

source: Worry not. It has been sent away so it may be put to good use. Every artefact we uncover carries us one step closer to the return of The Jackal.
target: 不要担心,它已经送走了,这样它就可以被很好地使用。我们发现的每一个动脉都带给我们一个更接近"猎豹"回归的一步。

source: I could have died, you know?
Yes, I'm aware. But you didn't, did you? A sign you were guided by The Path in your efforts.
target: 是的,我知道,但你没有吗?

source: I have something to ask of you.
I am sending my brother to hunt down more of these vessels, as apparently we have been wasting what talent he has keeping him here.
target: 我派我弟弟去猎杀更多的这些船只,因为显然我们一直在浪费他留下的天赋。

source: You are to go with him. He's clever and resourceful on his own, but lacks a certain amount of... well... let's just say, wisdom.
target: 你跟他去,他很聪明,很聪明,很聪明,但是...

source: I have faith that, together, the two of you will succeed in doing that which pleases The Jackal...
target: 我相信,你们两个会一起 成功完成《恶棍》的喜事...

source: Oh, before I forget, I want you to have this. It is a symbol carried by those who follow The Jackal. I officially welcome you to his family.
target: 哦,在我忘记之前,我要你拿着这个 这是那些跟随《杰克》的人携带的符号,我正式欢迎你来到他的家人

source: Ah, speaking of family... it looks like my brother is eager to talk with you. Goodbye for now. May you never stray from The Path.
target: 说到家人 看来我哥哥很想和你谈谈 暂时再见 愿你永远不要偏离道路

source: [Quest] What did you want to talk about?
You're not... exactly like your sister, are you?
What happened to the ritual vessel?
I could have died, you know?
What a fascinating mind... and quite the eventful path you've had... leading you here... to me.
target: 多么迷人的头脑... 和你所走过的多麼多事的路... 把你带到这里...

source: Indeed. Not quite in the flesh, but not far off. I see you've become well acquainted with my servant Mered.
target: 确实,不是肉中,但离我们不远,我看你已经熟知我的仆人Mered了.

source: Sorry, I draw the line at talking literature.
target: 抱歉,我讲文学时会讲到句子

source: You may find the flesh can be... stubborn. Sometimes you can't quite bring yourself to walk away...

target: 所以,你是一个... 书,现在?

source: Of course not. I am the immortal spirit of an ascendant Demigod. I am The Shadow Reborn.
target: 当然不是,我是一个长者德米戈德的不朽精神,我是影子重生者。
也许是在纸背上重生的

source: Reborn as the heir of Uket. I live in this vessel for now, though soon I shall reclaim my body... and my birthright...
target: 我暂时住在这个容器里 虽然很快我就会收回我的身体 和我的出生权利

source: How did you end up trapped in a book, then?
target: 那你怎么被困在书里了?

source: I am not trapped. I fragmented my soul, binding part of it to this tome enabled me to survive the cat-god's purge.
target: 我没有被困,我把灵魂割裂了, 将部分灵魂绑在这个玩具上,让我得以在猫神的清洗中生存下来。

source: I recall reading of a similar attempt to cheat death...
target: 我还记得有一次类似的 企图欺骗死亡...

source: I doubt that very much. Few could match my cunning, surviving when so many fell...
target: 我非常怀疑 很少有人能和我的狡猾相配 当这么多人摔倒时...

source: No, I'm sure of it... I remember now, it was the story of Harry Pot-
target: 不,我肯定,我记得,这是哈利・波特的故事...

source: Don't you say it... don't you fucking say it!
target: 别这么说... 别他妈说!

source: Why are you killing these people?
Mered told you nothing but the truth. They are already dead, their souls belong to me... the foundation of my grand design.
target: Mered只告诉你真相 他们已经死了 他们的灵魂属于我...

source: The rest is merely disposing of... unwanted scraps.
target: 其余的只是处理... 不需要的废品

source: There is no other reason. I require their souls and therefore their deaths. My desire is that of a Demigod... their deaths are certain.
target: 没有别的理由,我需要他们的灵魂,所以他们死了,我的愿望是...

source: So they are dying, meaning they were alive!
target: 所以他们就要死了,意味着他们还活着!

source: My desire is as inevitable as the tide. Their lives will be washed away like grains of sand... a matter of when, not if.
target: 我的愿望和潮流一样不可避免 他们的生命会像沙粒一样被冲走...

source: They are already dead. Thinking otherwise will only make your task more difficult...
target: 他们已经死了 否则只会让你的任务更困难...

source: What is it you want me to do?
You're still here... something the matter?
target: 你还在这里... 出什么事了?

source: Because I do not allow it. You cannot not so easily subvert the will of an ascendant Demigod...
target: 你不能轻易地破坏 登基的德米戈德...

source: You're a book, you can't stop me walking out of here!
target: 你是一本书,你不能阻止我离开这里!

source: Legs still not obeying your command? Perhaps you should listen to my request...
You can't make me listen to you...
Consciously? Perhaps not. Though you may find my will hard to overrule...
target: 可能不会 虽然你可能觉得我的意志难以推翻...

source: Fine. I'll listen, if you'll release me.
target: 好吧,我听着,如果你能放我走

source: I will release you now. You may ask any questions you have, come and go as you wish...
target: 我现在就放你走 你可以问任何问题,随便你...

source: For you know my power... you know that disobedience is... unwise.
target: 因为你知道我的力量... 你知道不服从是不明智的。

source: I require you to finish the preparation of my great works... I require you to deliver a soul to me... that I may rise...
target: 我要你完成我伟大作品的准备...

source: I won't be a part of this. Find someone else.
target: 我不会参与的 找别人

source: I warned you before, the will of an ascendant Demigod is no easy thing to deny...
target: 我警告过你 一个登基的德米戈德的意愿 很难否认...

source: What do you want from me?
target: 你想从我这里得到什么?

source: One more is all it takes. Read the name from my pages, wield the knife... I will guide the blade to the threads that bind their soul...
target: 再读一遍我书页上的名字,拿刀...

source: I... haven't ever heard this name before, but... I know it, somehow. The scribe... It belongs to her, doesn't it?
target: 我从未听说过这个名字,但我知道,不知怎的,文士是她的,不是吗?

source: There is power in a name, through my power you see the face of its owner... how else did you think I directed Mered
target: 一种名义上的力量,通过我的力量,你看到它主人的脸... 你还认为我是如何指导Mered的

source: This is a glimmer of recognition, nothing more... she thinks fondly of you... hopes to see you again... she will suspect nothing.
target: 这是一线承认,没有更多的... 她很喜欢你... 希望再见到你... 她不会怀疑任何事。

source: Take this knife, no other blade can sever the threads which bind a soul.  Kill her... that I may feast!
target: 拿着这把刀,没有其他刀刃能切断束缚灵魂的线条,杀了她...

source: What do I get out of this?
I shall grant you a great rank and status in my court... as befits a loyal servant. A Demigod can be a powerful ally...
target: 我将授予你一个非常高的官阶和地位...

source: I will kill the scribe, if I must.
target: 如果有必要,我会杀了文士

source: You truly are a worthy servant of The Shadow Reborn.
target: 你真的是"影子重生"的忠实仆人

source: Return when it is done... when blood is spilled and I am freed of my bonds...
target: 当它完成... 当血流成河,我解脱了束缚...

source: Are you insane? I'm not murdering her!
Think carefully before refusing me mortal. I will give you time to decide, return when you have an answer...
target: 在拒绝我之前仔细考虑 我会给你时间做决定 当你有答案时再回来...

source: I don't need time. I won't kill the scribe.
target: 我不需要时间 我不会杀文士的

source: You dare refuse? I could compel you... but I won't... as fate would have it, there is another way.
target: 你敢拒绝吗 我可以强迫你 但我不会...

source: You and Mered must go to Uket's shrine, there will be a final soul to claim there.
target: 你和Mered必须去Uket的神社 在那里会有最后的灵魂

source: At last you are here. A site of great power to Uket and, in turn, to me... I am... much stronger here...
target: 你终于来了,乌克特拥有强大力量的地方, 反过来,我...

source: I shall not claim the soul I desired, but a soul nonetheless... Mered?
target: 我将不要求我渴望的灵魂, 但一个灵魂...

source: Yes, oh mighty Shadow! How can your servant... err... serve you?
target: 对,伟大的影子,你的仆人怎么能...

source: You have been loyal Mered, I shall therefore bless you with a place in my great work. You should be honoured at this gift.
target: 你曾经忠于默里德,因此我将祝福你在我的伟大工作中占有一席之地,你应当为这个礼物而感到荣幸.

source: Oh, my lord... I don't know what to say... I mean thank y-you... err... I can't... I can't move my legs... it's like they're stuck...
target: 哦,我的上帝,我不知道该说什么...

source: This will make it easier Mered, running would merely prolong the inevitable. Now, take the knife and deliver his soul to me!
target: 这会让Mered更容易,跑步只会延长不可避免的时间,现在,拿起刀把他的灵魂交给我!

source: Sorry Mered, it was always going to end like this...
target: 对不起,梅里德,它总是会结束 像这样...

source: Wait! Why are you doing this to me... please, I just did what I was told! I was afraid... what was I supposed to do?
target: 等等,你为什么要这样对我...

source: Mered, now... Presumably me next, no?
Yet again you underestimate my power... I will act through you... give in to my will!
target: 你又一次低估了我的力量 我会通过你来行动 屈从于我的意志

source: Please... please... I don't want to die!
target: 求你... 求你,我不想死!

source: How are you... doing... that? No matter, he cannot resist!
target: 你怎么... 他无法抗拒!
所以,你是一个... 书,现在?

source: How did you end up trapped in a book, then?
target: 那你怎么被困在书里了?

source: Why are you killing these people?
So they are dying, meaning they were alive!
target: 所以他们就要死了,意味着他们还活着!

source: [Quest]What is it you want me to do?
You can't make me listen to you...
Fine. I'll listen, if you'll release me.
target: 好吧,我听着,如果你能放我走

source: [Refuse] I won't be a part of this. Find someone else.
target: 我不会参与的 找别人

source: [Listen] What do you want from me?
target: 你想从我这里得到什么?

source: What do I get out of this?
I will kill the scribe, if I must.
target: 如果有必要,我会杀了文士

source: Are you insane? I'm not murdering her!
I don't need time. I won't kill the scribe.
target: 我不需要时间 我不会杀文士的

source: [Accept] Sorry Mered, it was always going to end like this...
target: [接受] 对不起Mered, 它总是会结束 像这样...

source: [Refuse] Mered, now... Presumably me next, no?
Ugh... We need to find a way out of this mess. I'm getting bored fucking you lot...
target: 我们得想办法摆脱这混乱 我他妈的太无聊了...

source: Well maybe you should have thought about that before you fucked us the first time!
target: 或许你应该先考虑一下 然后再第一次上我们

source: Hey, how was I supposed to know it'd raise the fucking dead?
target: 嘿,我怎么知道它会把死人养大?

source: You didn't think that maybe the only shiny thing in this gods-forsaken dump, being right out in the open, could be a trap? And you call yourself a "master thief"....
target: 你没想到,在这个神弃的垃圾堆里, 唯一闪亮的东西,就在外面, 可能是陷阱吗?

source: Think we're stuck down here forever?
target: 你觉得我们被困在这一辈子吗?

source: Dunno... Hope not. We don't have that much food left...
target: 希望没有,我们没有那么多食物了...

source: Should've brought a good book to read... You ever read "The Cock-gobbling Cordwainer"?
No? What the fuck is it even about?
This lady shoe-maker who gobbles a lot of cock.
target: 这个女人的鞋匠 口吃很多鸡巴。

source: Hey, don't judge! It's got tons of hot and heavy foot stuff in it! You'd love it I bet.
target: 嘿,别评判,里面有一堆热重的脚物,你会喜欢的

source: Too bad you got Khemet killed... Could go for some of his music right about now.
target: 可惜你害死了赫梅特 现在可以去听他的音乐了

source: Pfft I thought you hated that noise.
I do. Or, I did... Wouldn't mind it so much now...
target: 我愿意,或者,我现在不介意了

source: Hey... You ever wonder what the afterlife is really like?
target: 嘿,你有没有想过 来世是怎样的?

source: No, and I'd rather not waste our time talking about it either. We'll find out when we get there...
target: 不,我也不想浪费我们的时间 谈论它。

source: Well if we don't find a way out of here, it could be sooner rather than later...
target: 如果我们没有办法离开这里 可能早点走...

source: Ugh... Just shut up, will you?
Oi! We've got a rat skulking about! Kill it!
target: 嘿,我们有个老鼠在偷偷摸摸的,杀了它!

source: Time to die, sneak! That treasure is ours!
target: 是时候死了 偷偷摸摸的 宝藏是我们的

source: Again? Shouldn't we be focusing on how to get out of here?
target: 再来一次,我们不该集中力量 想办法离开这里吗?

source: Wonder if the others found another way out...
target: 不知道其他人有没有别的办法...

source: Doubt it... Let's face the facts. We're all gonna die, and our time's best spent with your face between my thighs.
target: 面对现实吧,我们都快死了 时间最好用在我大腿之间

source: Please, I just went down on you!
You know what I could go for?
No! A slice of fresh pie! You know you don't have to be such a horny slut all the time, right?
target: 不,新鲜派,你知道你不用一直这么淫荡,对吧?

source: You came to the wrong ruins!
Idiot just had to touch it...
Hmm... Could swear I just heard something...
target: 嗯,可以发誓我刚刚听到什么...

source: Shadows in this place give me the creeps...
target: 这地方的阴影让我毛骨悚然...

source: We should just fight our way out, but nooooo, that would be too dangerous. They'd rather die of starvation instead...
target: 我们只是应该打我们的方式出去,但是不,那会太危险,他们宁愿死于饥饿,而不是...

source: Treasure's gotta be hidden here somewhere...
target: 宝藏必须藏在这里某处...

source: Become a tomb raider they said... It'll be fun they said...
What's a man gotta do to get some decent head around here?
target: 一个人要做什么才能有正经的头脑?

source: All this fuckery better be worth it...
Gods-damned bones rose up against us... The fucking bones...
target: 可恶的骨头 起来对付我们...

source: I'm just going in circles, aren't I?
Dunno what I'm patrolling for... Skeletons don't seem keen on chasing after us...
target: 不知我在巡逻什么 雪莱顿似乎不想追我们

source: Thought you could waltz in and snatch our prize, eh? Big mistake, stranger!
target: 以为你们能进来抢我们的奖品?

source: You've got guts coming here alone! Guts I'm gonna spill!
target: 你胆子真大,一个人来,我要吐了

source: What's this? Competition? I don't fucking think so!
target: 这是什么 竞争 我不这么认为

source: That's right, stay out of my way.
Be careful, don't want you getting hurt.
You're either very brave or unbelievably stupid, I'm not sure which.
target: 你要么非常勇敢 要么令人难以置信的愚蠢, 我不知道是什么。

source: Aren't we all? Long road, tired bones 'n all that. But every soul under this roof bled in the sand to earn their bunk.
target: 长路漫漫,疲惫的骨头,但屋檐下的每一个人都流血在沙滩上挣床铺。

source: So here's how it works. Step into the ring, or bed down in the yard. Either way, we could use the entertainment.
target: 就是这样的,走进圈子,或者在院子里睡觉。不管怎么样,我们可以利用娱乐。

source: The sooner we start, the sooner I sleep.
House rules say no weapons. Just your hands, feet and elbows. Understood?
target: 家规规定不带武器 只有你的手,脚和肘,明白吗?

source: No weapons, just hands. No problem, won't be the first time.
target: 没有武器,只有手,没问题,不会是第一次

source: Can't we just skip this part?
target: 我们就不能跳过这部分吗?

source: Bunk's in the back. And if you've use for it, there's spare armour by the armoury.
target: 邦克在后面 如果你用过的话 军械库旁边有备用的装甲

source: Put away your weapons so we can begin.
target: 把枪放下,我们开始行动

source: Mmm... Love that smell... We're gonna eat good today.
target: 嗯,我喜欢这味道,我们今天会好好吃

source: I think you've been hit in the head too much... Not sure how much more ophyx stew I can stomach.
target: 我想你头部被打得太多了...

source: Who knows? Overheard the priestess talking with Tabu. Sounds like she wants to make this temple her own. I'm betting we're stuck here for a while...
target: 谁知道呢,我听到教士跟塔布说话了 听起来她想把这座寺庙变成自己的

source: Path knows I love a good ophyx stew.
target: 路知道我爱吃一顿好烤肉

source: Path knows you're a loony... There's barely any meat in it anyway.
target: 路知道你是个疯子 反正里面几乎没有肉

source: It was dark when that thing came out of nowhere... I felt nothing but the rushing breeze against me...
target: 那东西突然冒出来时很黑...

source: S-sorry. I don't want to talk about it anymore...
target: 对不起,我不想再谈这个了...
嘎 - ! 嘎 - 嘎! 嘎 - 嘎

source: Oh the things I would do for an elixir...
target: 哦,我会做的东西 一个灵丹妙药...
嘎 - ! 嘎 - 嘎! 嘎 - 嘎

source: It looks as though you're injured.
We walk the Path. Pain is temporary... The Path is eternal.
target: 痛苦是暂时的 痛苦是永恒的

target: 这个地方是我的塔伯纳和我的家, 唯一一个水洞 在优波笈多... 至少我知道。

source: The foundations are part of the ruins that give the island its name. Local superstition meant nobody dared build up here... until I came along.
target: 地基是废墟的一部分,它让小岛得名。

source: May I have a look at your stock?
target: 我可以看看你的股票吗?

source: Show me what you have for sale.

target: 我想和你交换,如果你有时间。

I don't have much in, but you're welcome to have a look.
target: 我没什么,但欢迎你看看。

source: So, what can I get for you?
target: 那么,我有什么可以为你吗?

source: I'll take a look at your stock.
The Rampant Lioness... what exactly is this place?
target: 朗潘特狮子... 究竟这是什么地方?

source: This place is my Taberna and my home, the only watering hole on the Euphoris... that I know of at least.
target: 这个地方是我的塔伯纳和我的家, 唯一一个水洞 在优波笈多... 至少我知道。

target: 地基是废墟的一部分,它让小岛得名。

source: It's just you here right? Is there anything I can do to help?
target: 只有你在这里吗 我能帮忙吗?

source: Nothing right now, perhaps I can be of help to you though.
target: 现在什么都没有,也许我可以帮你。

source: We rarely see your kind on the island... what is it that brings an unbound formless to Tal-Senet?
target: 我们很少在岛上看到你们这种人... 是什么给Tal -Senet带来无限制的形态?

source: I'll take a look at your stock.
My appetite isn't going to be satisfied by anything on your list, I'm in the mood for you.
target: 你名单上的任何东西 我都不会满足我的胃口的,我为你着想

source: I'm not that sort of girl. I don't just drop my knickers on command!
target: 我不是那种女孩,我不只是把内裤放下来指挥!

source: C-can I get you something to eat instead?
I'm in the mood for you.
We rarely see your kind on the island... what is it that brings an unbound formless to Tal-Senet?
target: 我们很少在岛上看到你们这种人... 是什么给Tal -Senet带来无限制的形态?

source: I don't know what brought me here, but right now I just want to get this damned mask off.
target: 我不知道是什么把我带到这里的 但是现在我只想把这该死的面具摘下来

source: You came to the wrong island for that I'm afraid. Tal-Senet had far more poets and painters than smelters or smiths.
target: 你来错岛了,我担心,塔尔塞内特的诗人和画家比冶炼厂或铁匠要多得多。

source: I think we had a bronzeworker from Mehden a few months back. You could always sail one of the boats over... it's not like anyone will miss it.
target: 我想几个月前我们有个来自梅登的青铜工人 你总能驾船过来...

source: I don't know what you mean, what's an unbound formless?
target: 我不知道你是什么意思, 什么是无约束的无形?

source: You don't... oh honey. Well it's what you are.
target: 你不... 哦,亲爱的,这就是你是什么。

source: I can't see any slave collar or shackles, so you're not permanently tethered to any mistress or master. A free soul as it were, hence "unbound".
target: 我看不到任何奴隶的项圈或枷锁,所以你不会永久地绑在任何情妇或主人身上。一个自由的灵魂,就像它曾经一样,因此是"不受约束的".

source: Then your gifts of ascension... or lack thereof... you're kin with the formless. Not that there's anything wrong with that.
I wanted to ask something else.
I want to find somewhere clear of those... things. Somewhere safe to call home.
target: 我想找个地方清清楚楚 找个安全的地方叫回家

source: Sadly even Tal-Senet isn't safe from the stone sickness. The curse reached every corner of Sabu.
target: 可惜连塔尔塞内特都无法免于石病,诅咒到达了萨布的每一个角落.

source: It's a mercy that the few of us who remain are still untouched by it... even if we live in danger of the ones that fell.
target: 幸好我们当中的少数人 仍然没有被它伤害 即使我们活在被坠落者的威胁中

source: Surely if I clear out the cursed ones then Tal-Senet will be safe... for now at least.
target: 当然,如果我清除那些被诅咒的, 那么塔尔-塞内特将安全... 至少现在。

source: Don't try anything too heroic, down by the cove I was nearly... anyway, I lost my sword in the process.
target: 别太英勇,我差点在河口下游... 无论如何,我在这过程中失去了剑

source: Is slavery commonplace here? You mentioned collars and shackles, are those used to imprison slaves?
target: 奴隶制度在这里是司空见惯吗?

source: All trades of the flesh are commonplace in Sabu, even more so closer to the coast.
target: 所有肉类交易在萨布都司空见惯,甚至更接近海岸.

source: The collars and shackles do more than imprison... it's said that they bind the very soul of the wearer... break their will and distort their desire.
target: 项圈和枷锁比监禁更有用... 据说它们束缚着穿戴者的灵魂... 打破他们的意志 扭曲他们的欲望

source: It means that they cannot disobey the whim of their owner... and that over time they stop wanting to disobey.
target: 这意味着他们不能违抗主人的意念... 随着时间的推移,他们不再想违抗。

source: Once that happens the bindings are no longer needed... I've seen freed slaves that willingly submit themselves to the whim of a new captor.
target: 一旦发生这种情况 约束就不再需要了 我见过自由的奴隶们 愿意屈服于新捕头的随意行动

source: You mentioned the formless lack ascension, what does that mean?
target: 你提到无形无形的缺乏气质,这是什么意思?

source: This talk of the formless is getting a bit... taboo.
target: 说到无形者有点... 忌讳

source: Oh, I had no idea. Sorry if I've made you uncomfortable.
target: 哦,我不知道,抱歉让你不舒服

source: No it's fine. It's just not something you'd ordinarily talk about... or have to explain to someone.
target: 不,没关系,这不是你通常谈论的...

source: So, most people bear some mark of the goddess' reign... the forms she created through her gifts.
target: 因此,大多数人都带有一些女神统治的印记... 她通过她的天赋创造的形式.

source: But some remain almost untouched... peoples of a lineage from before the fire in the heavens... those without divine form.
target: 但是有些几乎没有被触及... 世系上的人... 在天上火光之前...

source: When you were speaking before, you mentioned that talking about the formless is taboo... why is that?
target: 你之前讲的时候,你提到 谈论无形是禁忌... 为什么?

source: Ah, yes. Well it both is and isn't... formless hold the lowest social status in Sabu, many see their lack of gifts as a divine message...
A sign that they weren't worthy of her gifts and so not worthy of protection. Most formless in Sabu are... most are kept as slaves.
target: 表明他们不配得到她的礼物 也不值得保护 在萨布大部分没有形态的人...

source: Some eventually attain a higher form, though many die in such an attempt... if they survive the process it's not uncommon that they're set free.
target: 有些人最终获得了更高的地位, 虽然许多人死于这样的尝试... 如果他们在过程中幸存下来...

source: It's frowned upon to keep a non-formless slave... though not unheard of.
target: 虽然不是没听说过,但要养一个不形而上学的奴隶 却被吓坏了

source: [Quest]I need to get this mask removed.
What do you mean unbound formless?
target: 你是什么意思无约束的无形?

source: This island seems fairly dangerous, do you get many patrons here these days? Must be hard to meet new people.
target: 这座岛看起来很危险,最近这里有不少赞助人吗?

source: No, not really. Most of the people who lived on Tal-Senet... they... the things that prowl the shoreline were once my patrons... my neighbours.
target: 不,不是的,大多数住在塔尔塞内特的人...

source: I manage though. I mean even when this place was teeming with people I didn't have anyone... not that I'm looking for anything serious.
target: 虽然我还是能行的,即使这地方跟别人在一起 我也没有任何人...

target: 但这并不代表我也不是...

target: 我们的萨布西辣酒很受欢迎,或者更强壮的酒?

source: The poetess singing about lions and jackals, are you and her...

target: 不,她偶尔会是好朋友, 虽然她经常是我屁股上的大痛!

Are you certain I can't get you anything? I'm having one, goddess knows I need it!

source: I'll have a Sabuthi Spiced Wine.

target: 我很享受你的陪伴 但原谅我,我没听到你的名字。

target: 我是Lybos的Damaris Panleostra... 嗯,我以前是Lybos的,我也很高兴和你说话, 打断一下.

I was a wanderer, moving here and there. Never found anywhere I wanted to settle... my path led me here by river... I think we ran aground...
target: 我是一个流浪汉, 到处走, 从来没有找到任何我想定居的地方...

I was a blade for hire, I killed men for coin... and I was good at it too. Not sure why, but I ended up on a boat here... I think it wrecked.
target: 我是雇工,我为了钱而杀人...

source: But then I also remember fighting a shadow so perhaps I can't trust any of my memories.
target: 但后来我还记得与影子战斗,所以也许我不能信任我的记忆。

I traded in flesh I think... I remember being wealthy, having my pick of the slaves too. I think I was bringing a shipment when we wrecked...
target: 我用肉做交易,我想我记得自己很有钱, 也有我挑的奴隶。
