I might not have much to tell, but I'm certain you do.
target: 我可能没什么好说的 但我肯定你有

source: Tell me some more about this place.
target: 再跟我说说这个地方吧

source: Of course, what do you want to know?
I might not have much to tell, but I'm certain you do.
target: 我可能没什么好说的 但我肯定你有

source: About... myself? I mean... of course, what would you like to know?
target: 关于我自己 我是说 当然 你想知道什么

source: Damaris, do you remember when you asked me to kiss you?
target: 达玛里斯,你还记得你让我吻你的时候吗?

source: Yes, o-of course. I know I was moving things too quickly...
target: 是的,当然,我知道我移动得太快了...

source: Do you still want that kiss?
How large is Sabu exactly, is it a single country?
target: 萨布到底有多大,它是一个国家吗?

source: I don't know if I'm the right girl to answer that one, I've not ventured further than Tal-Senet. I think it's split into... I want to say eight provinces.
target: 我不知道我是不是一个合适的女孩来回答这个问题, 我没有比塔尔-塞内特更冒险,我认为它分裂成...我想说八个省.

source: Don't hold me to that though, I'm no cartographer!
You mentioned Sabu is divided into different provinces, can you tell me more about them?
target: 你提到萨布被分成了不同的省份, 你能告诉我更多关于他们的情况吗?

source: I also mentioned that I'm no cartographer
target: 我还提到我不是制图员

source: You mention Tal-Senet as both a library and an island, what exactly was it?
target: 你提到Tal -Senet既是图书馆又是岛屿 到底是什么?

source: We're on the foundation of Tal-Senet at the moment. The island itself is really just what's left of the ruin.
target: 我们现在在塔尔-塞内特的地基上,这座岛本身其实就是废墟所剩无几.

source: From what I understand, long before the sundering it was built as a palace of sorts for the demigod Seshat.
target: 据我所知 早在潜伏之前 它就被建成了神盾局的宫殿

source: They say that's why plants thrive here, though if you ask me it probably doesn't hurt that we're in the middle of the Euphoris river.
target: 他们说,这就是植物在这里繁衍的原因, 虽然如果你问我, 它可能不会伤害我们 在优波斯河的中间。

source: So what's the story with the name, why is the taberna called "The Rampant Lioness"?
target: 那么,这个名字是什么故事,为什么塔伯纳叫"羊皮狮子"?

source: Taberna are seldom known for the subtlety of their naming. They need to be memorable... and nobody forgets "The Rampant Lioness".
target: 塔伯纳很少以名字的微妙性而闻名,他们需要记忆......没有人会忘记"羊皮狮子".

source: That... doesn't feel like the whole story. The name itself feels... personal, as though it means much more to you.
How in the five hells... sorry it's just, you're right. I named it after my mother. I barely remember her to tell the truth...
But I do remember that she loved me fiercely... when she came home she'd bundle me up in her arms. Made me feel so safe.
target: 但我记得她很爱我 她回家时 把我捆在怀里 让我感到很安全

source: I didn't want to use her name, it had no meaning to me. She was never "Hesra"... she was my Mum.
target: 我不想用她的名字,这对我毫无意义 她从来不是"赫斯拉" 她是我妈妈

source: Have you always lived here, on this island?
No, I actually moved to Sabu a little over four years back. The boat stopped here to drop off a trader and I just... stayed.
target: 不,我四年多前搬到了萨布 船停在这里送货,我...

source: I find Tal-Senet peaceful, or at least I did before... recent events.
target: 我发现Tal -Senet很平静, 或者至少我之前... 最近的事件。

source: You said you moved here. Where were you from, originally?
target: 你说你搬来这的,原来你从哪里来的?

source: I came here from Lybos, it's downstream from here... out to sea actually. It's part of the Helios Archipeligo, all rolling plains and hilltop villas.
target: 我从莱博斯来到这里,它从这里下游...

source: It's actually quite lovely... if you can overlook the herds of rutting centaur once autumn rolls in.
target: 它其实相当可爱... 如果你可以忽略 牛群的 rutting 半人马在秋季滚入。

source: What made you want to open a Taberna... and why here?
target: 你为什么想开个塔伯纳... 为什么在这里?

source: I wanted a place like this since I was a little girl growing up in Lybos.
target: 我小时候在莱博斯长大 我就想找个这样的地方

source: My mother moved there, before I was born, it's where she met my father. It was blissful, but when I was six my mother died.
target: 我母亲在我出生前就搬到那里了, 在那里她遇见了我父亲,很幸福,但是当我六岁的时候,我母亲就死了。

source: I'm so sorry, that's a terrible loss.
target: 对不起,这是一个可怕的损失。

source: Twenty years ago it was. Time doesn't heal, but the pain recedes.... and my father. He sought to give all the love my mother could not.

target: 狼圈,小贼和土匪现在折磨着阿内布 贸易瘫痪了...

source: Wait... you mean Amycus is dead?
target: 等等 你是说艾米库斯死了?

source: True, a body was never recovered but... well... he had a good thing here. One can only assume the worst.
target: 没错,一具尸体一直没有恢复 但是...

source: Any idea where I could look for Amycus?
The merchant Renshet has reported a missing shipment. The bandits who killed Amycus may be responsible.
target: 商人任舍报告有一批货物失踪,杀害艾米克斯的匪徒可能要负责.

source: One wouldn't presume but... eh... one might suggest starting there. Speak with Renshet, tell him Euthymius sent you..
target: 说说伦谢特 告诉他尤瑟米乌斯派你来的

source: Why do you seem so... tense?
target: 你为什么看起来这么... 紧张?

source: If you found yourself in one's situation, you would understand. One was assigned by the guild to this... backwater.
target: 如果你发现自己处于这种境地,你会明白的,一个被荷兰盾指派到这个...

source: The so-called rare goods these traders peddle here would hardly catch one's gaze in a real market.
target: 所谓的稀有商品 这些贸易商在这里 很难在真正的市场中被人们看到。

source: Even so... Aneb does yield some profit, meager though it may be. The guild simply cannot turn down the prospect of profit.
target: 即便如此,Aneb的确赚了不少利润,尽管可能是微薄的,荷兰盾根本不能拒绝利润的前景。

source: Of course these bandit attacks are an assault on commerce, the village cannot afford the disruption for long.
target: 当然,这些土匪袭击是对商业的攻击,村庄承受不起长时间的破坏。

source: One on the other hand... well... one may not have to remain here much longer if this state of affairs continues.
target: 另一方面... 如果事态继续下去 一个人可能就不必在这里呆太久了

source: Do you recognise the symbol on this amulet?
target: 你认得这个护身符上的符号吗?

source: Yes. One could be forgiven for not recognising it. It is a symbol borne by the lowest vermin... naturally one made every effort.
target: 是的,人们可以原谅自己不承认它,这是最低的害虫所象征的,自然是尽了一切努力的。

source: There should be no barriers to trade after all. Their encampment is not far, one will mark it on your map.
target: 毕竟应该没有贸易壁垒,他们的营地不远,你们地图上会标注它。

source: I'm helping an old man track down a missing guard.
target: 我在帮助一个老人找到一个失踪的警卫

source: Any idea where I could look for Amycus?
Why do you seem so... tense?
target: 你为什么看起来这么... 紧张?

source: Do you recognise the symbol on this amulet?
target: 你认得这个护身符上的符号吗?

source: You think because we're probably about to die means I'm just going to give up and let you win?
target: 你觉得我们可能就要死了 就意味着我放弃了 让你赢?

source: I would never! You're just wrong, that's all.
target: 我绝对不会 你错了 仅此而已

source: I know there's no such thing as a bad opinion... but still.
target: 我知道没有坏的意见... 但还是有的

source: What? There's absolutely such a thing as a bad opinion... I mean you're spouting one at the moment!
target: 什么 绝对有坏意见 我是说你现在在说一个

source: But they shed... at least fur doesn't peel off and leave scraps all over the place.
target: 但至少皮毛不会脱落 到处留下废屑

source: What? Talking of shedding and you think fur is the lesser offender?
target: 什么 说起脱衣舞 你觉得皮毛是更轻的罪犯吗?

source: Oh look Ashalia, someone lucky enough to still be walking around.
target: 哦,看阿莎莉娅, 一个幸运的,仍然走来走去。

source: Don't know what they're still doing here. If I could move, I'd already be on my heels!
target: 不知道他们还在这里干什么 如果我能动的话,我早就在后面了!

source: Are you... what happened to the two of you?
target: 你们... 你们俩怎么了?

source: Just a day like any other, one moment we're settling a disagreement, and the next... well you can see what happened.
target: 只是一天像任何其他, 一分钟我们正在解决一个分歧, 而下一个... ...

source: Just like those who fall to the curse, but we turned in an instant. I'm not even sure how we're still here...
target: 就像那些被诅咒的人 但我们马上就转身了 我甚至不知道我们怎么还在这里

source: It's probably because what we're discussing is of metaphysical importance!
target: 这大概是因为我们讨论的是 具有元物理重要性!

source: Well that's going to make you being wrong even worse!
This disagreement, what are the pair of you arguing about?
Ashalia and her friend thinks that scales are superior to fur. The absolute cheek of it, can you believe that?
target: 阿莎莉娅和她的朋友认为鳞片比皮毛优越,绝对的面颊,你能相信吗?

source: It's a matter of fact, Farak. They look better. They clean easier. They're more pleasant to touch. Face it, you're simply wrong.
target: 这是事实,法拉克,他们看起来更好,他们更容易清理,他们更容易接触,面对现实,你完全错了.

source: Let me get this straight... turned to stone, without warning, and the two of you are arguing about.... this?
target: 让我直说吧... 变成石头,没有警告, 而你们两个在争吵... 这个?

source: Well when you put it that way it makes us seem... but yes, yes we are. Need to settle it before we reach Keth-Eros!
target: 好吧,当你这么说,它让我们看起来...

source: I doubt we'll have managed to agree by then, an eternity of bickering awaits us in Keth-Eros...
target: 我怀疑那时我们还是会同意的 在凯斯伊罗斯 一场永恒的争吵等待着我们...

source: Only if you're unwilling to recognise the superiority of fur!
target: 除非你不愿意承认皮毛的优越性!

source: What do you think, stranger. Which is the better form, a scaled body or a furry one?
I have to go with the elegance of scales, by far the better choice.
target: 我不得不用天平的优雅, 远为更好的选择。

source: Did your mother lay with an Aadi or something, you stone-headed child of a-
target: 你母亲跟一个Aadi什么的上床了 你这头石头头的孩子...

source: Just because this stranger sided with you doesn't mean you win, Ashalia.
target: 就因为这个陌生人站在你一边 不代表你赢了 阿莎莉娅

source: Ashalia? Stop it... This isn't funny! L-look, you win, okay? I'll say it, scales are better. Just... say something.
target: 阿莎莉娅,别这样,这不好笑 听着,你赢了,好吗?

source: I... I think they're both gone. Nothing I can do here, I should get moving.
target: 我觉得他们都走了 我什么也做不了,我该走了

source: I have to go with the softness of fur, by far the better choice.
target: 我不得不带着柔软的皮毛去,到目前为止更好的选择。

source: Did your father bed a Mau or something, you rock-brained child of a-
target: 你爸爸睡了毛什么的, 你摇滚的孩子 一个...

source: Oh please, you're so full of it! A total stranger taking your side doesn't mean you win.
target: 拜托,你太夸张了,一个陌生人站在你这边并不代表你赢了

source: Farak? Say something... I don't want this! A-alright, you win, okay? I'll say it, fur is better. Just, please... don't go.
target: 法拉克,说点什么吧,我不想要这个,好吧,你赢了,好吗?

source: I... I think they're both gone. Nothing I can do here, I should get moving.
target: 我觉得他们都走了 我什么也做不了,我该走了

source: Neither, I prefer the touch of skin.
target: 也不是,我更喜欢皮肤的触摸

source: Oh, I'm still here. But... what in The Five Hells is wrong with you?
Revolting, the thought of it makes me shudder in disgust.... or it would... if I could move.
target: 令人反感的,想到它让我感到厌恶... 或者它会... 如果我能动的话.

source: But skin is supple and soft, it's smooth...
target: 但是皮肤又柔和又柔软,很光滑......

source: I've heard quite enough, thank you... and to think I felt Ashalia had a skewed outlook!
target: 我听够了,谢谢... 觉得阿莎莉娅有扭曲的前景!

source: I quite agree Farak, really puts our endless squabbles into perspective.
target: 我同意法拉克的观点,真的把我们无休止的争吵看透了。

source: I think they're gone... for good this time. Nothing to keep me here, I should move on.
target: 这次他们走了,我应该走了

source: What's going on between you two?
Hmm... This one is thirsty... Where are the servants?
Ah, there you are... This one requires drink. Whatever swill the locals drink will do... Hurry up now.. One doesn't have all day.
target: 这杯酒需要喝 当地人喝什么就喝什么

source: This one was beginning to wonder... what was taking so long... it is presumed you have this one's drink?
target: 这个开始怀疑... 怎么会这么长时间... 假设你喝了这杯?

source: Yes, I have it. See what you think of this.
target: 是的,我拿到了,看看你怎么看这个

source: Mmh- excellent then. Allow this one a... taste... eugh- what is this gutter-water you have brought? Go! Go and fetch this one something more palatable!
Perhaps some of that... Yellow Sweetwater the servants are always going on about...
Here's that Yellow Sweetwater you wanted.
You... Already had this prepared? This one is impressed... Now to see... Blegh-! This drink is vile! Bring this one some brandy. Go now, off with you!
target: 你准备好了吗,这个很让人印象深刻 现在看看,布莱格,这酒太下流了

source: You mean this Minot Brandy? Allow me to pour for you.
target: 你是说这个米诺特白兰地?

source: This one wonders why you are carrying all of these drinks around with you... But... I will take it.
target: 这个人想知道你为什么带着这些饮料到处走...

source: Mmmh- now that is what a good beverage should taste like. Reminds one of home... You have served me well. You've earned this...
target: 嗯,现在饮料的味道应该很好,你让我想起了家,你为我服务得很好,这是你应得的

source: Do not spend it all at once...
...one more moment. To prepare to serve so thoroughly... exemplary. One will give you this... a token of the value this one places in you.
target: 准备好为你们做彻底的... 模范的准备,你们会得到这个...

source: This one was beginning to wonder... what was taking so long... it is presumed you have this one's drink?
target: 这个开始怀疑... 怎么会这么长时间... 假设你喝了这杯?

source: Here's that Yellow Sweetwater you wanted.
It took long enough... Now to see... Blegh-! This drink is vile! Bring this one some brandy. Go now, off with you!
target: 现在看,这酒太烂了,拿来,你先走吧

source: You mean this Minot Brandy? Allow me to pour for you.
target: 你是说这个米诺特白兰地?

source: You... Already had this to hand? This one is impressed... Now the tasting...
target: 你,你已经拿了这个,这个很厉害...

source: Mmmh- now that is what a good beverage should taste like. Reminds one of home... You have served me well. You've earned this...
target: 嗯,现在饮料的味道应该很好,你让我想起了家,你为我服务得很好,这是你应得的

source: Do not spend it all at once...
This one was beginning to wonder... what was taking so long... it is presumed you have this one's drink?
target: 这个开始怀疑... 怎么会这么长时间... 假设你喝了这杯?

source: Mmmh- now that is what a good beverage should taste like. Reminds one of home... You have served me well. You've earned this...
target: 嗯,现在饮料的味道应该很好,你让我想起了家,你为我服务得很好,这是你应得的

source: Do not spend it all at once...
Which hell have those damned boys got to now?
target: 那些该死的家伙现在要到哪去?

source: Barely ever awake before noon... no work ethic...
target: 在中午之前几乎醒着... 没有职业道德...

source: How am I to bring this bloody harvest in alone?
target: 我怎么才能单独收割呢?

source: Oh, good day to you... haven't perchance seen two lads skulking off have you?
target: 哦,祝你今天愉快... 还没看到两个小伙子溜走吗?

source: I haven't, no... did they steal something?
target: 我没有,没有... 他们偷东西了吗?

source: Steal something? Heavens no! Just my son Anhur and my fieldhand. Always sneaking off to get drunk or enjoy... other pleasures.
target: 不,只有我儿子安赫尔和我的野手 总是偷偷溜出去喝醉或享受其他的乐趣

source: Was not so long ago that near half the island was cursed... yet they live as though the harvest will bring itself in!
target: 不久以前, 岛上近一半的人被诅咒了... 但是他们活下来了,好像收成会带回自己!

source: Do you know why your son and fieldhand have been sneaking off?
target: 你知道你儿子和野手为什么偷偷溜走吗?

source: Why? It's simple, tale as old as the dunes. The young get swept up in fantasy, can't see a childish fling for what it is.
target: 很简单,像沙丘一样古老的传说 年轻人被幻想所淹没

source: No more than the embers of youth. Naturally I forbade it under my roof...
target: 自然我禁止它在我的屋檐下...

source: My father... he kept me from such a mistake, without him I wouldn't have this farm. I just want the best for my son.
target: 我父亲让我避免了这样的错误,没有他,我就不会有这个农场了,我只想为我儿子好

source: I found Anhur a good match, a strong family on the mainland. Almost four thousand cubits of arable by way of a dowry.
target: 我发现安赫尔是一个很好的匹配者, 一个强大的家庭在大陆。

source: Sorry, what did you mean when you said that half of the island was cursed?
target: 对不起 你说半个岛被诅咒是什么意思?

source: Exactly that. All was well one day, then the next... I woke to an Aadi raising hell up on the road, found it tethered to old Teren's cart.
target: 有一天一切都很好,然后第二天 我醒来时发现一个Aadi在路上爬上地狱,发现它和老泰伦的车绑在一起

source: Wheels had buckled under the weight, beast couldn't pull it along like that. Teren was dead as a brick, cold as one too.
target: 轮子在重量下系上安全带,野兽无法像那样拉动,泰伦死得像砖头,冷得像一块.

source: Never seen the curse take like that before, led the Aadi up to the village to... well... let's say I came back quick. Nothing alive in that place now.
target: 以前从未见过这样的诅咒, 带领亚迪人到村里...

source: Nothing to be done about it either. Not that it matters... we don't bring the harvest in and we'll be dead ourselves come the dry season.
target: 我们不会把收获带进来,我们自己会死在旱季。

source: Oh, good day to you... haven't perchance seen two lads skulking off have you?
target: 哦,祝你今天愉快... 还没看到两个小伙子溜走吗?

source: I haven't, though there are two bodies not far from here. One had a similar pelt to yours.
target: 虽然离这里不远有两具尸体,但我还没有看到,有一个和你的类似

source: Same pelt as... Anhur! No, no... where are they? How did he...
target: 和安赫尔一样,不,不,他们在哪里?

source: A beast took them, they're in the mouth of a cave just beyond the end of your pasture.
target: 一只野兽带走了它们 它们就在你牧场尽头的洞穴口里

source: There was a note, I presume for you. Your son planned to elope, he was in love.
target: 有个字条,我猜你,你儿子计划私奔,他恋爱了

source: In... love? I only forbade it for... for his own sake. Goddess... did my hand drive my own son to his end.
target: 爱,我只为了他自己而禁止它 女神,我亲手把儿子逼到尽头

source: I cannot thank you for this news stranger. I must... I must tend to my child.
target: 我不能感谢你这个陌生人 我必须照顾我的孩子

source: I can't imagine the pain you feel, a father should not have to bury their son.
target: 我无法想象你所感受到的痛苦 一个父亲不该埋葬他们的儿子

source: I cannot thank you for this news stranger. I must... I must tend to my child.
target: 我不能感谢你这个陌生人 我必须照顾我的孩子

source: Not to insult your company but I cannot stand around chewing the fat all day, the harvest isn't going to thresh itself.
target: 我不是要侮辱你的公司 但我不能整天忍受嚼脂肪 收成不会自己崩溃的

source: Would you kindly keep an eye peeled for my boy or the fieldhand? You'd have my gratitude stranger.
target: 你能帮我的男孩还是野手留神点吗?

source: I will. Should I see them I'll let your son know you want him back at the farm.
target: 我会的,如果我看见他们 我会告诉你儿子你想让他回到农场

source: My thanks, stranger. It's hard graft to work the field alone!
target: 谢谢 陌生人 一个人去田里工作很辛苦

source: Oh, Anhur takes after me in looks, you can't mistake him.
target: 哦,安赫尔在看上我,你不能误解他。

source: It seems like they keep leaving as you've made them unwelcome, it's not my place to bring your son back.
target: 看来他们一直离开,因为你让他们不高兴, 这不是我把你儿子带回来的地方。

source: Save your judgement stranger, you'll better understand when you have children of your own. Not such a simple task as your tone implies.
target: 救救你的判断陌生人,当你有自己的孩子时,你会更好的理解,不是像你的语气暗示的那样简单的任务.

source: Ah, you're back. Did you find my boy? It's about time he returned!
target: 你回来了,找到我儿子了吗?

source: I did find your son, as well as your fieldhand. They were slain by a beast in a nearby cave.
target: 我确实找到你的儿子,还有你的野手 他们被附近的洞穴里的野兽杀死了

source: No, that cannot be right. I spoke with him only... it cannot be...
target: 不,这不可能,我只和他谈过...

source: His fur was the same as yours and he left a note. They were in love, planned to elope together. The cave they met in was the den of a beast.
target: 他的皮毛和你一样,留下了一张纸条,他们相爱,计划一起私奔,他们相遇的洞穴是野兽的巢穴.

source: It fell upon your fieldhand and injured him mortally. Your son fought it back and slew it, but not before it landed a fatal wound.
target: 它落在你的野手身上,使他受了致命的伤害 你儿子把它击退并杀死了它,但是在它被致命的伤口击中之前

source: My son... dead. Dead for a love that I forbade... that I did not entertain as real... I cannot...
target: 我儿子死了,因为我禁止的爱情...

source: Farewell, stranger. I must bury my son and the one he gave his life for. I owe him that at least.
target: 再见,陌生人,我必须埋葬我儿子和他为他献出生命的人 至少我欠他一个

source: Your son is not here, it seems that his relationship was not just a harvest fling after all. He and your fieldhand have eloped. They left a note.
target: 你儿子不在这里,他的关系似乎不仅仅是丰收 毕竟,他和你的战地手私奔了,他们留下了一张纸条。

source: They eloped? Let me read that... I see. Did I speak so harshly that he could not confide in me? I... I truly have become my own father.
I didn't trust his decision... I was so afraid of seeing him hurt that I hurt him myself...
target: 我不敢相信他的决定 我害怕看到他受伤

source: At least in this note he says they'll return once wed, I shall make amends then. I'll start preparing the feast, gift them my largest house.
target: 至少在这张纸条里他说一旦结婚他们就会回来 我会补偿的 我会开始准备宴会 给他们我最大的房子

source: It's funny... this may be for the best, as long as my son is happy that should be enough for me. Too easily we lose sight of what matters...
target: 有意思的是,这也许是最好的, 只要我儿子高兴,那就足够了。

source: Let me know when you find them.
target: 你找到他们的时候告诉我

source: You've made your thoughts clear, we don't have anything to talk about.
target: 你把想法说清楚了 我们没什么可谈的

source: I have much to prepare. I must fatten up my best Aadi for their return!
target: 我有很多事要做,我必须养肥我最好的Aadi 为了他们回来!

source: When he returns I'll unseal the special bottle I had tucked away!
target: 当他回来时,我会解开我藏起来的特别瓶子!

source: You said half the island was cursed?
target: 你说半个小岛被诅咒了?

source: There was a note. They planned to wed.
target: 有张纸条,他们打算结婚

source: I'm sorry... for the loss of your kin.
target: 对不起... 失去你的亲人了

source: [Quest]I'll be on the lookout for them.
You drove them away, I won't bring them back.
target: 你把他们赶走,我不会带回来的

source: Your son and fieldhand are dead. A beast killed them.
target: 你儿子和野手都死了 一只野兽杀了他们

source: Your son and the fieldhand eloped together. They left this note.
target: 你儿子和野手私奔了 他们留下了这张纸条

source: Please tell me you're here to stop this nonesense...
target: 请告诉我你是来阻止这一切的...

source: Can't you hear that girl's insipid blathering?
target: 你听不到那个女孩的无声大喊吗?

source: Her "true love" is holed up in his room milking his life away and she's too daft to figure it out...
target: 她的"真爱"藏在他的房间里 挤出他的生活 她太傻了,想不通...

source: If someone doesn't stop her inane poetry soon... well I might end up vomiting over all of my perfectly good fruit!
target: 如果很快有人不阻止她 疯狂的诗歌... ...那么我可能会呕吐 在我的所有完美的水果!

source: Once I've finished picking up this mess, me and my fruit are moving far far away from this place...
target: 一旦我收拾完这烂摊子, 我和我的水果就要远离这个地方了...

source: Should have never attempted to move it all at once...
I could have sworn I picked up this exact fruit already...
target: 我发誓我已经拿了这些水果...

source: One day, I'll put the beast in her place… maybe then she’ll stop pretending she’s not desperate for my cock.

source: You...  You'd do that for me? Thank you, stranger. I best be going then, freedom awaits.
target: 你愿意为我这么做吗 谢谢 陌生人 那我还是走吧 自由在等着

source: Are your balls feeling full? I've got a slave who is desperate to drain them for you... she'll swallow the lot and beg for more.
Oh, is it her over there? Well, yes... gods, I'd gladly have her suck me dry. Well go on then, don't keep me waiting! Send her over... go, go!

target: 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 喘不过气来 咳嗽

source: It is our duty to serve.

target: 拜托... 我们需要一个主人

source: It is my honour to serve the gods.
target: 我很荣幸能为众神服务

source: What can a wretch such as I do for you?
target: 像我这样的坏蛋能为你做什么?

source: All of it... Everything leads to this...
target: 所有这一切 都导致了这个...

source: I am nothing without the desires of the gods.
target: 没有神的欲望,我什么也不是

source: My eyes and ears are open.
May I be of service to you?
To live amongst the gods... That is a true gift.
target: 活在众神之中,真是天赐之宝

source: Please, tell me what is needed of me.
I am nothing without your request.
target: 没有你的要求,我什么也不是

source: Tell me what I must do.
What do the gods wish of me?

target: 你在说那些狂热分子吗?

source: Yeah... I heard they burned a villa near Tal-Thonis... but not before they'd had their fun with the occupants.
target: 我听说他们在Tal -Thonis附近烧了别墅 但还没到他们和住户玩得开心的时候

source: I wouldn't worry about it. Most of those stories are blown out of proportion. You know how it is.
target: 我不用担心,这些故事大多都不合比例,你知道的

source: Have you been to Kusu lately?
As a matter of fact I have. Smells worse every year. The food is still worth it though.
target: 事实上,我有,每年闻起来更臭,但食物还是值得的
仍然像往常一样异国情调

source: I was visiting my sister in Tal-Senet not long ago, and there was this wonderful little poetess.
target: 不久前我在塔尔塞内特拜访了我妹妹, 有个很棒的小诗人。

source: The music was catchy and the words were... well the words were so lewd I was blushing like centaur mare in heat!
target: 音乐很流行,词也很... 词也太淫秽了,我脸红得像半人马一样热!

source: Sounds like I'll have to go see this musician for myself.
target: 看来我得亲自去见这位音乐家了

source: Let's go together after next months shipment. We're due a break anyway.
target: 下几个月发货后我们一起去吧 反正我们该休息了
看到喜欢的东西了吗,陌生人?

source: There's no finer selection of slaves in all of Sabu.
target: 萨布全市没有更精细的奴隶选择.

source: Herding is hard work, but it's worth it.
If you notice any unusual behavior from the Formless, let us know.
target: 如果你发现无形者有任何异常行为 请告诉我们

source: Remember, a happy slave means a happy master.
target: 记住,一个快乐的奴隶意味着一个快乐的主人.

source: One day I'll be a Herdmaster...
target: 总有一天我会成为牧民...

source: Found yourself a good slave yet?
The Fold has been around for thousands of years, and I wager it'll be around for another thousand.
target: 福德已经绕了几千年了 我敢打赌,还会绕上一千年

source: You'll find the best slaves here.
target: 你会找到这里最好的奴隶

source: I wonder what it's like to be a slave.
If you're looking to buy or sell, the Stockwarden can take care of you.
target: 如果你想买或卖, 斯托克沃德可以照顾你。

source: It could be worse... Could be scrubbing a Minoan's taint again...
I've been doing the same thing for far too long now.
target: 我已经做了同样的事情太久了。

source: I wonder if they'll let me be an entertainment slave instead...
target: 不知道他们会不会让我当个娱乐奴隶...

source: One of us got crushed by a stone the other day... They just... carried on... like nothing happened.
target: 那天我们中有人被石头压碎了 他们继续...

source: The sooner we finish building here, the better.
target: 我们越早完成这里的建设,越好。

source: Sorry, I shouldn't stop to talk.
target: 对不起,我不该停下来说话

source: The masters usually spend their time inside the gardens. I assume you're looking for them?
target: 主人们通常都在花园里度过时光 我猜你是在找他们吧?

source: Stone, stone and more stone. I'm getting tired of stone.
target: 石头,石头和更多的石头,我厌倦了石头.

source: The work is tedious, but it could be worse.
target: 工作很乏味,但可能会更糟。
我的背好痛,我快没命了

source: All of this hard work, when it will all be dust one day. Why do we do it?
target: 所有这一切辛勤工作,当有一天,一切都会变成尘土,我们为什么要这样做呢?

source: I can't be seen talking with you. It's not time to rest yet.
target: 我不能被看见跟你说话,现在还不能休息

source: Unless you want to trade places with me, stranger, I suggest you don't let the Herders see you interrupting my work.
target: 除非你想和我交换地方 陌生人 我建议你别让牧民看到你打断我的工作

source: I'm much happier here than tending to the merchants. The rock never asks you to pluck hairs from its arse.
target: 我在这里比照顾商人更快乐 岩石从来不要求你从它的屁股上拔毛

source: There's not an issue with my work, is there?
target: 我的工作没有问题,是吗?

source: If you wish to speak with someone who matters, look for the masters.
target: 欲与有要者议,寻诸师子.

source: One day I'll make it down to the river. One day...
target: 总有一天我会赶到河边,有一天...

source: Master? Master Turo? Where are you?
target: 师父,图罗师父,你在哪里?

source: Master Turoooo! It's time for my walkies!
target: 杜鲁大师,我该用对讲机了

source: Have you seen my master? Master Turo? He's been gone for ages and missed taking me for my daily walk... I'm starting to worry...
target: 你见过我师父吗 图罗大人 他走了好几年了 错过了我每天的散步

source: You will? Oh, thank you so much kind stranger! He could be anywhere, but he usually spends time in the busier parts of the fold.
target: 他可能去任何地方,但他通常在更繁忙的地方呆着。

source: What can you tell me about your master?
target: 你能告诉我关于你的主人什么?

source: Well, he always takes me for my walk at the same time everyday. He's really done his best to take care of me since my, erm, capture?
target: 他每天都带我散步 他真的尽力照顾我 自从我...

source: Silly to think I looked down on this kind of life... Anyway, erm, he's usually very busy. Always meeting someone for business of one sort or another.
target: 傻的以为我看不起这种生活...

source: He makes a lot of notes, never goes anywhere without his journal. Oh, and he likes when I lick that area between his balls and his butthole.
target: 他写了很多笔记,没有他的日记就哪儿都去不了。 哦,他喜欢我舔他的蛋蛋和屁眼之间的区域。

source: I'm sorry, but I couldn't find your master. All I could find was his journal.
target: 抱歉,我找不到你的主人 我只能找到他的日记

source: That can't be good... Oh.... Something bad must have happened to him. Now who's going to take me for my walks?
target: 肯定出事了 现在谁来带我散步?

source: You think to pull the wool over this one's eyes?
target: 你想把羊毛拉过这只眼睛吗?

source: N-no, sir! Never! Of course not!
target: 不,先生,绝对不行,当然不行

source: This Formless is worth that much, I promise you!
target: 我向你保证,这个无形无形值这么多钱!

source: Hmmm... The stench leads one to believe otherwise...
The smell isn't coming from the Formless though!
Oh? Then what, do you propose, is the source of this horrid odor?
target: 哦 那你建议说 这种可怕的味道的来源是什么?

source: Hmmm... This one thinks you will do nicely in one's collection.
target: 这个家伙认为你会在收藏品中表现的很好

source: Yes she's very ni- wait... are you talking about me?
target: 是的,她非常... 等等... 你在说我吗?

source: Tell one how much gold is required.
target: 告诉一个需要多少黄金。

source: I, erm... Many deep apologies, merchant lord, but I'm not for sale.
target: 我,呃,我深表歉意,大商人, 但我不卖。

source: Surely we can come to an agreement, no? Your hands are the perfect size for what one has in mind...
target: 当然我们可以达成协议,不是吗?

source: No, erm... No, I am afraid I'll have to pass on your offer. These hands are made for tending to the flock.
target: 不,恐怕我不得不接受你的邀请 这些手是用来照顾羊群的

source: This one knows all have a price...
This one does not mingle with... riffraff...
I suppose I did this to myself...
target: 我想我这样做是对自己...

source: Looking for my master? Should be around here somewhere.
target: 找我的主人吗 应该在这附近

source: Being a slave isn't so bad, but you didn't hear that from me.
target: 做奴隶不是那么糟 但你没从我这里听到

source: When life gives you yellow fruit, you make yellow fruit wine, right?
target: 当生命给你黄色水果, 你做黄色水果葡萄酒,对不对?

source: Being a slave is hard, but being a master is harder. At least, I think...
target: 做奴隶很难,但做主人更难,至少我认为...

source: Tired of how hard life can be? Try finding yourself a good master.
I see you, looking at me like that.
Can't imagine why I ever fought the idea of being a slave.
target: 无法想象我为什么会反抗做奴隶的想法.

source: When I think about it, the Gilded Fold really turned my life around for the better.
target: 当我想到它,吉尔德·福德 真正改变了我的生活 以更好的。

source: Sure glad I have somewhere nice to stay.
target: 很高兴我有个好地方待着

source: I heard there are people out there trying to end slavery. Can you imagine? Everything would fall apart.
target: 听说有人想结束奴隶制 你能想象吗?

source: You ever look up at the clouds and try to find animal shapes in them? Maybe it's just me...
target: 你曾经仰望过云 试图在云中找到动物的形状?

source: I won't do it again. I promise, master.
target: 我不会再这样了 我保证 主人

source: Oh but I know you will. You enjoy being chased. And caught...
target: 我知道你会的,你喜欢被追,被捉...

source: I'm onto you, you little minx. I know you're playing games with me.
target: 我盯上你了,你这个小笨蛋 我知道你在跟我玩游戏

source: So what will you do then, master? What will you do to punish me?
target: 那你怎么办 主人 你要怎么惩罚我

source: Hmmm a good question... What should I do with you?
target: 问得好,我该怎么处置你?

source: It would be terrible if you left me dangling here, all tied up and helpless... And then...
target: 如果你把我丢在这里,会很可怕, 被绑起来,无助,然后...

source: Oh? Is that what my runaway slut wants?
target: 哦,这就是我逃跑的荡妇想要的吗?

source: N-no master... d-don't torment me for being such a naughty servant...
target: 不,不,主人... 不要因为我是个淘气的仆人而折磨我

source: Standing here all day in this heat... sure is thirsty work.
target: 整天站在这热闹... 肯定就是干渴的工作.

source: Could go for a drink right about now...
Any more parched and I'd drink the sweat off a Minoan's sack...
target: 再有口渴,我会喝米诺安的麻袋里的汗...

source: Gods, I'm parched. I'll be looking like a dried fruit soon. Say, you mind doing me a favour and bringing me something to drink?
target: 天啊,我快渴死了,我快看起来像干果了,你介意帮我个忙 带点喝的给我吗?

source: There should be some wine in one of the carts around here. Thanks in advance, friend.
target: 这里的一辆货车应该有酒 事先谢谢 朋友

source: My saviour, thank you. I won't forget your generosity.
target: 我的救世主 谢谢 我不会忘记你的慷慨

source: Excuse me, but I'm looking for someone who works here. A Herder named Turo? I was supposed to meet him for a trade in merchandise today.
target: 抱歉,我要找一个在这里工作的人 一个叫图罗的牧民?

source: No, sorry. I'm actually looking for him as well.
target: 不,对不起,我其实也在找他

source: Damn the fates. Well, thanks anyway.
The Fold really do have the finest slaves in all of Sabu, wouldn't you agree?
target: 福德真的有萨布最好的奴隶,你同意吗?

source: I can't get enough of this one...
Sorry, but do you mind? I'm trying to enjoy the show.
Every move is just so... tantalising...
target: 每一步都那么... 令人发指...

source: You won't get entertainment like this anywhere else.
target: 你到别的地方都不会有这种娱乐的

source: I'll have to come here more often.
If you're looking for a conversation, you won't find one here.
target: 如果你在找一个谈话, 你在这里不会找到一个。

source: You know, it's considered impolite to interrupt a slave-watching session.
target: 你知道,这被认为是不礼貌的 打断一个看奴隶的会议。

source: If only I had enough gold to take this one home with me.
target: 如果我有足够的金子 带这个回家。

source: Sorry, did you want something? I'm rather busy.
How does the Gilded Fold do it?
target: 吉尔德·福尔德是如何做到的?

source: Never in my life have I seen such beauty... I'll have to make this slave my own some day...
target: 我这辈子从未见过这么美的...

source: You must be new here. Come, sit, and enjoy the slaves touching themselves for us.
target: 你一定是新来的,过来,坐下来,享受奴隶们为我们摸自己吧

source: It's like being in Keth-Eros, isn't it?
The things these slaves can do... I simply can't take my eyes off of them.
target: 这些奴隶能做的 我无法从他们眼皮底下消失

source: It's nice getting a break from the day-to-day.
They're like sweet honey for the eyes.
target: 它们就像甜蜜 眼睛。

source: I'm going to have to take care of myself after this...
target: 之后我必须照顾好自己...

source: You. You're late. Get inside and assist the priestess at once.
target: 你,你迟到了,马上进去协助女祭司

source: You've come to the wrong place, cat-worshipper!
I'm sorry, but I can't allow you any further. This tomb is now claimed by The Path, and only followers of Anubis are permitted to enter.
target: 抱歉,我不能让你再继续了 现在这个坟墓被The Path所宣称 只有阿努比斯的追随者才能进入

source: This place gives me the creeps.
Keep your eyes open for danger.
The archenemy is here! Kill them!
How did you get in here, outsider? Leave, now, or we will make you leave.
You had your chance to obey. Now you die!
target: 你有机会服从,现在你死了!

source: I swear there's something else in here...
target: 我发誓这里还有别的东西...

source: You again, what do you need?
You know there's a dead guy over there, right?
target: 你知道那边有个死人吧?

source: Another one? Why in the Five Hells does this shit happen when I'm on shift. Unbelievable.
target: 又一个 为什么在五地狱里 我值班的时候会发生这种事

source: Let me guess. Stabbed, strange markings cut into the flesh?
target: 让我猜猜 被刺伤的 奇怪的标记切入了肉体?

source: Are you with the City Watch?
You know we've met before right...? Yes, I'm with the Watch.
target: 你知道我们以前见过面吗?

source: Try to stay out of trouble this time.
Now that you mention it... Yeah, there were some symbols carved on the body.
I knew it. I fucking knew it. Someone up there really has it in for me.
target: 我就知道,我他妈的知道 有人真的有它给我。

source: First I'm lumped with command of a bunch of horny layabouts; now I'm stuck dealing with a ritual killer. Just my luck.
target: 先是指挥一群淫荡的仆人,现在我只能面对一个仪式杀手,只是我的运气

source: Do you know what the symbols mean?
target: 你知道符号是什么意思吗?

source: Honestly, I don't care. It's not as though knowing the reasoning of some unhinged murderer will make the victim any less dead.
target: 老实说,我不在乎,知道一个杀人犯的推理 会让受害者死得更惨

source: The symbols might be important though...
You're not going to take no for an answer are you? Fine, makes no difference to me...
target: 你不会接受拒绝的答案吧?

source: The person who found Khaa, the first victim, was a scribe. She was freaking out about the symbol.
target: 找到第一个受害者Khaa的人是文士 她对这个符号感到害怕

source: At least I assumed she was. Come to think of it she may have been freaking out because his entrails were all over the...
target: 至少我猜她是,想起来她可能吓坏了 因为他的内脏都满...

source: Nevermind. The point is you can talk to her if you must. Pale Draconid lady. I've seen her before, possibly works up at the temple.
target: 重点是如果你需要的话你可以跟她谈谈 白粉色的女士 我以前见过她 可能在神庙工作过

source: So... what do we do now?
target: 那么... 我们现在怎么办?

source: We? I can't spare anyone to trail around after some unknown lunatic. The Watch are spread thin just trying to guard the markets.
target: 我无法放过任何人去追一个未知的疯子 守望者为了守护市场而四处奔波

source: Especially thin considering half my watchmen are probably horizontal at the moment. The other half are almost certainly watching.
target: 特别是考虑到我一半的守望者 很可能是横向的,另一半几乎肯定在看。

source: If you want to stalk this killer be my guest, I'll even throw some coin and a good time your way if you catch them.
target: 如果你想跟踪这个凶手,我也会扔一些硬币 如果你抓住他们,我会好好享受你的生活

source: ...on the understanding that I caught them. That goes without saying really.
target: 以我抓到他们的理解,这不言而喻

source: I'll find the killer, and bring them to justice.
target: 我会找到凶手 把他们绳之以法
你回来了,有什么新消息吗?

source: Any hints on how to find this person?
target: 有关于如何找到这个人的提示吗?

source: I'd start at the dead body, if I were you. Maybe, I don't know, ask around a bit? Try looking for clues or where they went?
target: 如果我是你,我会从尸体开始 也许,我不知道,四处打听一下?

source: You certain you're cut out for this? Nobody is making you do this, you do know that... right?
target: 你确定你被淘汰了吗 没人要你这么做 你知道...

source: I'm more than happy to write it up as a robbery and move on, if you change your mind.
target: 我很乐意把它写成抢劫 继续前进 如果你改变主意的话

source: What are you doing to help find the killer?
target: 你做什么来帮助找到凶手?

source: I'm sorry, I didn't realise I reported to you. Oh wait, I don't. Go on then, piss off.
target: 抱歉,我没意识到我向你报告过 等等,我不报告,你走吧,滚开

source: So then, got a result for me?
So there was this ancient tome and it-
target: 所以有一个古老的汤姆,它 -

source: You know what, forget I asked. I don't want to know... so long as there's no more killings that's good enough for me!
target: 忘了我问吧,我不想知道...

source: Not now, I'm up to my neck in it....
You know there's a dead guy over there, right?
target: 你知道那边有个死人吧?

source: Are you with the City Watch?
Do you know what the symbols mean?
target: 你知道符号是什么意思吗?

source: The symbols might be important though...
So... what do we do now?
target: 那么... 我们现在怎么办?

source: [Quest]I'll find the killer, and bring them to justice.
target: 我会找到凶手 把他们绳之以法

source: Any hints on how to find this person?
target: 有关于如何找到这个人的提示吗?

source: What are you doing to help find the killer?
target: 你做什么来帮助找到凶手?

source: So there was this ancient tome...
I'm hunting a thief. Have you seen anything?
target: 我在追捕小偷 你看见什么了吗?

source: Oh gods, those two put you up to this didn't they?
target: 哦,上帝,那两个 让你这样做,不是吗?

source: The two guards at the fork in the road sent me.
target: 路叉那两个卫士送我来.

source: Of course they did, lazy fuckers. Far too busy looking for a tight hole to cum inside, can't possibly do their damned jobs!
target: 当然了,懒惰的混蛋,太忙了 找一个很紧的洞,不能干他们该死的活儿!

source: What in the five hells did they promise you? Must be good to have you traipsing around on this wild hunt.
Now that you mention it, I don't think they offered me anything. I just agreed.
target: 既然你提了,我想他们没给我任何东西,我刚同意了

source: Don't worry, you're not the first. Tell you what, if you do catch the pickpocket I'll put in a good word for you at the temple.
target: 别担心,你不是第一个 告诉你,如果你抓到那个扒手 我会在庙里给你写个好词

source: It's not much but I won't make you bend over to get it either, which is more than I can say of that pair.
target: 不多,但我不会让你弯腰去得到它, 这比我能说那对。

source: So you'll put in a good word for me?
target: 所以你会为我写一个好词吗?

source: Sure. I mean it's not like I'm a big dog up there, excuse the pun, but I'm held in some esteem by the temple guard.
target: 当然,我的意思是,我不是一只大狗 在那里,原谅双关语, 但我有些尊重 由寺庙守卫。

source: Might not come to much, but it's never a bad thing to be spoken of well by the guards.
target: 可能没什么大不了的 但警卫们说得好 从来都不是件坏事

source: What if I want you to bend me over?
target: 如果我要你弯我一下呢?

source: Well if you ask nicely then I might be persuaded to detain you for a while... discreetly of course. Perhaps I'll demand a bribe to let you go free...
target: 如果你问得好,我可能会被说服拘留你一段时间...

source: G-gods... I mean... aahh! Y-you'll need to do b-better than this- nnah!
Hnnh! I th-thought you said you could b-break m-me?
target: 我想你说过可以打碎我?

source: C-come on then! Sh-show me -ahh- w-what you've got!
target: 来啊,给我看看,你有什么!

source: Getting t-tired? Unnh! I c-can keep this up all d-day!
G-gods... yes... t-test me... just d-don't stop!
target: 神啊... 是的... 考验我...

source: If this is heresy... c-call me a f-fucking heretic! Unnh!
W-why would I -ahh- why w-would I r-resist this?
target: 我为什么要... 我为什么要... 坚持下去?

source: H-how can th-this be part of the c-curse... f-fuck!
target: 怎么会... 这是c -curse的一部分... 他妈的!

source: Y-you just h-had to ask... gods!
target: 你... 你... 不得不问...

source: Hnh! Test m-me again! O-over and -ohh!- over!
Oh fuck... fuck! Hnnnnhnngh! Gah-hahn... hah...
Eugh... foul! I thought you were more resilient than that... but no matter, I have little time for such games anyway.
target: 讨厌,我以为你比那更有韧性...

source: Goodbye, heretic. May your death be slow.
target: 再见,异教徒,愿你的死慢一点

source: Wait, you're just going to leave me here?? Fuck...
target: 等等,你就把我丢在这儿?

source: Eugh! D-disgusting! I should kill you for that... But I've wasted enough time on you as it is.
target: 真恶心,我应该杀了你 但我已经浪费了足够多的时间

source: Goodbye, heretic. May your death be slow.
target: 再见,异教徒,愿你的死慢一点

source: Wait, you're just going to leave me here?? Fuck...
target: 等等,你就把我丢在这儿?

source: Eugh! How dare you get off whilst I'm... argh! I should kill you for that... But I've wasted enough time on you as it is.
Goodbye, heretic. May your death be slow.
target: 再见,异教徒,愿你的死慢一点

source: Wait, you're just going to leave me here?? Fuck...
target: 等等,你就把我丢在这儿?

source: You clearly, hahh- don't know what you're doing. I'm not even close!
target: 你很清楚,我不知道你在干嘛,我甚至不亲近!

source: I don't have time for this! You and your games are only wasting my time. I have what I need as it is. Enjoy dying slowly, heretic.
target: 你和你的游戏只是在浪费我的时间,我拥有我所需要的东西,慢慢的去死,异教徒

source: Wait, you're just going to leave me here?? Fuck...
target: 等等,你就把我丢在这儿?

source: [Fight] Back down or I'll put you down.
target: [法 退后,否则我把你放下。

source: Go. Return to your handler... bring them the news that today Bast revels in our victory over The Jackal.
target: 回到你的管理者那里 给他们带来消息 今天Bast在我们的胜利中欢呼

source: The time of the Anubis is over... The time of Bastet's chosen has come...
target: 阿努比家族的时代已经结束了 巴斯特被选中的时代已经来临了

source: The will of Bast is tantamount to righteousness.
target: 巴斯特的意志相当于正义.

source: Hold it right there! I take it you're the one responsible for all of these dead heretics? Hmm, nicely done...
target: 别动,你应该为这些死异端负责吧?

source: Hold it right there! Don't you know the penalty for trespassing on sacred ground is death?
target: 你难道不知道在神圣的地盘上非法侵入的惩罚是死刑吗?

source: Look, I'm one of you. I'm an Inquisitor. Or... almost one, anyway.
target: 听着,我是你们的一员,我是宗教裁判所的,或者...

source: It was given to me by another Inquisitor. Her name is Tefahra.
target: 是另一个审讯官给我的 她叫特法赫拉

source: I am unfamiliar with the name... but there are many of us. Tell me, how did you come about earning the favour of this... Inquisitor Tefahra?
target: 我对这个名字不熟悉,但是我们有很多人,告诉我,你是怎么得到这个...

source: I slaughtered an entire Anubite encampment. They had fallen to their own lust and had to be put down.
target: 我宰了整个阿努比特人营地 他们已经屈服于自己的欲望 不得不被击落

source: A necessary act. I've found that killing the fallen is often the only way to truly save them from themselves...
target: 有必要的行为,我发现 杀死死者往往是真正拯救他们自己的唯一办法...

source: I suppose I won't kill you after all... but you should leave this place and return to the one who sent you.
target: 我想我不会杀你 但你应该离开这个地方 回到派你来的那个人身边

source: I ended an Anubite ritual orgy through my will alone. They fled before me like cowardly dogs.
target: 我独自通过遗嘱结束了一次阿努比特仪式,他们像懦夫狗一样逃到我面前。

source: My... that is impressive. It's not often they are even capable of hearing our words... their ears filled with the honeyed lies of Kethra's whelp.
target: 他们甚至不常听到我们的话 他们的耳朵充斥着Kethra的谎言

source: I beat an Anubite priestess at her own game.  In the face of my devotion to Bast her lust was like a candle in a storm...
target: 我打败了一位阿努比特女祭司 面对我对巴斯的奉献 她的欲望就像暴风雨中的蜡烛

source: I see... you should tread carefully when facing heretics in such a way. But if what you say is true, I am impressed...
target: 你这样面对异教徒时应该小心行事 但如果你说的是真的,我很佩服...
这是我的事... 独自一人

source: Hmm... spoken like a true inquisitor. I see the hatred in your eyes... that hunger for righteous justice. You are truly one of us.
target: 我看见你眼中充满了对正义的渴望 你才是我们的一员

source: We have everything under control here Inquisitor.
target: 我们这里的审讯官已经掌握了一切

source: It is doubly a blessing, finding this place. Both a victory over the fetid jackal cult, and a new base of operations in the region.
target: 找到这个地方是双倍的祝福,它既是对野狼邪教的胜利,也是该地区新的行动基地。

source: The Inquisition will make an outpost of this tomb--a foothold in our war against the heretics.  To the victor, the spoils.
target: 宗教裁判所会把这座坟墓作为前哨 成为我们对抗异教徒的战线 对胜利者来说 战利品

source: I am Karo, an Inquisitor of Bast. Mark my name, for you will hear it uttered in despair by countless heretics... each final breath a testament to my purity.
target: 我是卡罗,巴斯的宗教裁判官,请记下我的名字,因为你会听到无数异教徒在绝望中说出这个名字...

source: We've met before... Do you not remember me?
Hmm? No... I can't recall. To evade the notice of others is a gift for an Inquisitor... the unseen blade cuts the deepest.
target: 我记不得了 逃避别人的注意 是给一个宗教裁判所的礼物

source: So... You don't know who Tefahra is?
target: 你不知道谁是特法赫拉?

source: No, I don't. She's likely a member of little renown... though, even the worm has a role to play in the grand scheme.
target: 不,我不知道,她可能是一个小名人的成员...

source: I should report back to Tefahra...
I stopped an Anubite ritual orgy...
target: 我阻止了一次阿努比特仪式的狂欢...
我打败了一位阿努比特女祭司...

source: Yes, I see! These inscriptions definitely pre-date Hatha, Sobeq even... perhaps... Kethra herself? But the calligraphy...
Hmmm... appears to be a copy of an even earlier text... If I could somehow cross-reference just a couple of these symbols with...
target: 嗯... 似乎是更早的文本的复制品...

source: ... the precursor relic uncovered by Suvan in the... wait, who are you? What do you want?
Well, what does it look like? Can't you see I'm busy? If you're here with my canine fangs you can just leave them on the table.
Esi said I'd find you here.
target: 艾西说在这里会找到你的

source: Esi eh? A name that brings back memories. Heart of a lioness, but much too callow. Tell me, is she well?
target: 狮子的心,但太迟钝了 告诉我,她还好吗?

source: How do I know her? I raised the girl! Feels like an age since I found her in that cave, hungry and alone.
I pitied her, she'd been through a lot and was old beyond her years... she had no memory of the time before I found her.
target: 我可怜她,她经历了很多 并且已经老了超过她的岁数... 她不记得了我找到她之前的时间。

source: I know that got to her, the blank papyrus where her story should be. She was keen to write of her own deeds... her own path
target: 我知道这让她想起了 写她故事的空洞的帕皮鲁斯 她热衷于写自己的作品

source: Too keen, it has to be said. I tried my best, I really did. In the end... it was her who abandoned me. There's a kind of poetry to it.
Oh, the Void? Well it's nothing really... I mean obviously I have one or two notions.
target: 哦,Void,其实没什么,我的意思是...

source: Esi was attacked by something invulnerable to her weapons. She said it was almost like the children's stories of The Void.
target: Esi被她武器不可抗拒的东西攻击,她说这几乎跟The Void的儿童故事一样.

source: So they can still cross over... or perhaps they've been trapped here all this time... I knew it! If they can enter our world then it-
target: 所以他们仍然可以越过... 或者也许他们一直被困在这里...

source: Beings of the Void my child, creatures from outside of reality. Some evil, others benevolent, but all powerful beyond measure!
target: 我孩子的凡人,来自现实以外的生物,有些邪恶,有些仁慈,但都强大到无法衡量的程度!

source: It's possible, if the inscriptions I've discovered are to be believed. The results could be... unpredictable.
target: 如果能相信那些我发现的铭文 结果是无法预料的

source: I've spent some time studying a structure not far from here... almost nothing left of it but spectacular nonetheless.
target: 我花了一段时间研究一个离这里不远的结构... 几乎什么都没有了,不过很壮观。

source: You can't miss it. From here, travel south. Just beyond the field of stones, an old path still runs up the cliffside.
target: 从这里出发,往南走,在石头之野外, 一条老路仍然沿着悬崖边走

source: Somewhere inside the temple lies a gateway... though it seems admission to the Void was once a matter of some ceremony.
target: 寺庙里面的某个地方有个入口... 虽然它似乎承认了Void 曾经是一个仪式的问题。

source: You will need to do your best to restore order in the temple, if you are to activate the doorway.
target: 若要激活门道,则需要尽力恢复寺庙秩序.

source: Anyway, you should see where it leads... perhaps there you'll find the answers you seek.
target: 总之,你应该看看它通向何处... 或许在那里你会找到你想要的答案

source: Travel to the void? Good heavens no, I'm far too busy researching if it even exists! There are many truths yet to be unearthed.
But you're serious about this, aren't you? Well, I have a favour to ask.
Across the river is a bustling little market village. My servant lives there and, much like you, she is engrossed with that temple.
target: 河对岸是一个繁忙的小集市村,我的仆人住在那里,和你一样,她被那座寺庙所缠绕。

source: I've heard nothing since my return, and our list of work is piling up. Fetch her for me, and I'll allow you to seek her counsel.
target: 自从我回来之后,我再没听到过什么,我们的工作清单堆积不下,帮我把她找来,我允许你去找她的建议.

source: I'm sorry, I found your servant, dead...
target: 对不起,我找到你的仆人死了...

source: Dead? No she... I should've known... a tragic end for one so gentle...
Thank you. You may keep her notes for yourself, perhaps they will help your journey... I have little need for them now.
target: 谢谢,你可以留着她的笔记,也许可以帮助你的旅程...

source: Scribe... What can you tell me of the Void?
target: Scribe 你能告诉我什么是Void吗?

source: I found a... Void construct. I need to know how to destroy it.
target: 我找到一个虚拟结构 我需要知道如何摧毁它

source: Esi said I'd find you here.
target: 艾西说在这里会找到你的

source: Scribe... What can you tell me of the Void?
target: Scribe 你能告诉我什么是Void吗?

source: I'm sorry, I found your servant, dead...
target: 对不起,我找到你的仆人死了...

source: Argh! Don't leave me here like this!
Gods, why? Why you? Why us...?
target: 为什么是你 为什么是我们...

source: I... I'll make them pay, Papa... Every last one of them...
target: 我会让他们付出代价的 爸爸 每一个都...

source: Sorry won't bring him back... Sorry... won't punish those responsible...
But... the ones who did this... They're already dead...
target: 但是... 凶手已经死了...

source: There are more like them out there. Mindless zealots like these who deserve nothing but death... and I will bring it to them...
target: 外面还有更多的像他们这样的狂热分子, 他们应该死,我会带给他们的...

source: Thank you for your help, but I need to be alone now. Please...
target: 谢谢你的帮助 但我现在需要一个人

source: N-no Papa! You can't die! Don't leave me!
target: 不 爸爸 你不能死 别离开我
杀了他们 P 请杀了他们

source: Hmph- Begone... This one is busy.
You see how this one's darling Neftahra becomes so easily flustered. She will give herself to this one again. She simply cannot help it.
target: 你看,这个可爱的尼夫塔赫拉 变得如此容易。她会再次把自己交给这个。她根本无法自拔。

source: N-no! I am not flustered! I'm furious! Ugh!
Come now... Prostrate yourself before this one, and service him as is your place.
target: 来,在你面前叩头,像你们一样为他服务

source: Hnngh- at last... another hole from The Fold claimed by this one...
target: Hnngh终于... 终于... 从这个房子的"封面"里又开了个洞...

source: Too much? Mmmmyes, "gilded" pet, but... you've made your choice... Now you must- hahhh- lay with it. Mmhmhmhm...
target: 太多了吗? 嗯,"被打"的宠物,但是...

source: S-so much.... too much.... h-hahh- mmmgh-
G-gods, why did I agree to this? Hnnnngh-!
Hmhmhm... That's good... Sing for me.... Mmmh-
Auuhhh fuck! S-so much seed! Y-you could- nngh- fill the Euphoris!
target: 他妈的,这么多种子,你可以...

source: Mmmh- yes... all of it for you, pet... Mmngh-
Mmmh- That was... pleasant enough. A Minoan of his word, this one will resume the previously agreed upon tax rate for slave trade through Kusu.
target: 说得太好了,这个会恢复以前商定的通过库苏 贩卖奴隶的税率

source: So, it seems you're stranded here on this island?
target: 看来你被困在这岛上了?

source: ...and the boat is to leave the island?
What do you know about the ruins just up from the beach, they look recent.
target: 你对海滩上的废墟了解多少? 它们看起来很近

source: So, it seems you're stranded here on this island?
target: 看来你被困在这岛上了?

source: ...and the boat is to leave the island?
You don't talk much, do you?
He gets like that... when he really wants to fuck. I think it's something to do with all the blood rushing somewhere other than his head...
target: 他真的想干的时候就那样了 我想这和他头部以外的血流成河有关

source: What do you know about the ruins just up from the beach, they look recent.
target: 你对海滩上的废墟了解多少? 它们看起来很近

source: You don't talk much, do you?
He gets like that... when he really wants to fuck. I think it's something to do with all the blood rushing somewhere other than his head...
target: 他真的想干的时候就那样了 我想这和他头部以外的血流成河有关

source: Gets like that when he... oh, he wants to fuck me? All he had to do was ask.
target: 他想和我上床时就那样了?

source: Gets like that when he... oh, you mean he wants to make a broodmare of me?
target: 他这样想... 哦,你是说 他想为我做个小事?

source: Well, what are you waiting for?
Gets like that when he... oh, well then he'd better kneel down...
target: 那样的话... 哦,那么他最好跪下...

source: Want to fill me up again?
Then what are you waiting for?
You'd better kneel down if I'm going to fuck you.
target: 你最好跪下,如果我要他妈的你。
我... 花光了 我... 花光了 我...

source: What in the goddess' name is this?! It's so raw you could set it on the ground and it would run away!
target: 女神的名字是什么 这么生动的你可以把它放地上 然后它会逃跑

source: Are you going to add anything to that soup? At this rate it probably tastes like water with a hint of disappointment!
If you were trying to make a mess, congratulations, you've succeeded beyond belief!
target: 如果你是想搞砸,恭喜,你已经成功超越了信仰!

source: My blind grandmother cooks faster than you!
target: 我瞎婆娘做的比你们快!

source: You're not a chef. You're a culinary catastrophe waiting to happen!
target: 你不是厨师,你是个厨师

source: You. Are. Hopeless, you fucking aadi!
target: 你,是的,没有希望,你他妈的Aadi!

source: You're late! Get to your station, and make me an appetiser. A fruit medley. Ingredients are on the table. Let's go!
target: 你迟到了,快去车站 给我做个小菜一碟 水果药 原料都放在桌上了,走吧!

source: Get to your station, and make me an appetiser. A fruit medley. Ingredients are on the table. Let's go!
target: 到你的车站,给我做个餐具,水果药,食品在桌子上,我们走!

source: Let's have a taste, shall we? I can't believe it... You've done it. You've managed to ruin fruit!
target: 尝尝吧,真不敢相信 你成功了,你毁了水果!

source: Never in all my years have I seen such a catastrophe of a platter! You might as well give up on any dreams you had of becoming a chef.
target: 我这几年从未见过如此惨烈的盘子!

source: No! I don't want to hear it. Cook me some Emerald Skewers, and try not to be such a fuck-up this time!
target: 不,我不想听,给我煮点翡翠雪糕, 这次别这么操蛋!

source: Cook me some Emerald Skewers, and try not to be such a fuck-up this time!
target: 帮我煮点翡翠花 试一下这次别这么乱来

source: Finished with those skewers are you? Looks okay, but let's see how they taste... Mm- *cough* blegh!
target: 你吃完了吗 看起来还不错 但让我们看看他们的味道

source: Kethra's tits! If I wanted you to make a fish jerky I would've said so. These skewers are as dry as my sandals!
target: Kethra的奶子,我要你做个鱼肉干,我早就说过了,这些烤肉和我的凉鞋一样干!

source: Are you fucking proud of yourself?
target: 你他妈的为自己骄傲吗?

source: Well, no you see I'm not actually-
No excuses! You get one last chance to prove yourself. Make me some candied nunut. Go on then, get to it!
target: 别找借口,你还有最后一次机会证明自己 帮我弄点甜头来,去吧

source: Make me some candied nunut. Go on then, get to it!
target: 来点甜甜的 去吧 去吧!

source: Show me what you've got. Even an idiot could make some decent candied nunut... Hmm... hm- ptew! I stand corrected!
target: 给我看看你有什么,连个白痴都做不出什么好东西...

source: Oh, erm... What's wrong with it?
What... What's wrong with it?! I can't even begin to tell you what's wrong with it! Take my advice, and step away from the cooking pit, forever.
target: 我甚至不能开始告诉你什么是错的 接受我的建议,永远远离烹饪坑

source: Get out of my sight! Oh and while you're out, maybe go find some melinh and apologise to them for ruining the honey they worked so hard to make!
target: 滚出我的视线! 哦,当你出去的时候,也许去找些麦林 并道歉他们毁了他们努力制造的蜂蜜!

source: What in the hells is going on here?
Hey you! Y-yeah you! You have to save them! I would, only... the key's at the bottom of the Euphoris!
target: 嘿,你,你必须救他们,我只会...

source: I thought I was dead for sure!
Ugh, my wraps are all soaked!
What will happen to them now?
Whatever Bast desires of them. They are in her hands now...
target: 无论巴斯特想要什么,现在他们都掌握在她手中...

source: I can't swim... you'll have to do it! You don't want them to drown do you?
target: 我不会游泳的,你必须这么做 你不想让他们淹死吧?

source: What are you waiting for? They're drowning... you've got to save them!
target: 你们还在等什么 他们淹死了 你们得救他们

source: What will happen to them now?
Y-you did it! I mean, I knew you could do it, of course! Thank you friend. I'll be sure to get these slaves to their proper owners.
target: 当然,我知道你们能做到的,谢谢朋友,我会把这些奴隶 带到他们真正的主人那里去的

source: You will die for your heresy!
You should not have defied Bast's mercy!
target: 你不应该违抗巴斯的慈悲!

source: Bast breaks their bonds, I will break you!
target: 巴斯打破他们的债券, 我会打破你!

source: Y-you did it! I mean, I knew you could do it, of course! Thank you friend. I'll be sure to get these slaves to their proper owners.
target: 当然,我知道你们能做到的,谢谢朋友,我会把这些奴隶 带到他们真正的主人那里去的

source: What have we here... hmm? Offering aid to the helpless? How noble of you...
target: 我们这里有什么 向无助的人提供援助?

source: Hey, what are you doing here? S-stay back, you!
You save them from the cooking pot only to cast them into the fire... The mewling wretch is a slaver, after all...
target: 你把他们从锅里救出来 只是为了把他们扔进火里...

source: Help me free the rest of these... poor things. I will ensure they are truly... free.
target: 帮我解脱这些可怜的东西 我会确保它们真正...

source: Okay, let's free the slaves together.
target: 好吧,让我们一起释放奴隶。

source: What?? H-hey! Those are property of the Gilded Fold!

No Mera, I mean I want to be with you...

I'll slip away whilst their backs are turned. Once you're done, come find me. But don't make me wait too long...
target: 等他们转身的时候我会溜走 一旦你搞定了,就来找我,但别让我等太久...

target: 听起来很简单,你要去哪里?

target: 我还没知道,我会看看我能走多远,祝你好运...

I'm sure you could have. You slipped away awfully quick!
target: 我敢肯定,你可以的,你溜得很快!

source: I'm thinking Kusu... There's opportunity there, as long as you don't end up slung beneath a Minoan's belly of course.
target: 我想久秀,只要你不会在米诺安的肚子下沉下去,就有机会了

source: Perhaps you'll visit me there... who knows, I may have my own bakery.
target: 也许你可以去那儿看我 谁知道呢 我可能有自己的面包店

source: Well, I'm glad you made it out safely, Mera. You take care of yourself okay?
target: 我很高兴你平安无事,梅拉,你保重

source: W-wait... erm... I was thinking... maybe... now that I'm not under Mother's thumb, we could... you know...
target: 等等 我在想... 也许...

source: I'm sorry, Mera. I'm happy to help earn your freedom as your friend, but I can't be more than that.
target: 对不起,梅拉,我很高兴能帮你挣取自由

target: 我当然不理解 我想库苏总有米诺安人吧?

source: I'm sorry, I just don't want you in that way.
target: 对不起,我只是不希望你这样。

source: Don't be sorry, I'm still thankful for everything you did for me. I... guess I should get going. Until we meet again...
target: 别抱歉,我还是很感激你为我所做的一切 我想我该走了,直到我们再见面...

source: It's so strange being free of Mother... the whole world ahead of me.
target: 离母亲而去... 我前面的世界太奇怪了

target: 我仍然很感激你为我所做的一切,我想我该走了,直到我们再见面...

target: 众神抛弃了我们 享受这些乐趣 而你可以... 我们只是被死亡风吹走的沙子... 生命正在消逝...

source: Ahem. I just wanted to say that I met the God queen... face to face with Kethra... I think she possibly killed me... so yeah, as you were.
target: 我只是想说,我遇见了神后...

source: Gods, you all look so fucking good... I can't hold back any longer! Fuck...

Check out my wares, you'd be pressed to find a better bargain!
target: 看看我的货,你会被压着 找到更好的交易!

target: 我时不时地进一些特殊的股票,龙牙之类的.

target: 我听说过一个扒手的谣言,也看到了他们对我贸易的影响,但不幸的是,我觉得我帮不了你。

source: A few of my customers were robbed but I've no idea who was to blame, sorry. I'll be most grateful if you catch them.
target: 我的几个顾客被抢劫了 但我不知道该怪谁 对不起 如果你抓到他们 我会很感激的

source: Check out my wares, you'd be pressed to find a better bargain!
target: 看看我的货,你会被压着 找到更好的交易!

source: I get in some special stock from time to time, dragon teeth and the like.
target: 我时不时地进一些特殊的股票,龙牙之类的.

source: Come back soon, best prices in Sabu!
target: 快回来,萨布最好的价钱!

source: [Quest] I'm hunting a thief. Have you seen anything?
target: 我在追捕一个小偷 你看见什么了吗?

source: Just a voyeur or are you here to actually buy something?
Should I have brought anything with me? We left so quickly I didn't think to...
Where we're going... will he be there, in person I mean? I suppose you're not allowed to say...
target: 我们要去的地方,他会在场吗?

source: First I find out I'm truly not alone and now we're travelling together... it's... it's nice.
target: 首先,我发现我真的不孤单 现在我们一起旅行... ... 这是...

source: Is it... is it much further? Only I don't usually travel this far from home...
target: 离家这么远,我通常不会走那么远

source: Are you certain you know where you're going?
target: 你确定你知道你要去哪里吗?

source: It can't be much further, can it?
What is... wait... oh gods, help me! I... I can't...
target: 等等,天啊,帮帮我,我不能...

source: Wait, stop! Please... don't kill me...
The Watch will gladly take you.
target: 守望者会很乐意带你去的

source: Well that's just as good as killing me yourself, it's not like they'll let me live...
target: 这跟杀了我一样好 他们不会让我活着的

source: Sabu is safer without you in it.
Wait, let's not do anything rash... we can talk this through...
target: 等等,我们不要做任何鲁莽的事... 我们可以通过...

source: Hang on...  please... just... just wait...
target: 等一下... 请... 只是...

source: The amulet for your life... Deal?
Yes, yes! Take it! Take it!
Leave, now. If I see you again, I'll kill you.
target: 离开,现在,如果我再见到你,我就杀了你

source: Really? I mean... yes! I'll go, I'm leaving right now!
target: 是吗 是的 我走了 我马上走

source: Go, take the tome, it will speak to you of Atá's will...
target: 去吧,拿下这个Tome, 它会告诉你Atá的遗嘱...

source: ...each long before committed to the tome, the great work...
Was I? Probably just the heat getting to me...
Did you see what happened? The murder?
Oh... oh yes. Flash of a blade and the spray of blood... I'll never understand such things.
target: 哦,是的,刀片的闪光 和血的喷雾...

target: 为何这些人必须死,他们为什么要被标记为死亡,生命就像一盏流光的蜡烛,怎么可以干脆被扼杀出来.

source: I suspect they were quite like you or I, yet somehow their life's path led them here. The gods alone knowing the true cause.
target: 我怀疑他们跟你或我一样 但不知何故他们的生活道路 把他们带到了这里

source: The body bears the mark of Atá. Do you know it?
target: 尸体上印着阿塔的印记,你知道吗?

source: I... I cannot... It's not safe to mention that name here... follow me.
target: 我,我不能在这里说这个名字...

source: ...creeping shadow will envelop the red moon...
target: 深藏的阴影会笼罩着红月...

source: ...truth in lies, light in darkness... test them... yes, the test... only if they know the welcome...
target: ...谎言中的真相,黑暗中的光芒... 考验他们... 是的,测试...

source: You told me to follow you... Why shut me out?
target: 你叫我跟着你 为什么把我拒之门外

source: Open the door. Let's get better acquainted...
...warm flesh, how I'd love to fuck... no... not unless they prove their devotion... but I... need to...
target: ...温暖的肉,我多么想做爱... 不... 除非他们证明他们的忠诚...

target: 梅里德并不孤单 上升的阴影吞噬了世界... 一起...

target: ...他们会回来的,随着夜幕的降临...

target: 我穿的丝绸 装饰着伟大的珠宝和金饰...

I sort of see where you're coming from but no.

target: 这是一把钥匙,就像一把性感的钥匙... 锁链上的钥匙!

source: Above gates I reside, guarding nought but ecstasy. Never can I be lost, though by some I am yet seldom found. What am I?
