Atá didn't send me... I simply discovered the body.
target: 亚塔没有派我来 我只是发现了尸体

source: Are you certain though... no, no... not certain. You saw the sigil and couldn't stop until you found me.
target: 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不 不  不 不 不 不  不 不 不 不    不 不   不  不  不  不  不  不  不  不 不  不 不 .

source: "Errant flesh"? What's that supposed to mean?
When Atá claims a soul, sometimes the body doesn't realise or won't let go... it just sort of continues going. Without a soul...
target: 当阿塔声称灵魂,有时身体不意识到或不会放手...

source: Quite impossible to tell them apart, from real people I mean. Without the tome I wouldn't even know where to start.
target: 除了真正的人,我根本无法告诉他们,没有了这个玩具 我甚至不知道从哪里开始。

source: Was err, Khaa... Was he "errant flesh"?
Yes! Oh gods, makes sense why you were asking around, you thought I was out murdering people!
target: 是的,天啊,你为什么到处问, 你以为我在杀人!

source: No wonder you seemed so cautious when we met. No. No, no, no. Not a person, just meat that forgot to stop walking.
target: 难怪我们见面时你这么谨慎 不 不 不 不 不是一个人 只是忘了停止走路的肉

source: And so... you do this for Atá?
target: 所以... 你是为了阿塔?

source: The Shadow Reborn, yes. The errant flesh are a danger to the great work. He relies on me, and now you.
target: 影子重生,对,错误的肉体是伟大的工作的危险,他依赖我,现在依赖你。

source: I thought there might be others, the tome itself suggests there are many.
target: 我想可能还有其他的, 汤姆本身就暗示有很多人。

source: This tome you mention... What's in it?
Like you I was drawn to the great work by Atá.
target: 就像你一样 我被阿塔吸引到了伟大的作品中

source: Shall I tell you how it all began?
target: 要我告诉你这一切是如何开始的吗?

source: Don't go anywhere. I'll be back.
...they will return, as night follows the setting sun...
target: ...他们会回来的,随着夜幕的降临...

source: Very well, perhaps it's best if you ask about the parts which interest you. There is so much to cover...
target: 好吧,也许你最好问问你感兴趣的部分,有很多东西要覆盖...

source: I've heard enough. I'm handing you over to the Watch.
target: 我听够了,我要把你交给守望台

source: No. Wait! Unless... perhaps I misread the tome... your name must be there! Yes that's it, Atá help me destroy this insolent carrion!
target: 不,等等,也许我读错了你的名字, 你的名字一定在那里!

source: I'll spill its belly, pull the loose threads snagging the soul and pluck them out... your mark will burn away this hollow shell!
target: 我会把肚子撒出来 拔掉那条松散的线 把灵魂挖出来... 你的印记会烧掉这个空心壳!

source: Yes, yes. The tome of Atá's great work. I found it, that was how I knew he'd chosen me. Me specifically.
target: 是的,是的,阿塔的伟大工作,我找到了它,我知道他选择了我。

source: I'd been released by the Merchant's guild after paying my debts. Kept me in that dank cellar for weeks, chained to a post.
target: 我还债后被商船的盾释放了 把我关在那个破地窖里好几个星期了

source: I was looking for a place to sleep, still covered in that Minoan stink, and there it was. I don't know why... but I picked it up.
target: 我在找一个睡觉的地方, 仍然被米诺安的臭味覆盖, 在那里,我不知道为什么...

source: What's so special about it, though?
Full of names. Just pages and pages of names and... I couldn't help but read. The last page was different... blank, except...
target: 满是人名,只有几页、几页、几页姓名,我忍不住要读,最后一页不一样,除了...

source: Except it wasn't blank. Letters formed before my eyes, the book spoke to me... told me of its master, Atá... of his great works...
target: 除了不是空白的,我眼前形成的信,这本书对我说...

source: Told me of my part in them... to cut the few threads binding the errant flesh to their souls.
target: 告诉了我在其中的角色... 切掉那些束缚着 错误的肉体的灵魂的线条

source: So... a... book... made you kill people?
target: 所以... 一本... 书... 让你杀人?

source: No, you're not listening. Atá had already eaten their souls, they weren't alive. But a thread or two remain, keeping the body moving.
target: 不,你没有在听,阿塔已经吃了他们的灵魂,他们还活着。

source: Like a kite on a string. I simply sever the connection and allow the kite to drift away in the wind.
target: 就像弦上的风筝,我只是切断了连接,让风筝在风中飘走.

source: How do you put a face to the name?
target: 你怎么把脸贴在名字上?

source: The first one was easy, I knew the man. Once I'd dispatched him, my amulet... well... it came alive. It's hard to explain.
target: 第一个很简单,我认识他,一旦我派他,我的护身符...

source: I didn't mention the amulet, did I? Had it since I was a child, just a trinket really. I was wearing it when I found the tome.
target: 我没有提到护身符,对吧?

source: As soon as I cut the threads to the soul the amulet showed me the way. I can't say why, but I think...
target: 我一切断灵魂的丝线 护身符就指引着我

source: I think it might be a fragment of Atá... perhaps that's why the tome chose me... but now it guides me.
target: 我想这可能是阿塔的碎片... 也许这就是为什么我被托米选中了... 但现在它指引了我.

source: But why does Atá need these things destroyed?
target: 但为什么阿塔需要摧毁这些东西?

source: It's not for me to know that. I have been told that until they are cut he cannot fully absorb the souls.
target: 我并不知道,有人告诉我,直到被割伤,他无法完全吸收灵魂。

source: As though the threads prevent him from digesting the essence. His mark fully severs that connection.
target: 似乎线条使他无法消化精髓,他的标记完全切断了这种连接.

source: Unless destroyed the flesh will fester in the city, draining the souls of those around them like an affliction.
target: 除非毁灭的肉,在城市里腐烂,他们周遭的人的灵魂,将像苦难一样耗尽。

source: I think I understand what I need to...
Good. Then it's time, are you ready to help me?
target: 好,是时候了,你准备好帮我了吗?

source: Are you prepared to help cut the last ties binding errant and soulless flesh... that Atá might become the Shadow Reborn?
target: 你准备好帮助切断最后的束缚 错误和无灵魂的肉体... ... 阿塔可能成为阴影重生?

source: No. I'm handing you over to the Watch.
No. Wait! Unless... perhaps I misread the tome... your name must be there! Yes that's it, Atá help me destroy this insolent carrion!
target: 不,等等,也许我读错了你的名字, 你的名字一定在那里!

source: I'll spill its belly, pull the loose threads snagging the soul and pluck them out... your mark will burn away this hollow shell!
target: 我会把肚子撒出来 拔掉那条松散的线 把灵魂挖出来... 你的印记会烧掉这个空心壳!

source: No, because I'm not fucking insane.
target: 不,因为我他妈的不是疯了。

source: I don't know how I didn't notice it before, the humming of my amulet. I think I saw your name on the eleventh page!
target: 我不知道我之前怎么没注意到,我的护身符的鸣叫,我想我在第十页上看到了你的名字!

source: The soul threads are hidden behind your eyes, I just know that's where I'll find them! I'll split your skull and pluck them out!
target: 灵魂线被隐藏在你的眼睛后面, 我只知道这就是我能找到它们的地方!

source: In the marrow too, of your femur, I bet there's a thread there! Atá will reward me for cracking them open!
target: 你的骨髓里一定有丝线 阿塔会奖励我打开的

source: Yes. I will serve Atá as you have.
target: 是的,我会像你们一样为阿塔服务

source: As the tome said you would. I am to give it to you now, for a while I shall rest. The tome will tell you when to return to me.
target: 正如汤姆说过的,我现在要把它给你,我要休息一段时间,汤姆会告诉你什么时候回来。

source: You're back so soon, are you returning the tome to me?
target: 你这么快回来,你还给我吗?

source: Come with me. Atá has a final task for us.
target: 跟我来 阿塔有最后的任务要交给我们

source: Gladly! I'm so grateful that I'm not alone in this any longer...
target: 我很感激我不再孤单一人了
哦,好吧,那我先休息一会

source: You're back so soon, are you returning the tome to me?
target: 你这么快回来,你还给我吗?

source: I'm not listening to a book. You must answer for your crimes.
target: 我没有听书,你必须为自己的罪行负责

source: My... crime? I don't understand... but you saw the tome... you must... wait...
I don't know how I didn't notice it before, the humming of my amulet. I think I saw your name on the eleventh page!
target: 我不知道我之前怎么没注意到,我的护身符的鸣叫,我想我在第十页上看到了你的名字!

source: The soul threads are hidden behind your eyes, I just know that's where I'll find them! I'll split your skull and pluck them out!
target: 灵魂线被隐藏在你的眼睛后面, 我只知道这就是我能找到它们的地方!
哦,好吧,那我先休息一会

source: [Condemn] The Watch will gladly take you.
[Kill] Sabu is safer without you in it.
target: [杀]萨布是安全的没有你在里面。

source: [Trade] The amulet for your life... Deal?
[Release] Leave, now. If I see you again, I'll kill you.
target: [释 离开,现在,如果我再见到你,我会杀了你。

source: Did you see what happened? The murder?
[Quest] The body bears the mark of Atá. Do you know it?
target: 尸体上印着阿塔的记号 你知道吗?

source: You told me to follow you... Why shut me out?
target: 你叫我跟着你 为什么把我拒之门外

source: [Seduce] Open the door. Let's get better acquainted...
It's a dragon on a pile of riches!
It's a jewel-encrusted strap-on, worn by a thief!
It's your mother, dressed in silk underwear!
You write these yourself, or is there like a reference book?
target: 你自己写的 还是有参考书?

source: It's a carving above a tomb entrance!
It's a key, like a sexy key... on a chain!
target: 这是一把钥匙,就像一把性感的钥匙... 锁链上的钥匙!

source: What did you think I knew about Atá?
target: 你以为我知道阿塔的事吗?

source: What do you mean, "share the burden"?
[Quest]Come on, we both know you're behind the murders.
target: 得了吧,我们都知道你是凶手的幕后黑手

source: Atá didn't send me... I simply discovered the body.
target: 亚塔没有派我来 我只是发现了尸体

source: "Errant flesh"? What's that supposed to mean?
Was err, Khaa... Was he "errant flesh"?
And so... you do this for Atá?
target: 所以... 你是为了阿塔?

source: [Quest]This tome you mentioned... What is it?
I've heard enough. I'm handing you over to the Watch.
target: 我听够了,我要把你交给守望台

source: What's so special about it, though?
So... a... book... made you kill people?
target: 所以... 一本... 书... 让你杀人?

source: How do you put a face to the name?
target: 你怎么把脸贴在名字上?

source: But why does Atá need these things destroyed?
target: 但为什么阿塔需要摧毁这些东西?

source: [Quest]I think I understand what I need to...
target: [查 我想我明白我需要什么...

source: No. I'm handing you over to the Watch.
No, because I'm not fucking insane.
target: 不,因为我他妈的不是疯了。

source: Yes. I will serve Atá as you have.
target: 是的,我会像你们一样为阿塔服务

source: Come with me. Atá has a final task for us.
target: 跟我来 阿塔有最后的任务要交给我们

source: I'm not listening to a book. You must answer for your crimes.
target: 我没有听书,你必须为自己的罪行负责

source: Please... please... I don't want to die!
target: 求你... 求你,我不想死!

source: Good... Good... Time to live again... Reborn!
target: 好,好,该再活一次了,重生!

source: I knew you'd find your way here. Come, join me by the fire...
target: 我知道你会找到路的,过来,跟我来...

source: So this is the Night Lotus... I can... feel the power coming off of it...
target: 所以这是夜莲,我能感觉到它产生的能量...

source: Ohhh my, how delicious it is when I'm right... Enjoy your newfound power, my dear...
target: 哦,我的天,当我说对了,那是多么的美味...

source: Now... this comes as a surprise to me. That you could chose this path was not lost to me, but that you would... I must say I am rather disappointed.
target: 现在,这让我很惊讶,你选择这条路 并不是我迷失的,而是你...

source: You will cease this at once!
Unexpected... that you would choose death so soon...
target: 没想到你这么快就选择了死亡

source: What brings you to my humble little hole in the ground, Fated One?
target: 什么风把你吹到我地上的卑微的洞里,胖子?

source: I'm looking for a plant called Night Lotus. Have you seen any here?
target: 我在找一种叫夜莲的植物,你看见了吗?

source: How peculiar.... darkness seeking darkness... It is the way with the void, I suppose, wouldn't you agree? There is, in fact, Night Lotus in this cistern.
But you knew that, didn't you? You could feel it, hmm? Go on then. But one might wonder what you intend to use it for...
target: 你早知道,你感觉到了,然后继续,但你可能想知道你打算用它做什么...

source: Will you eat it as I once did? Will you partake of the power you need for the pinnacle moment of your existence in this world?
Or will you use it to perhaps... Yes... Perhaps you will use it selflessly. Undo the dark sorcery wrought by yours truly, hmm?
target: 或者你会用它,也许你会无私地使用它 解除你的黑暗魔法,嗯?

source: I must admit, this particular choice of yours is as lost to me as a ship through the fog...
target: 我必须承认,你的这个选择 对我来说就像一艘飞船在雾中消失一样...

source: Wait... You're the one who cursed the village? Why?
target: 等等,你是那个诅咒村子的人?

source: Oh for what reasons would you find my act satisfactory, hmm? Mirth? Revenge? Justice? Petulance? Duty? Curiosity?
target: 你凭什么认为我的行为是令人满意的?

source: What matters, is that what's done is done, and thus, like a bead down a thread, you are here.
target: 重要的是,已经做的事情已经做了, 因此,像一颗珠子 线下,你在这里。

source: You meant for me to come here?
Meant for you to? Not so much as that. But I knew what I would do, and what you would do, and so, here we are...
target: 我早就知道自己会做什么,你也会做什么,所以我们...

source: You cannot intend for the future to happen as it will, my dear, for it will occur how it will occur despite any desire, or lack thereof, one way or another.
target: 亲爱的,你不能希望未来能如愿以偿,因为不管有多么渴望,还是没有这种愿望,未来都会发生。

source: What do you mean by "Fated One"?
Oh nothing. And everything... We are all fated, are we not? Though none are so fated as yourself... Your spirit burns darkly upon destiny's tapestry, my dear...
target: 我们都是命中注定的,不是吗?

source: What will you do? Oh, the pain of not knowing! Hehehehe....
What are you doing here? Are you here to help us?
target: 你来这干嘛 你是来帮我们的吗

source: I am Mesahtnofret, the scribe of this village.
target: 我是Mesahtnofret, 这个村庄的文士。

source: Over the past several weeks, the desires of those who live here have slowly faded. Pleasure turned to disgust.
target: 在过去几周里,生活在这的人的欲望慢慢消退了,快乐变成了厌恶。

source: It didn't take long for the curse upon this land to begin taking hold.
target: 不久之后,这片土地的诅咒 才开始得到控制。

source: I tried everything in my power to try and reignite the burning lust in our hearts, but it was no use.
target: 我尽我所能 尝试重新点燃我们心中的欲望 但没用

source: Somehow, our passions have been entirely extinguished.
target: 我们的激情被完全扑灭了

source: We weren't sure how long we had until people succumbed to the curse, so we boarded ourselves inside of our homes.
target: 我们不知道我们还有多久才被诅咒 所以就躲在家里了

source: It would only take a few fallen to slay our entire village. I decided to remain outside so that I could go around to check on everyone.
target: 我决定留在外面,让我可以四处看看每个人。

source: Thank Kethra! I couldn't do this on my own. If you are serious, I have a plan which may yet save us before it is too late.
target: 谢谢Kethra,我不能自己来,如果你是认真的,我有一个计划,也许在为时已晚之前就救我们。

source: There is a nearby tomb of an ancient warlord. This warlord was particularly ruthless, but that is a story for another time.
target: 附近有一座古代军阀的墓穴,这位军阀特别无情,但这是另一段时期的故事.

source: I am far more interested in another bit of history. According to local legends, the warlord possessed a powerful elixir of lust.
target: 我对另一段历史更感兴趣,根据当地的传说,军阀拥有强大的性欲灵丹妙药.

source: This aphrodisiac may hold the key to our salvation. I believe that the warlord was likely buried with the recipe to keep it from others.
target: 这个药方可能掌握着我们救赎的关键,我相信军阀很可能是用秘方埋葬的,以此来不让别人知道.

source: The warlord alone knew the recipe for this powerful concoction. This secret granted him a great deal of power and control.
target: 单是军阀知道这种强大曲折的秘方,这个秘密给了他很大的权力和控制权.

source: Warlords are not known for their willingness to share power. If any trace of the recipe exists, it will be hidden within the tomb.
target: 军阀们并不知道他们愿意分享权力,如果有食谱的痕迹,它就会藏在墓穴里.

source: I pray that it can. If the legends are to be believed, this powerful aphrodisiac drove even the most chaste wild with lust.
target: 如果传说被人们相信的话, 这个强大的春药甚至用欲望驱赶了最阴沉的野性。

source: This should help my village to overcome their sudden reservations and stop the progression of the curse.
target: 这应该能帮助我的村庄克服他们突然的保留意见,阻止诅咒的蔓延.

source: With the supposed power of this drink, I believe that it may even be able to halt or reverse some of the minor petrifications.
target: 有了这杯酒的威力 我相信它甚至可以 停止或扭转一些微小的粉饰

source: Oh, a little. I ventured to the tomb myself. Some of the inscriptions were quite... informative.
target: 哦,有点,我自己去墓穴了,一些铭文...

source: Please hurry. Return as soon as you are able.
I see. Well, please hurry. We don't have much time left.
target: 明白了,请快点,我们没有太多时间了

source: There are? The tomb was empty last I was there. Perhaps there were some bandits that disturbed the dead.
target: 上次我在场的时候 坟墓是空的 也许有些土匪打扰了死者

source: I knew it! Kethra be praised! Let me see.
target: 我就知道,凯斯拉,给我看看

source: Uh... Yes, yes of course not. There was not even a hint of the restless dead in sight.
target: 当然没有,甚至没有看到 让人不安的死的迹象

source: Alright, alright. I did know about the restless dead. But it's not what you think...
target: 好吧 好吧 我确实知道那些不安的死人 但这不是你的想法...

source: I didn't tell you because I caused it. I was the one who raised them from their slumber.
target: 我没告诉你是因为是我害的 是我从睡梦中抚养他们的

source: I didn't wish any harm to you, but if I had told you about them then you would have asked questions.
target: 我并不想伤害你 但如果我告诉你他们的事 你会问问题

source: Though you asked anyways, so you're correct. It probably would have been for the best if I had just told you the truth from the start.
target: 虽然你问了,但你是对的,如果我一开始就告诉你真相的话,那可能是最好的。

source: You have to understand, I have always been eager to learn new things. So, when I stumbled across some forbidden knowledge...
target: 所以当我偶然发现一些被禁止的知识时...

source: Well, you could certainly say my interest was piqued. I went to a isolated tomb to practice my new knowledge, the warlord's tomb.
target: 我到一个孤立的坟墓去练习我的新知识,军阀的坟墓。

source: Admittedly my understanding was not as comprehensive as I hoped. What I thought was a minor incantation raised... everything.
target: 承认我的理解并不如我所希望的那么全面 我认为是小小的咒语...

source: I know, I know! I just... I should have been more cautious. The last thing I want is for people to think that I am some necromancer.
target: 我知道,我应该更小心的,我最不想的就是让人觉得我是巫师

source: When you came along, you seemed capable enough to get the recipe and dispose of any... evidence of my transgressions.
target: 当你来的时候,你似乎已经足够 能够拿到食谱 并处理任何... 有关我犯法的证据

source: I am so sorry. I should have told you, but the curse here has been weighing on me greatly. I panicked.
target: 对不起,我应该告诉你的, 但诅咒已经对我造成很大压力,我惊慌失措。

source: I know. To be honest, I can't help but feel that what is happening here is a divine retribution for my actions.... my crimes.
target: 老实说,我无法不觉得 发生的事情是对我行为的天谴...

source: Yes, I have all of these ingredients... all except one.
target: 是的,我拥有所有这些成分... 除了一个。

source: The recipe refers to the petals of a flower... that's called the Night Lotus. I'm not familiar with this particular type of lotus.
target: 食谱中指花瓣,叫做夜莲,我不熟悉这种特别的莲花.

source: Admittedly, my knowledge of Sabu's flora is somewhat lacking here and there.
target: 诚然,我对萨布的植物的了解 在某种程度上是缺乏的。

source: A short time ago an Acolyte of Seshat passed through the oasis, going north. Surely an Acolyte of The Scribe would know.
target: 不久之前,塞萨特的阿科利特人从绿洲经过,向北走去。斯克里贝人的阿科利特人一定知道。

source: I will begin to prepare the elixir while I wait for your return.
target: 我将开始准备灵丹妙药 等你回来

source: What did the acolyte say? Can we still find this Night Lotus?
target: 亚科利特怎么说的 我们还能找到这朵夜莲吗?

source: We must find it at once. Please come back as soon as you have gathered enough.
target: 我们必须马上找到它 请你们收集到足够多后立即回来

source: Then all hope is lost for us. This once thriving oasis will become nothing more than a garden of forgotten ruins and silent statues.
target: 那么,我们的希望就全消失了,这个曾经兴旺的绿洲将变成一个被遗忘的废墟和沉默的雕像的花园。

source: What amount of gold could possibly be worth the lives of an entire village?
target: 多少黄金可能值得整个村庄的生命?

source: Not only did you abandon us when we needed you most, but you taunt us with false hopes of salvation. You are a beast!
target: 你不仅在我们最需要你的时候抛弃了我们,你还用救赎的虚假希望来嘲弄我们,你是个野兽!

source: Depart from here at once. You are no longer welcome in this place.
target: 立刻离开这儿,这里不再欢迎你了

source: Please return as soon as you have. I can't help but feel we are close to saving my people.
target: 请您尽快回来,我忍不住觉得我们快救回我的人民了

source: That I am. Why do you disturb my contemplation?
target: 我就是,你为什么打扰我的思考?

source: The Night Lotus? You seek a truly rare specimen. With petals as black as night, they catch the morning dew like a thousand stars.
target: 夜莲?你寻找一个非常稀有的标本,花瓣黑如夜,它们捕捉晨露像一千颗恒星一样.

source: Beautiful, ancient, and harvested to near extinction. A handful remained however, their decendants still blossoming here.
target: 美丽的古老的, 收获到几乎灭绝。不过,还有一小部分人仍然在这里繁茂。

source: I must ask, why do you seek this flower in particular?
target: 我一定要问,你为什么特别找这朵花?

source: Is that so? The only nearby settlement was that tiny oasis we passed through not long ago.
target: 是吗 附近唯一的定居点是不久前我们经过的 狭小绿洲

source: I must say, this so-called cure intrigues me. A means to lift the affliction would change the face of Sabu as we know it...
target: 我不得不说,这所谓的治疗方法让我很感兴趣 一种解除痛苦的手段会改变萨布的面貌,就像我们所知...

source: Abandon your prior arrangement and instead teach me how to craft this elixir. I'll pay you handsomely for your troubles.
target: 放弃你之前的安排 教我怎么设计这灵丹妙药 我会为你惹麻烦而给你漂亮的报酬

source: A wise decision, you have made the right choice. Here, take your gold and leave my sight. We have a village to visit.
target: 明智的决定,你做出了正确的选择,拿着你的金子离开我的视线,我们有一个村庄可以参观.

source: A pity. Such knowledge, such power, should belong only to Seshat. It is too important to be held by mere peasants.
target: 可惜的是,这种知识,这种权力,应该只属于塞萨特,太重要了,不能只由农民掌握。

source: I am grateful for all of your help, even if in the end it was all in vain.
target: 我感谢你们所有的帮助,即使最后一切都是徒劳的。

source: I thank you for your offer, but my place is here with my people. I was not able to save them but perhaps I can still ease their end.
target: 我感谢你的提议,但我和我的人民在这里,我未能拯救他们,但也许我仍能缓解他们的结局。

source: Damn you, filth! If you want me to go with you you'll have to drag me!
target: 可恶,混蛋,你要我跟你走,就得拖我走

source: I pray that you die. A bad death. A slow death.
target: 我祈求你们死 死得很惨 死得很慢

source: Did you gather enough lotus petals?
target: 你收集的莲花花瓣够不够吗?

source: We have no time to waste. Many are already lost to the curse. Come back when you have enough Night Lotus for the elixir.
target: 我们没有时间浪费了,许多人已经迷失在诅咒中了,等你有足够的夜莲配上灵药再回来。

source: Yes, yes! There is just enough here for the survivors. Thank you, traveller. You may yet have saved our village.
target: 是的,是的,这里有足够的幸存者,谢谢,旅行者,你也许已经拯救了我们的村庄。

source: Please, excuse me. I must prepare and administer the elixir with haste. There is no time to spare.
target: 请原谅,我必须迅速准备和管理灵丹妙药,没时间了

source: Welcome back, traveller! Thank you again for all of your help.
target: 欢迎回来 旅行者 再次感谢你的帮助

source: Most are responding well to the elixir. The cure worked better than I could have hoped.
target: 大多数人对灵药反应良好,解药效果比我想象的好.

source: We were able to save many of our people all thanks to you.
target: 感谢你,我们拯救了许多人。

source: Safe travels, friend. You will always be welcome here.
target: 一路平安,朋友,你在这里会很受欢迎的

source: Oh what am I going to do now...?
There has to be a way...
Good, you've returned. Did you find everything we need?
target: 好,你回来了,我们需要的东西都找到了吗?

source: I'll stay here and make sure everyone remains boarded up. Go quickly, and with the wisdom of Seshat. The fate of the village depends on you.
target: 我会留下来,确保所有人都能上船,快去,带着塞沙特的智慧,村落的命运取决于你.

source: W-what have you done? I can smell the Night Lotus on your breath! You've doomed the entire village!
target: 你做了什么 我闻到夜莲的味道了 你毁了整个村子

source: Everyone will die now... because of your greed...
target: 现在每个人都会死 因为你的贪婪...

source: Go away. I want nothing to do with you.
Woah traveller, you may want to go back the way you came. Dangerous sorcery is at work here.
target: 哇,旅行者,你可能想回到你来的方式,危险的巫术在这里工作。

source: That doesn't sound good... What kind of sorcery?
target: 听起来不妙 什么样的巫术?

source: The dangerous kind. Aren't you listening?
Sorry, I'm just... I'm just stressed out. According to the town patriarch, a magi placed a hex on this entire village some weeks ago.
target: 抱歉 我只是压力太大了 据镇长说 几周前有个法警给整个村子下了毒药

source: They thought the magi's vile promises to be nothing more than the ravings of a madwoman, but her spellwork was apparently no ruse.
target: 他们认为女神的恶毒承诺 只不过是一个疯女人的胡言乱语 但她的咒语显然没有诡计

source: Slowly but surely, the villagers noticed their desires beginning to fade into a dull nothingness, until their passions became extinguished entirely.
target: 村民们注意到他们的欲望 渐渐消失为一无所有 直到他们的激情被完全灭亡

source: Now they're left with no way to satisfy the curse, and it's only a matter of time before they begin to die, or worse, become a monster...
target: 现在他们没有办法满足诅咒了,而只是时间问题,他们开始死亡,或者更糟糕的是,变成一个怪物......

source: Is there anything I can do to help?
target: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗?

source: Thank Kethra, I was hoping you'd ask! I've tried everything in my power to handle this on my own, but nothing seems to work.
The villagers and I settled for boarding them up in their homes to contain any who might turn. To keep everyone safe while I think of something.
target: 村民们和我安排了 让他们住在家里 以控制任何可能转身的人

source: What I need is something to counteract the magi's hex, and I have an idea. There's an elixir I've read about in the scrolls...
target: 我需要一些东西来对抗Magi的六分律,我有一个想法,我在卷轴上读到过一种灵药...

source: It's a long shot, but such a potion is the only hope these people have.
target: 机会很长,但这种药剂是这些人唯一的希望.

source: Do you know where we can find the elixir?
target: 你知道我们在哪里能找到灵药吗?

source: Well... I don't believe the elixir exists anymore. Not in its completed form, anyway.
target: 我不相信灵药已经不存在了 反正它还没有完全形成

source: Not far from here is the burial ground of an ancient warlord. And if the stories are to be believed, a recipe for the elixir may lay within his tomb.
target: 离这里不远的是一位古代军阀的墓地,如果故事被相信的话,灵精的秘方可能就在他的坟墓里.

source: What makes you think this warlord would even have something like that?
target: 你凭什么认为这个军阀会有那样的东西?

source: This warlord, whose name is recorded as Nergaal, was a powerful warrior who hoarded for himself a massive harem, hand-selected out of his conquests.
target: 这名军阀被记录为"内尔加尔"(Nergaal),是一位强大的战士,他为自己囤积了巨大的后宫,从他的征服中亲手挑选出来的.

source: He quickly grew frustrated with his inability to satisfy them all, so he gathered an entire coven of magi to create for him an elixir...
target: 他很快因无法满足他们所有人而变得沮丧,于是召集了整个大法官会,为他创作一种灵丹妙药. .

source: An elixir that would give him unnatural lust and sexual endurance.
target: 一种能给他不自然的性欲和性耐力的灵丹妙药

source: The magi did this obediently. Though once Nergaal was sure the elixir worked as intended, he put every magi to the sword–a testament to his cruelty...
target: 虽然Nergaal确定灵丹妙药能如愿以偿,但他却把每个法师都用剑...

source: If he killed the magi, what makes you think a recipe to the elixir is in his tomb?
target: 如果他杀了Magi 你凭什么认为他墓里有灵药?

source: Until the time of his death, Nergaal managed to recreate the elixir as often as he needed it. No doubt he knew the recipe and hoarded it for himself.
target: 直到他去世时,内尔加尔设法按他需要的频率重塑了灵丹妙药,毫无疑问他知道配方,并为自己囤积.

source: He taunted others with his secret knowledge, and supposedly hid the recipe somewhere only he would think to look.
target: 他用他的秘密知识欺骗了别人,据称他把食谱藏到他想看的地方。

source: Now, Nergaal had an odd obsession with death, going so far as to rule his little kingdom upon a throne within what he planned to be his eventual burial site.
target: 现在,Nergaal对死亡有一种奇怪的痴迷, 以至于统治他的小王国 在他计划成为他最终埋葬地点的王位上。

source: I have no doubt in my mind Nergaal would have hidden the recipe somewhere in his tomb...
target: 我毫不怀疑Nergaal会把食谱藏在坟墓里

source: Are you sure this elixir will even help?
target: 你确定这个灵丹妙药会有用吗?

source: I pray that it can. If the legends are to be believed, such a powerful aphrodisiac will be able to counteract the hex, and halt the progression of the curse.
target: 如果传说被相信的话,那么这种强大的恶作剧就能够对抗六恶,阻止诅咒的发展。

source: That's enough history for one day. I'll mark the location of Nergaal's Tomb on your map. Hopefully you can find the recipe before it's too late.
target: 已经够你一天的时间了,我会在地图上标注内尔加尔墓的位置,希望你能在太迟之前找到食谱.

source: You're back! Please tell me you found something we can use.
target: 你回来了,告诉我你找到可以用的东西了

source: I found the recipe for the elixir, and even one of the ingredients!
target: 我找到灵丹妙药了,还有一种配方!

source: I can hardly believe it! But then, the scrolls have never led me astray. So, what ingredients do we need?
target: 我简直无法相信,但是,那卷卷轴从未让我误入歧途。那么,我们需要什么成分?

source: Erm, we need... the pulp of a yellow fruit, some river water, something called a Night Lotus, and then semen...
target: 呃 我们需要... 黄果汁 河水 一种叫夜莲的东西 然后精液...

source: Hmm of course, of course...  We can get most of those nearby, but... are you sure the recipe calls for Night Lotus?
target: 当然,当然,我们可以在附近买到这些,但是...

source: I'm positive. Is that going to be a problem?
target: 我肯定,那会是个问题吗?

source: Why is that? Is it rare or something?
Extremely so... It only grows in the dark and in places where its roots can feed off of latent magics in deep, wet places. Caves usually. Sometimes cisterns.
target: 只有在黑暗中生长,在深处,湿润的地方 其根部能够从潜在的魔法中觅食

source: There has to be some Night Lotus nearby...
Do you know where we could find some?
target: 你知道我们在哪里能找到吗?

source: Not for certain... There are a number of cisterns I know of, not far from here. I'll mark them on your map and you can search them.
target: 不确定,我认识很多水箱 离这里不远,我会在地图上标注

source: I'll be surprised if you find any, but we've come so far in helping these people already, we can't give up hope just yet.
target: 如果你找到的话,我会很惊讶的, 但我们已经帮助了这些人, 我们不能放弃希望了。

source: Yes, remind me what those were again...
target: 是的,提醒我那些是什么来着...

source: I've collected everything we need for the elixir! Even the Night Lotus!
target: 我收集了我们需要的精液 连夜莲也收集了

source: Oh thank the gods for you, stranger. Quickly now, hand them over, there's no time to waste!
target: 哦,感谢上帝,陌生人,快点,交出来,没时间浪费了!

source: One of them was some pulp of a yellow fruit.
Okay, okay that one is easy. We have some here in the village you can use. Just grab one from the basket over there.
target: 好吧,那很简单,我们村里有你们可以用的,从那边的篮子里拿一个

source: We need some river water too.
Another easy one, you'll have to go down to the river and collect some water there. I think I remember seeing a jar on the shore nearby you can use.
target: 另一个容易,你必须下河去取水,我想我记得在附近岸边看到罐子,你可以使用。

source: And last but not least... we need semen.
target: 最后但并非最不重要的是 我们需要精液

source: Right... Well honestly, no good lust draft goes without it. Surely I don't need to tell you how you can get your hands on some of that...
target: 老实说,没有它就不会有好的性欲草案了,我当然不需要告诉你 你怎样才能得到一些...

source: Safe travels, friend. You will always be welcome here.
target: 一路平安,朋友,你在这里会很受欢迎的

source: We were able to save many of our people all thanks to you.
target: 感谢你,我们拯救了许多人。

source: Jackal sack! Don't sneak up on me like that! Wait... are you... are you real?
target: 别这么偷偷摸摸的,等等,你是真的吗?

source: What do you mean? Of course I'm real...
target: 你什么意思 我当然是真的...

source: You nearly scared my tail off! At least there's two of us now...
target: 你差点把我尾巴吓跑了 至少现在有两个人...

source: We're survivors you and I, the last two living souls following the great devastation....
target: 我们是幸存者,你和我, 后两个活着的灵魂 追随巨大的破坏...

source: What are you talking about? There are plenty of people still alive...
target: 你在说什么 还有很多人还活着...

source: No there's not. Trust me, I looked! We're all that's left.
target: 不,没有,相信我,我看过了,我们只剩下这些了

source: Where exactly did you search before deciding that you were the last man alive?
target: 在决定你是最后一个活着的人之前,你在哪里搜查的?

source: I checked the huts. Every. Last. One.
target: 我检查了小屋,每个,最后一个,一个

source: Yeah, and guess what? Everyone's dead. I'll say it again. You and me? We're all that remain.
target: 是啊,你猜怎么着,每个人都死了,我再说一遍,你和我?

source: You genuinely believe that we're the last two people alive? Sorry friend, I think you've lost it.
target: 你真的相信我们是最后两个活着的人?

source: I think you're the crazy one! You've obviously got a serious case of denial.
target: 我觉得你疯了,你显然有严重的否认

source: You searched four huts and declared yourself the last man alive? Why not look further?
target: 你搜了四间小屋,宣布自己是最后一个活着的人,为什么不往前看呢?

source: No need for that. Only need to touch water once to know all water is wet!
target: 不需要,只要摸一下水就能知道水是湿的!

source: That's really not how things work... I mean I'm alive, surely that proves you're wrong.
target: 事情不是这样的 我是说我还活着 这肯定证明你错了

source: You think you can outsmart reality? Just look around you! Life as we know it has ended!
target: 你以为你能超越聪明的现实吗?

source: Life... That gives me an idea!
The way you looked at me just then... I'm not going to like this idea, am I?
I think you and I should work together, undo this travesty, start... repopulating.
target: 我觉得我们应该一起工作, 消除这个可笑的,开始... 重新流行。

source: It would be a nice way to pass the time. The apocalypse is far more boring than I expected.
target: 时间流逝是不错的办法 启示录比我想象的要无聊得多

source: I suppose a proper greeting is in order, seeing as how we're the only people left.
target: 我想一个适当的问候是正常的, 看我们是如何是唯一的人了。

source: The name's Moswen. I'm a fisherman, if you hadn't already guessed. Who are you?
target: 我叫莫斯文,我是渔民,如果你还没猜到,你是谁?

source: If the world is over what are you planning to do now?
target: 如果世界已经结束了 你现在打算做什么?

source: I'll probably just stay here and fish. Enjoy each sunrise and sunset until I die, or the curse takes me.
target: 我可能只是呆在这里钓鱼, 享受每次日出和日落,直到我死去,否则诅咒会把我带走。

source: How are you planning to spend the end of days?
target: 你打算如何度过最后的日子?

source: Want to get started on the... repopulation efforts before you leave?
target: 想在离开前开始... 重新增加人口的努力吗?

source: I... I don't really know. It's a long story.
target: 我不知道 说来话长

source: Right, and I'm the one with sand in my brain...
Honestly? I'm still working that out.
I know exactly what you mean, a new you everyday and all that...
target: 我完全明白你的意思 每天都有新的你 以及那些...

source: Who I am is no business of yours, Moswen the fisherman.
target: 我和你无关 渔夫莫斯文

source: I suppose names don't matter much now anyway...
target: 我想现在名字不重要了...

source: I plan to obtain wealth and power. I deserve both and I shall have them.
target: 我打算获得财富和权力,我应该得到这些财富和权力,我将得到这些财富和权力。

source: Out there?  Everyone's dead. What's the point?
target: 外面,大家都死了,有什么意义?

source: I plan to taste the pleasures of the flesh, explore every delight this place has to offer.
target: 我打算品尝肉体的快乐 探索这个地方提供的一切快乐

source: You into grinding your junk against stone? That's all you're gonna find. I'm here though, and stone-free!
target: 你想用石头来磨你的垃圾吗?

source: I don't know, I'm not really sure yet.
You're welcome to stay here with me. We can fish and fuck every day!
target: 欢迎你留下来陪我 我们可以每天钓鱼和做爱!

source: It's always good to see the other survivor. How are you?
target: 见到另一个幸存者总是很高兴,你好吗?

source: You were wrong, we're not the only ones left. I've met others, you could come with me?
target: 你错了,我们不是唯一剩下的人 我见过其他人,你可以和我一起去吗?

source: Oh you poor soul... You'll come to grips with things eventually.
I think it's about time you put a baby in me.
target: 我想是时候你给我生个孩子了

source: A fuck a day keeps the curse at bay!
target: 一天他妈的让诅咒永远无法消除!

source: Don't go off and die. I really don't want to be the only one left...
target: 别死,我可不想成为唯一的...

source: I'm not going to like this idea am I?
target: 我不会再喜欢这个主意了 是吗?

source: I'm tasting the pleasure of the flesh.

target: 我不太确定... ... 说不定...

source: I found others, we're not the only ones.
target: 我找到其他人了,我们不是唯一的

source: Hah, I don't doubt you'll be back though! Sooner or later you'll want company...
target: 哈,我并不怀疑你会不会回来!

source: Err... not yet no. Another time perhaps.
You're right. If we're going to repopulate Sabu I suppose we do need to get started...
target: 你说得对,如果我们要重新繁衍萨布...

source: I plan to explore the forgotten ruins of this place, discover the truth buried beneath the dunes.
target: 我计划探索这个地方被遗忘的废墟 发现沙丘下面的真相
我在探索被遗忘的废墟

source: I'm not certain how you think you'll get me pregnant, but want to try anyway?
target: 我不确定你怎么会让我怀孕 但还是想试试看?

source: I was wondering... Could you teach me to fish?
target: 我在想 你能教我钓鱼吗?

source: Look at you. So eager to learn and grow despite everyone you've ever known or loved being dead.
target: 看看你,尽管你曾经认识或爱过死去的每一个人 都渴望学习和成长

source: That's probably why you survived, come to think of it... Good thinkers with a will to live, like us, always survive.
target: 所以你们才活下来,想起来... 好思想家有生存的意志,就像我们一样,永远生存下去。

source: I'll teach you to fish, and I'll even do it for free.  No use for gold these days anyway.
target: 我教你钓鱼,我甚至免费做,如今黄金都没用了.

source: Lucky for you, I have a spare fishing pole. It's right over there. Go ahead and take it, and then come with me to the dock.
target: 幸运的是,我有一个备用的钓鱼竿,就在那边,拿去,然后跟我去码头。

source: Alright then, to start, all you must do is grab my pole.
target: 好吧,首先,你必须做的就是抓住我的杆子。

source: Erm... I thought you were teaching me to fish.
Not that pole! The fishing pole! We can fuck later. Go on then, take it out and cast your line into the water near that school of fish right there.
target: 钓鱼竿,我们等会再操,然后把它拿出来,然后把绳子扔到鱼群附近

source: Yeah, just like that... And now, we wait...
target: 是啊,就这样,现在,我们等待...

source: I have to say, you look quite nice with that rod in your hands.
target: 我不得不说 你手里拿着那根棍子看起来不错

source: Ohhh well done, well done. There are all sorts of fish out there too. Probably more fish than there are people now...
target: 哦,干得好,干得好,外面还有各种鱼,也许比现在的人还要多...

source: Watching you fish has me feeling rather pent up. Perhaps you feel the same way?
target: 看你钓鱼,我感觉很沉闷,也许你也是一样?

source: The Aethio will be here soon, we have to wait!
target: 爱思唯奥人很快就会到的,我们必须等待!

source: Darling... I'm so sorry, but we have to get out of here.
target: 亲爱的 我很抱歉 但我们得离开这

source: They're going to take her away from all this. Any moment now, they'll be here...
target: 他们会把她从这一切中带走的 随时都会到的

source: We have to leave darling, there's nothing to be done.
target: 我们必须离开亲爱的,没什么可做的。

source: My love, we have to leave... we can't stay here.
target: 亲爱的 我们必须离开 我们不能呆在这里

source: Shhh, please... you'll wake her a-and...
Don't worry, mama is here... you're safe... it's okay...
target: 别担心,妈妈在这里... 你安全了... 没事的...

source: We're all here, together... we'll see you soon.
target: 我们都在这里,在一起... 我们很快会见到你。

source: It's going to be okay... mama loves you so much...
target: 不会有事的 妈妈非常爱你...

source: You're not alone my baby girl... dada is here too.
target: 你并不孤单 我的宝贝女儿... 爸爸也来了

source: Here looks like a good place, not too far from home and the tree will give some shade.
target: 这里看起来是个好地方,离家不远,树会给一些遮荫.

source: Whatever is responsible for this... it cannot be allowed to continue.
target: 不管对此负责... 都不能再继续了

source: See! I told you they'd come!
target: 看,我告诉过你他们会来的!

source: You are one of them, aren't you? You're one of the Aethio?
target: 你是他们中的一个,是吗?

source: Those who take.. who save newborns from this place...
target: 那些把... 新生儿从这个地方救出来的人...

source: You are one of them, you must be! You have come to take my daughter...
target: 你一定是其中之一 你是来带走我女儿的

source: Yes, I am one of the Aethio... I have come for your daughter.
target: 是的,我是爱思唯奥人之一 我是来找你女儿的

source: You... you are? Thank the goddess... I was so worried... here, take her... gently now, she's sleeping.
I will take good care of her, you have my word.
target: 我会好好照顾她的 我保证

source: B-but what if she needs her mother?
target: 但是如果她需要她妈妈呢?

source: Come now love, she'll be... we'll see her again, soon enough.
target: 来吧,亲爱的,她会... 我们会再见到她的,很快的。

source: It's for the best... m-my little girl... I know I'll see her again.
target: 这是最好的... 我的小女儿... 我知道我会再见到她

source: No, I'm not one of the Aethio.
Y-you're not... but then who will save my little girl... you must be! Please!
target: 你,你不是,但谁会救我的女儿...

source: I'm sorry, but your child is gone. You should leave here, it's not safe,
target: 对不起,你的孩子不见了 你应该离开这里,这不安全

source: N-no... no! How dare you... abandon my daughter... in this... in this hell.
She's gone sweetheart. If we don't leave, we will soon follow... We need to get somewhere safe.
target: 她走了,甜心,如果我们不走,我们马上会跟着...

source: I'm not going anywhere! You're not her mother, you wouldn't understand!
target: 我哪儿也不去 你不是她妈妈,你不会明白的

source: Thank you for trying, stranger, but you should save yourself. I think we'll... we'll rest here a while. Together.
target: 谢谢你的尝试,陌生人,但你应该拯救自己。

source: Yes, I'm here for the child.
You seek the Temple of Pahnu... Yet his mouth thirsts... Quench her desire, and she will speak the truth you require...
target: 你寻找帕赫努庙,但他口渴...

source: Ahhh, thank you... It has been an age since I was last tended to.
target: 谢啦,我上回被关了很久了

source: You seek an audience with the Shepherd of the Wilds, do you not? But to enter his temple, first you must become one with that which birthed you.
target: 你们要跟野兽牧羊人一起看,不是吗?

source: Land... Sea... Sky... You must seek out the ancient shrines, attune yourself with the elements, cloak yourself in nature's glory.
target: 陆地,海,天空,你必须寻找古代的神迹, 与元素相适应, 披上自然的荣耀。

source: Only then will the scales fall from your eyes, and the hidden way be made clear.
target: 只有这样,天秤才会从你的眼里掉下来,而隐秘的道路才会明白。

source: Seek cave, river, and plateau... Only then will the way to Pahnu appear for you.
target: 寻找洞穴、河流和高原,只有这样,通往帕赫努的路才会出现。

source: You bear the mantle of creation... Go, seek my master within his temple. The way is now open.
target: 你承担着创造的内衣 去他的神殿里寻找我的主人吧 道路已经打开了

source: The land is the foundation upon which all the world rests... Though despite its burden, it never ceases giving.
target: 这片土地是全世界赖以生存的基础...

source: Water is the source of all life, carried from the sea across the land through its many rivers and springs... Embody its life-giving anima.
target: 水是所有生命的源泉,它从海洋中穿过陆地,穿过河流和泉水...

source: The essence of life is carried upon the wind, and the air of the sky is the source of all wisdom. Give thanks for each and every breath.
target: 生之精气,随风而载;天之气气,乃万物智慧之源,每息而谢.

source: You have fully embraced the path of nature... and are now ready to approach my master.
target: 你完全接受了自然之路... 现在准备接近我的主人了

source: Aren't you all bandits? Why aren't you attacking me?
Do you think we just fight every single passerby? That'd be fucking exhausting, not to mention some of us would get killed.
target: 你觉得我们跟每个路人打吗?

source: Anyway, we're preoccupied with other matters, why pick a fight when we don't need one. Don't take that the wrong way...
target: 不管怎么样,我们忙于其他的事情, 为什么要在不需要的时候挑战。

source: I'm sure you're a great fighter... I just feel like we should fight other people. I'd rather be friends.
target: 我敢肯定,你是一个伟大的战士...

source: You'll be fine here if your mouth stays shut, you keep your hands to yourself, and don't stare anyone down.
target: 如果你的嘴闭上,你不会有事的,你把你的手放在自己身上, 不要盯着任何人。

source: Let me see. You must have pulled this from one of Nefi's shipments.
target: 我看看 你一定是从尼菲的货里提取的

source: He's been trying to send goods to Aneb without giving us a cut. Naturally we've been making that hard for him.
target: 他一直想送货给Aneb,却不给我们一个切口。

source: You don't know Nefi? Makes sense. He wasn't much of anybody before he killed the old boss.
target: 你不认识尼菲,他杀了老老板之前 人不多

source: After his takeover he got too big for his boots and we had a bit of a falling out.
target: 他接手后,他的靴子太大了,我们有点摔倒了

source: I'm looking for a guardsman. Goes by Amycus?
You mean that Centaur from Aneb? I can't say I miss him, but we didn't have anything to do with it.
target: 你是说阿内布的半人马?

source: To tell you the truth I'd happily have him here, I'm sure we could've swayed him to join us eventually.
target: 老实说,我很高兴他在这里, 我相信我们本来可以摇摆他,最终加入我们的行列。

source: But since setting up camp,we've been busy holding our own against our competition.
target: 但是自从建立营地以来 我们一直忙着 自己对抗我们的竞争对手

source: Bandit clans don't play well with one another. Surprising, I know.
target: 土匪部落互相不善,令人惊奇,我知道.

source: What about the other bandit clans? Could they have done it?
target: 其他匪族呢,他们能办到吗?

source: Maybe. Perhaps we can help each other. I can mark the location of another camp on your map.
target: 也许吧,也许我们可以互相帮助 我可以在地图上标出另一个营地的位置

source: Can't promise they'll be happy to see you, might even attack you... honestly that's the only reason I'm sharing.
target: 不能保证他们会很高兴见到你 甚至会攻击你... 说实话,这就是我分享的唯一原因

source: The enemy of my enemy and all that. If they don't cut your throat then do me a favour.
target: 我的敌人的敌人,如果他们不割断你的喉咙,那就帮我个忙吧

source: If you do talk to their boss Nefi, tell him Najja sends her regards.
target: 如果你和他们的老板Nefi说话 告诉他Najja会向她问好

source: What do you know about Khoomah?
We've found a bottle or two in shipments, good stuff if you ask me. Takes more than a few days for the cravings to end though...
target: 我们找到一两瓶好货了,如果你问我的话, 需要几天多的时间才能结束这些渴望...

source: I have no idea where they are getting it, and I don't really want to know. Anything that good is a slippery slope.
target: 我不知道他们从哪里得到的,我也不想知道,任何好的都是滑坡。

source: A couple of the lads were dumb enough to drink enough to get hooked.
target: 有几个家伙笨到喝得够醉

source: They got desperate when the supply ran out and wandered off in search of more. Haven't heard from them since.
target: 补给用光后他们急着走去寻找更多,此后再也没有消息了.

source: If you ask me, I think they bumped off that centaur so they could peddle Khoomah without disruption.
target: 如果你问我,我想他们撞了那半人马 这样他们就可以在不中断的情况下 挖Khoomah。

source: The timing is too convenient for the two to be unrelated.
target: 时机太方便了,两者不相干.

source: Aren't you all bandits? Why aren't you attacking me?
I'm looking for a guardsman. Goes by Amycus?
What about the other bandit clans?
What do you know about Khoomah?
Welcome traveller. Won't you warm yourself by the fire? These are dark times indeed, this hour the darkest of all.
target: 欢迎旅行者,你不会为火暖身子吗?

source: Rest beside these embers, I have many tales to while away the witching hour. Dawn will come all the sooner.
target: 和这些木头一起休息吧,我有很多故事要讲 趁着女巫的到来,黎明会早点来

source: Of course. Where to begin... ah, I know the perfect tale for a night such as this.
Well known is the downfall of our ancient queen, her betrayal at the hands of the cat goddess.
target: 众所周知,我们的古代女王的下台, 她背叛猫女神。

source: However, previous few consider how the usurper acomplished this feat. Fewer still worry of the dangers that may yet linger beneath the dunes.
target: 然而,以前很少有人考虑篡夺者是如何完成这一成就的。 对于沙丘下面可能存在的危险,人们仍然担心得更少。

source: Countless hundreds scour the relics that scatter this place. Seeking power in forgotten urns they delve greedily into the detritus of that coup.
target: 数以百计的文物 分散了这个地方,在被遗忘的骨灰堆中寻找力量 他们贪婪地钻进那场政变的破碎。

source: Yet there is one artefact that means certain death for those who open it. A foul creation, fashioned in that war of antiquity.
target: 然而,对于打开它的人来说,有一种动画意味着一定的死亡,一种在古代战争中形成的肮脏的造物。

source: The Accursed Urn. Some claim it a myth, others a tale to deter tomb robbers, yet all stories follow the same path.
target: 有人声称这是神话,其他人则说这是震慑盗墓者的故事,但所有的故事都遵循同样的道路。

source: A vessel that can tear all essence from the soul from all those foolish enough to open it, their bodies then immediately petrified by Kethra's curse.
target: 一个能从灵魂中撕裂所有精髓的容器 从那些愚蠢的人那里撕开它, 他们的身体然后被Kethra的诅咒立即吓坏了。

source: It was by this means that even demigods were laid low, the usurper taking full advantage of that weakness to seal away what remained.
target: 正是通过这个手段,即使是神明也被贬低了,篡位者充分利用了这一弱点来封杀剩下的东西.

source: Perhaps it was such a fate that has befallen those poor wretches that surround us here. Such an urn could lay beneath our feet even now.
target: 也许我们身边那些可怜的扳手们 遭遇了这样的命运 这样的骨灰盒甚至现在都可能倒在我们脚下

source: I know what you're thinking, why not simply avoid opening strange urns? Well for the rare chance at power of course.
target: 我知道你在想什么,为什么不干脆避免打开奇怪的骨灰盒呢?

source: Like all magics, there are exceptions to the rule. It is rumored that if one survived the leaching of their soul, that they might draw from the urn.
target: 与所有魔法一样,规则也有例外,传说如果一个人在灵魂的浸出中幸存下来,他们可以从骨灰盒中抽出.

source: Then one would obtain a form of pure essence, or at least a fragment of one. It is such temptation that continues to lure many to their doom.
target: 如此一来,人们就会得到一种纯粹的精髓,或者至少是其中的一块。 正是这种诱惑继续引诱许多人走向末日。

source: Ah, look. Our tale is ended and the darkest hour has passed. The dawn draws ever closer.
target: 看,我们的故事结束了,最黑暗的时刻过去了,黎明越来越近了。

source: May you find the treasures you deserve.
S-stay back! I-I have a sharp stick and I'm not afraid to use it! Oh... you're not that thing.
target: 退后,我有一个尖棒 我不怕用它!

source: Either keep your voice down and stay here with me, or leave. I'm not going anywhere yet.
target: 要么小声点,留在我这里,要么离开,我哪儿也不去

source: Thank you... for your kindness. I'll never forget it.
target: 谢谢你的好意 我永远不会忘记的

source: You walk the path with pride, friend.
target: 你骄傲地走在路上 朋友
我... 我不知道 我...

source: One thing's for sure... I'm leaving this wretched island and never coming back!
target: 有一件事是肯定的 我要离开这个可怜的小岛 再也不回来!

source: Thank you for convincing me to leave that cave, as I surely would have died there, but I can't stay here a moment longer.
target: 谢谢你说服我离开那个洞穴 因为我肯定死在那里 但我不能再呆在这里了

source: For a moment there, I saw my life flash before my eyes...
target: 有那么一瞬间,我看到我的生活闪闪发光...

source: What are you doing in this cave?
Hiding... I don't want to die.
What exactly are you hiding from?
There's something terrible out there... falls upon you in an instant... and you die... torn apart.
target: 外面有可怕的东西... 瞬间就落在你身上... 你死了...

source: I don't think I'll ever be able to forget the spray of blood... and the stink of its breath... like carrion...
target: 我永远忘不了血的喷雾 和气味的味道 就像肉瘤一样

source: I'm off... you can come with me you know.
target: 我走了... 你可以跟我走,你知道的。

source: Good luck out there... I'm not budging until I know it's safe.
This thing, how did you escape it?
target: 这个东西,你怎么逃出来的?

source: I... I don't know. I recall running... then I must have tripped... before I rolled over it was on me.
But there was a sound, like... singing? Deep... so deep the ground trembled.
Whatever it was, that thing didn't care for it... just left me there on the floor... so I ran. Found myself here.
target: 不管是什么,那东西不在乎...

source: It could still be out there, hunting me...
target: 可能还在外头 追杀我...

source: Are you one of the missing scouts?
target: 你是失踪的侦察兵之一吗?

source: Ah, so you've found my fellow blades... Yes. I was sent to find some means for us to escape this island.
target: 你找到我的同伴的刀片了 我被派去寻找一些方法让我们逃出这座岛

source: I presume that means some of my brothers and sisters are still alive? Thank Anubis.
target: 我想这意味着我的一些兄弟姐妹还活着?

source: Oh, you mean the black feathered creature? I killed it.
target: 哦,你是说黑色羽毛生物吗?

source: Are you sure? You... You saw it die?
target: 你确定吗 你看到它死了吗

source: I really hope so, I mean I have its head right here...
target: 我真的希望如此,我的意思是,我有它的头就在这里... ...

source: No, I trust you... I really don't want to see.
target: 不,我相信你 我真的不想看见

source: Blessings stranger,  I could kiss you! I need to go find my fellow blades and tell them!
target: 祝福陌生人,我可以吻你,我要去找我的同伴,告诉他们

source: Yes, although the fight has taken a toll on them... they're a little worse for wear.
target: 是的,虽然战斗给他们造成了损失... 他们穿起来会更糟糕

source: Maybe you should rejoin the rest of your group?
target: 或许你应该重新加入你的团队?

source: No... Not with that monster out there, and especially not after being such a coward... My life as a warrior is over.
target: 不,不要和那个怪物在一起 特别是当个懦夫之后...

source: They're leaving without me? I suppose they think me dead...
target: 他们离开的时候没有我?

source: Probably... you could still go after them.
target: 可能... 你还是可以去追他们

source: No... Not with that monster out there, and especially not after being such a coward... My life as a warrior is over.
target: 不,不要和那个怪物在一起 特别是当个懦夫之后...

source: I did come across them but... your friends are all dead.
target: 我确实见过他们 但是... 你的朋友都死了

source: N-no... You can't be serious! H-how?
You should! Go, rejoin your fellow warriors.
target: 你应该去,加入你的战友

source: Thank you, stranger. I won't forget this, nor you!
target: 谢谢你,陌生人 我不会忘记的,你也不会忘记的!

source: They're leaving without me? I suppose they think me dead...
target: 他们离开的时候没有我?

source: Probably... you could still go after them.
target: 可能... 你还是可以去追他们

source: I will! I was always blessed with swift feet, catching up should be easy enough. Path be your guide, stranger!
target: 我会的,我总是被快速的脚所祝福, 追赶应该足够容易了,道路是你的向导,陌生人!

source: Maybe you should leave... rejoin your friends...
target: 也许你应该离开... 重新加入你的朋友...

source: I already told you I'm not leaving. Nothing you say will convince me to.
target: 我已经告诉你我不会离开的,你说的话不会让我相信的

source: Maybe you should leave... rejoin your friends...
target: 也许你应该离开... 重新加入你的朋友...

source: I already told you I'm not leaving... It's too dangerous out there.
target: 我已经说过我不会离开的 外面太危险了

source: Whatever creatures stalk this place... there's nothing preventing them finding you here.
target: 不管什么生物跟踪这个地方... 没有什么能阻止他们发现你在这里。

source: So far it's working. It's certainly safer than going back out into the open.
target: 目前为止,它已经起作用了,它肯定比回到开放的地方要安全.

source: Surely you're safer with your friends than in this cave...
target: 你和你的朋友在一起肯定比在这个洞穴里安全

source: I... I suppose you may be right. But what if that thing attacks me again on my way to the camp?
target: 我猜你可能是对的 但如果那东西在我去营地的路上又袭击了我呢?

source: I've made it safely there before. I'll keep you safe.
target: 我之前安全地到达那里了 我会保护你的安全

source: But what about my cowardice? How do I excuse that I hid here whilst they faced that thing?
target: 但我的懦弱怎么办 我怎么能原谅我躲在这里 而他们却面对那东西?

source: Everyone ran from that creature, what matters is that you've stopped running now. Come on, I'll lead the way.
target: 大家都从那怪物身上跑出来 重要的是你现在停止了跑步

source: I... Okay, I'll do it. But don't you dare leave my side!
target: 好吧,我会的,但你敢离开我身边!

source: Something terrible found them... me. I killed them all.
target: 发现他们很可怕 我把他们都杀了

source: What? Why?! G-get away from me!
target: 什么 为什么 离我远点

source: That same thing that chased you... it found them. They didn't stand a chance.
target: 追逐你的那一样东西 它找到了他们 他们没有机会

source: I... I can't believe it... I'm never leaving this cave.
target: 我简直不敢相信 我永远不会离开这个洞穴

source: What are you doing in this cave?
Are you one of the missing scouts?
target: 你是失踪的侦察兵之一吗?

source: Oh, you mean the Kravenrook? I killed it...
target: 你是说克拉文鲁克 我杀了它...

source: Yes, in fact they're leaving by boat
target: 是的,事实上他们要乘船离开
你应该重新加入你的朋友...

source: The same monster that attacked you killed them.
target: 就是那个袭击你的怪物杀了他们
你应该重新加入你的朋友...

source: What business do you have here?
You want me to do 'em boss?
Not yet, no. Our friend here means no harm, they're just the butt of Najja's joke.
target: 还没有,不,我们的朋友在这里意味着没有伤害, 他们只是纳贾的笑话的屁股。

source: Ever since that bitch and her cronies left they've been a thorn in my side.
target: 自从那个婊子和她朋友离开后 他们就一直缠着我

source: What happened between you and Najja?
target: 你和纳贾之间发生了什么?

source: I don't know who you are or how you know Najja. Be warned though, she'll drag you down with her if she can.
target: 我不知道你是谁,也不知道你是怎么认识纳贾的,但要警告她,如果她能,她会把你拖下水的.

source: She can't keep up the raids forever. Aneb will either form a village militia or get a new centaur from somewhere.
target: 她无法永远地维持突袭,阿内布要么组建村民兵,要么从某个地方获得新的百官.

source: When that happens, she'll be right back where we were under the old boss. Broke and hungry.
target: 等那事发生 她就会回到我们老老板的身边了

source: I found us a better way, without the need for killing. Not everyone agreed. Side with her and she'll be the death of you.
target: 我找到了更好的方法,不需要杀人,不是每个人都同意,跟她一起,她就会死在你手上

source: I'm looking for the missing guardsman, the centaur.
I know nothing about that. We've been going through a bit of an internal... reorganisation.
target: 我对此一无所知,我们经历了一些内部重组

source: By the time I got things under control here, that centaur was long gone.  I'm just taking advantage of the situation, like anyone else.
target: 等事情被我控制了,那半人马早就不在了,我只是像其他人一样,利用这个局面而已.

source: I didn't run him off, or kill him, if that's what you're thinking. Like I said, I wanted to take a different route. Less violence.
target: 我没有把他赶走,也没有杀了他,如果你是这么想的,就像我说过的,我想走不同的路线,少暴力.

source: Besides, I suspect Aneb will have some new guards very soon.
target: 另外,我怀疑Aneb很快就会有新警卫了

source: Aren't you going to attack me?
Not unless you try something stupid. Like I said, I'm trying to find a better way.
target: 除非你尝试一些蠢事,就像我说的,我在试着找到更好的方法。

source: Our last boss would've 'ad you strung up, empty out your pockets before we bash out your skull
target: 我们最后的老板会把你吊起来 掏空你的口袋 在我们打爆你的头骨之前

source: Enough. We can only profit off of a dead person once. After all, if you teach a man to fish...
target: 够了,我们只能从死人身上获利一次 毕竟,如果你教人钓鱼...

source: Do you know where all this Khoomah is coming from?
target: 你知道胡玛从哪里来的吗?

source: No idea. Potent stuff, someone will be making a mountain of coin from it.
target: 不知道,有潜质的东西,有人会用它做一山硬币。

source: Jars of Khoomah are being hidden in your shipments.
target: 霍马的贾斯被藏在你的货里了

source: Pretty sure I'd know if that were true. Wait... You're serious aren't you? That damn rat... Right under my nose!
target: 你是认真的吧 那个该死的老鼠 就在我鼻子底下

source: Sokkwi packs the shipments... You'll be able to find him nearby.
target: 索克维负责运货,你可以在附近找到他

source: I suggest you talk to him before I pay a visit myself. He might not be in any condition to talk after that.
target: 我建议你在我亲自去拜访之前和他谈谈 他可能此后没有条件说话

source: Don't come back unless you have actual business with me.
target: 除非你跟我有业务,否则就别回来

source: What happened between you and Najja?
target: 你和纳贾之间发生了什么?

source: I'm looking for the missing Aneb Guardsman, the centaur.
target: 寻寻失阿尼布护卫者,百官.

source: Aren't you going to attack me?
Do you know where all this Khoomah is coming from?
target: 你知道胡玛从哪里来的吗?

source: Jars of Khoomah are being hidden in your shipments.
target: 霍马的贾斯被藏在你的货里了

source: That's far too much gold, Khoranos! What are you thinking?
target: 黄金太多了,霍拉诺斯,你在想什么?

source: This one thinks it is a fair amount. Due compensation for The Fold's continued access to trade through Kusu.
target: 这个人认为这是一笔相当的金额,对The Fold继续通过库苏进行贸易给予应有的补偿.

source: This is about the other night, isn't it?
target: 这是关于那天晚上,不是吗?

source: You know what this one desires, sweet Neftahra...
target: 你知道这人想要什么,甜甜的尼夫塔拉...

source: You make this far more difficult than it has to be, darling Neftahra...
target: 你让这比它更困难,亲爱的尼夫塔拉...

source: No, you are the one making things difficult! A-and don't look at me like that!
target: 不,是你弄的麻烦 别那样看我!

source: What gives you the right... to be such a twat?
target: 你凭什么有权... 做个这样的蠢货?

source: Hmhmhm... This one is Minoan... The world is one's right!
target: 这个是米诺安,世界是对的

source: You can just forget it! It's never going to happen. Not again!
target: 你忘了吧,它永远不会发生,不要再发生!

source: Oh sweet, sweet Neftahra, how you make this one laugh.
target: 哦,亲爱的,亲爱的尼夫塔拉,你怎么让这个笑。

source: Hnnnngh- at last... One has been without you wrapped around his cock for- mmmh- far too long...
target: 终于有人没你缠着他的鸡巴太久了

source: Too much? Mmmmyes, "gilded" pet, but... you've made your choice... Now you must- hahhh- lay with it. Mmhmhmhm...
target: 太多了吗? 嗯,"被打"的宠物,但是...

source: Hmhmhm- Take- Mmmmh- more... One knows you can...
G-gods, why did I agree to this? Hnnnngh-!
Hmhmhm... That's good... Sing for me.... Mmmh-

target: 自从萨蒙和他的朋友搬到我们的小岛后 我每天都负责为家人提供大量食物

source: I think I'll wait to sell then... Sorry to waste your time.
target: 我等着卖吧 抱歉浪费你的时间

source: Don't worry about it! You know where to find me if you change your mind.
target: 别担心,如果你改变主意,你知道我在哪里

source: A Formless... Hate processing them. Usually someone already owns them. Whatever the case, no doubt a Minoan or the Anubites will put 'em to use.
target: 通常已经有人拥有了 不管发生什么,毫无疑问 米努安人或阿努比人会使用它们

source: Unfortunately they're not good for much but hard labour. Best I can give you is 50 gold.
target: 可惜他们不是好人,而是苦力,我只能给你50金

source: Good. I know it isn't much, but it's not like you're getting much out of it anyway.
target: 很好,我知道这没什么,但你也不是在忙这个

source: A Collared one? Hmm... Nice to look at, but everyone knows they're not the real deal. Still...
These ascension fakers do go for a nice sum in certain circles. I can give you 150 for this one.
target: 这些冒牌货一定能赚到很多钱,我可以给你150块

source: A Demi? I see you're growing bolder with your acquisitions... We'll need to move this one quickly. 300 gold. Take it or leave it.
target: 德米,我看你越来越大胆了,我们得快点搬走,300块黄金,要么拿走,要么离开它

source: I know someone who'll be very happy with this one. Here's your payment, and keep up the good work!
target: 我知道有人会很满意的,这是你的薪水,继续干!

source: Curious who you are... You running some sort of shop here?
That's right! Name's Pharon. Stockwarden Pharon. And what you see here is exactly what it looks like.
target: 没错 我叫Pharon 斯托沃登·Pharon 你在这里看到的就是它的样子

source: If you're looking to sell one of your slaves, I'm the one to come to!
target: 如果你想卖掉你的奴隶,我才是来找你的!

source: Simply decant one of them into the cage right here, I'll appraise them in a flash, and then hopefully get you the best deal you'll find on the market!
target: 只要把其中之一放进笼子里 我就一瞬间评估一下 然后希望能给你最好的交易 在市场上找到!

source: Heard any interesting rumours from your customers?
target: 听说你的顾客有有趣的谣言吗?

source: Sorry, nothing except talk about the curse. But that's to be expected with how bad things have gotten, isn't it?
target: 抱歉,除了说咒语以外,别无他法 但事情会变得如此糟糕

source: I'd like to sell this slave.
Alright then! Let's take a good look at what we're working with here...
target: 好吧,让我们好好看看我们的工作...

source: I'd like to sell a slave.
Alright then! Will just need you to decant them into the cage right next to us here and we'll get the transaction process going.
target: 那好吧 只需要你把他们放进我们旁边的笼子里 然后我们就能开始交易了

source: I'd like to sell a slave.
I'd like to sell a slave.
You're new around here. Surprised you found me in my little nook.
target: 你是新来的,你发现我在我的小角落里

source: No matter, no matter. Why don't you take a look at my wares?
target: 没关系,你为什么不看看我的药呢?

source: I can't get Mehlva out of my thoughts...
target: 我不能让梅尔娃离开我的想法...

source: I need you to do something for me, I need you to bring her my note, I need her body.
target: 我需要你帮我做点什么 我需要你把我的笔记给她 我需要她的身体

source: I can't leave and she can't know who I am if this fails!
target: 我不能离开,如果失败了,她就不知道我是谁了!

source: She's by the docks in the fishing village north of here, bring this to her and tell her I want her by the moonlight.
target: 她就在北边渔村的码头边 把这个带给她 告诉她我要她到月光下

source: Head over there now, and don't forget. Don't say who I am!
target: 现在往那边走 别忘了 别说我是谁!

source: A cruel and terrible beauty, this...
All sight... fled... but for this single blossom...
target: 所有目光... 逃离... 但为了这朵花...

source: Blessed am I for such a gift as this... graced with nature's imperfect perfection...
target: 幸好我有这种天赋 被大自然的完美所赐予

source: As the sun fades beneath this stoney veil, I must wonder if its warmth still kisses the ruin of my home.
target: 当太阳在石质的面纱下消退时,我必须怀疑它的温暖是否仍然吻着我家的废墟.

source: Are you able to hear me?
Where delicate petals danced the unstill air, now doomed are they to be forever held, as am I...
target: 细腻的花瓣跳着未静的空气 现在注定会永远被抱住 就像我...

source: Such fragile beauty, ensnared by unending twilight... until both time and fate drift away on a fairer breeze, as will I...
target: 如此脆弱的美丽,被无尽的黄昏所笼罩... 直到时间和命运在更公平的微风中飘逝,我也会...

source: I appreciate your company, your presence grants respite from the solitude of my end.
target: 感谢你的陪伴,你的到来 使我暂时不再孤独

source: I... don't really know what to say...
Even the flower is beginning to disappear from my sight... we all leave this world... alone.
target: 连花也开始从我眼前消失... 我们都离开这个世界... 独自一人

source: Did you really think you could sneak up on a priestess of Anubis? I sensed your treacherous presence before you even entered this tomb...
target: 你真的认为你可以偷偷摸摸地找阿努比斯的女祭司吗?

source: Surely you didn't believe such a paltry disguise would fool a priestess of Anubis. Your treacherous intent cannot be hidden from me...
target: 你肯定不相信这种伪装会骗到阿努比斯的女祭司

source: You inquisitors are known for your brazenness... But to be so foolish as to oppose a priestess of The Jackal? That's new.
target: 你们这些问罪者很傲慢,但愚蠢到要反对《小丑》的女牧师?

source: Ah, I thought I sensed the presence of an inquisitor... And one who intends to stop me from my ascension no less. Laughable...
target: 啊,我感觉到有个审讯员...

source: Your service to the traitor-goddess ends here and now!
target: 你对叛徒的忠告 现在就在这里结束!

source: The gifts of Kethra are not for you to lock away!
You'll need to do better than that, inquisitor!
target: 你需要做得更好,问询官!

source: Behold, the gifts of The God Queen!
Where is your cat-goddess now? Ahahahaha!
Your kind are a blight on Sabu... A hindrance to the rebirth of this divine kingdom... I shall enjoy ending you...
target: 你们这种人对萨布来说是祸福 阻碍这个神圣王国的复兴 我很乐意结束你们
死吧,异教徒! 死吧,异教徒!

source: No, it is you who will die... But not before I force you to witness my ascension!
target: 不,是你们会死的,但是在我逼你们见证我的荣耀之前...
什么... 你... 结束了?

source: Stop this madness... using the ritual vessel could destroy you! Do not give in to this darkness!
Hah! I would be a fool to believe you. I will destroy you, and then take what is mine!
target: 信你,我会是个傻瓜,我要毁灭你,然后夺走我的东西!

source: It is the will of The Path. Nothing more. Nothing less. The blessings of Anubis' mother are not meant to be buried... they are to be embraced.
target: 这是"道路"的旨意 没有什么比这更难的了 阿努比斯的母亲的祝福 不应该被埋葬...

source: I do not expect one of your kind to understand.
target: 我不指望你们这种人能理解
死吧,异教徒! 死吧,异教徒!

source: No, Nassiros, I refuse to return to my master with this... this sorry excuse for copper!
target: 不,纳西罗斯,我拒绝回我的主人 带着这个... 这个对不起的借口铜!

source: If you do not like it, then you may leave it.
target: 如果你不喜欢,那你可以离开它。

source: I had to cross through a warzone to get here, and I'll have to do so on my way back. All of that, and for what?
target: 我不得不穿过战区才能到达这里,我回来的路上必须这样做,所有这一切,为了什么?

source: It is not this one's problem... A deal, is a deal.
target: 这不是这个问题 交易就是交易

source: No, this is not what was agreed to! Why do you insult my master so?
target: 不,这不是约定的,你为什么这样侮辱我师父?

source: This one cares not what your master thinks. He wishes for copper ingots? Here are copper ingots.
target: 这个不管你主人怎么想 他想吃铜锭吗?

source: Take them, or don't, but you will pay nevertheless.
target: 要么拿走,要么不拿走,但你还是会付钱的

source: Come see Nassiros for the finest copper in all of Sabu.
target: 来见纳西罗斯吧 萨布最优秀的铜牌

source: Tell your friends about Nassiros and his magnificent copper ingots.
target: 告诉你的朋友们纳西罗斯和他的铜币

source: Do not believe the slanderous words spread about one's ingots.
target: 不要相信诽谤的言语 散布在一个人的硬币上。

source: What seems to be the trouble?
This overgrown miscreant here, has insulted my master for the last time; trying to sell us copper ingots even a Tokol wouldn't want!
target: 这个过度生长的杂货店 最后一次侮辱了我的主人 试图卖给我们铜币 甚至一个托科尔不会想要的!

source: Bah. This one has given what you have purchased. You will hold up your master's end of the bargain... and pay...
target: 买到的东西就交给你了,你先按住主人的价钱...

source: I've never heard a more ludicrous thing in all my life! Go on stranger, see for yourself. That copper is shit for quality.
target: 我这辈子从没听过更可笑的事!

source: Oh my... These are... not good.
This one assures you that you are mistaken.
target: 这个可以保证你搞错了

source: See, you oaf? Even a wandering vagabond can look at your supposed craftsmanship and tell it's inferior scrap!
target: 看吧,你这笨蛋,连流浪的流浪汉 都可以看你的本领 说这是低劣的废品!

source: I think I know how this should be settled...
target: 我想我知道该怎么解决...

source: What is there to settle? The master requested copper ingots. This one crafted copper ingots. The master must pay for said copper ingots.
target: 老板要的是铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制的铜制

source: Well, the copper ingots are obviously of poor quality.
Thank you! And so, obviously, I'm not giving this brigand a single gold coin.
target: 所以很明显 我不会给这只金币

source: Then, you will not take the copper. This one cares not.
target: 那你就别想拿铜了 这只无所谓了

source: The quality of the copper is irrelevant.
Ah, you see? Finally someone who understands...
Understands? Understands what, you smelly farce of a living creature?
target: 明白吗 你闻到活生物的闹剧了吗

source: Surely your master has taught you better manners.
target: 你的主人一定教了你更好的礼仪

source: The merchant here is clearly in the wrong... You can't sell poorly made copper. It isn't right.
It... Isn't right? This one wonders where you've come from... The master requested copper ingots. Here they are.
You know what? This isn't worth it. I'm leaving.
Those ingots are useless. I'm not lugging trash back through beast-ridden lands and sandstorms.
target: 那些垃圾没用,我不会把垃圾拖回野兽的土地上和沙暴

source: Hmhmhmm very well... Give your master one's regards...
target: 好极了 向你的主人问好

source: The merchant is right... If you agreed to pay for them, you should pay for them.
target: 商人说得对 如果你同意支付他们,你应该支付他们。

source: I can't believe what I'm hearing... Did you even look at them? Those ingots are worthless.
target: 我简直不敢相信你居然看到他们了?
成交就是成交 成交 成交

source: You know what? This isn't worth it. I'm leaving. And no, I'm not paying you.
target: 这不值得,我要走了 不,我不付你钱

source: Hmhmhmm very well... Give your master one's regards...
target: 好极了 向你的主人问好

source: It sounds like this isn't the first time this has happened. You should consider finding a better source for your copper ingots.
target: 听起来这不是第一次了 你应该考虑为你的铜币找到更好的来源

source: That we should have to- *sigh* You know what? You're right. The master is going to be upset with me for returning empty handed again...
But this isn't worth it... I'm leaving. And no, I'm not paying. You can keep your useless metal.
target: 不,我不付钱,你可以留着你的无用的金属

source: Hmhmhmm very well... Give your master one's regards...
target: 好极了 向你的主人问好

source: I'd like to buy the ingots.
Ah, excellent. This one will sell them to you for only... one hundred gold pieces. A bargain price.
target: 不错,这个只卖一百块,价钱很便宜

source: Wonderful.. A pleasure doing business with you, stranger...
target: 很高兴和你做生意,陌生人...

source: That's... *sigh* You will hear from my master soon. This isn't over.
As for you and your master, one cares not... Good riddance...
target: 至于你和你主人,我们不在乎...

source: You know... I wager your balls are nice and full... I could empty 'em for you... Swallow every last drop...
target: 我打赌你的蛋蛋很好吃,满满的 我可以帮你清空...

source: Such... vile eagerness! Please, take the copper for a quarter of the price, and go before one is made to be sick.
target: 这么卑劣的渴望 请拿铜来换取四分之一的价钱 趁有人生病前走

source: Listen... I want to help you out, but we both know the ingots aren't worth that much gold. Let's talk a price cut. Help me help you.
target: 听着,我想帮你,但我们都知道 硬币值不值那么多金子,我们来谈减价吧,帮我帮你

source: Hmmm... You are a shrewd dealer in business, one sees. Very well, you have a deal. This one will sell the copper for half its original price.
target: 你是一个精明的经销商,你有一个交易。

source: You have a deal. I guess...
Yes. Please, take your copper and share of this one's beneficence.
target: 是的,请拿上你的铜 和分享这其中的恩赐。

source: That's... *sigh* You will hear from my master soon. This isn't over.
As for you and your master, one cares not... Good riddance...
target: 至于你和你主人,我们不在乎...

source: Actually, I think I'll leave it. I never actually wanted that copper to begin with!
target: 其实,我想我会离开它,我从来没有真正想要的铜 首先!

source: A well-struck bargain... You may take your copper and go...
target: 讨价还价的好货 你可以带上你的铜牌去...

source: That's... *sigh* You will hear from my master soon. This isn't over.
As for you and your master, one cares not... Good riddance...
target: 至于你和你主人,我们不在乎...

source: Actually, I think I'll leave it. I never actually wanted that copper to begin with!
target: 其实,我想我会离开它,我从来没有真正想要的铜 首先!

source: The copper is of poor quality...
The quality of the copper is irrelevant.
The merchant is in the wrong.
I'd like to buy the ingots.

target: [ 低声 ] 我可以清空你的蛋蛋...
[ Leave] 反正我从不想要它。
[ Leave] 反正我从不想要它。

source: Return here once you know the location of the relic.
target: 你一知道文物的位置就回来

source: One wonders if you already regret your decision, or if that will come later. Perhaps only with the realisation of how your final days will be spent.
target: 人们想知道,你是否已经后悔了,或者以后还会后悔。也许只有意识到你最后的日子将如何度过。

source: I'm hunting a thief. Have you seen anything?
target: 我在追捕小偷 你看见什么了吗?

source: You?! They've put you on such an essential task? Heavens forbid they do their own work rather than delegate to some mercenary
target: 他们让你做这么重要的任务?

source: You think I'm not up to the task?
target: 你以为我不胜任任务吗?

source: One doesn't mean to offend but one expects the best for such a task. The fact you're of no renown here renders that reality unlikely.
target: 一个人无意冒犯,但人们期望 最好完成这样的任务。

source: I thought it was just a petty thief...
A petty thief? You're after a slayer of profit my friend, a murderer of commerce and mutilator of economy. Their crime is greater than a mere act.
target: 小偷,你是为了谋利 我的朋友,杀人犯和经济的破坏者 他们的罪行不仅仅是一种行为

source: Oh but of course you didn't. The true damage is overlooked by all but the Merchants Guild, only to us is the real gravity of the situation known.
target: 当然你没有 真正的伤害被忽略了 除了商贸协会之外 只有我们知道 情况的严重性

source: Of course, one can scarcely avert one's gaze for a moment before the furry hands of that wretch are reaching for one's jewels.
target: 当然,人们几乎无法避免 一个人的目光片刻之前, 毛手毛脚的坏手 正在到达一个人的珠宝。

source: Furry hands, huh? So the thief wasn't Formless...
target: 毛手,所以小偷不是无形...

source: One would say not, thick dark fur on both hands. That's all one saw of the vermin, but clearly and on several occasions.
target: 人们不会说,两只手都有厚厚的深色皮毛,这都是一只看到害虫的,但清楚和多次。

source: As soon as one turned back the cur vanished into the crowd. They can't hide forever though... and once we catch them...
target: 一旦有人转身, 柯尔就消失在人群中, 他们不能永远躲起来, 一旦我们抓住他们...

source: What will you do when I catch them?
target: 等我抓到他们,你会怎么做?

source: What will we do? I very much doubt that they have anything with which to repay the guild, so we'll have to consider other options.
target: 我们该怎么办呢?我非常怀疑他们有什么可以回报盾的,所以我们不得不考虑其他的选择.

source: They'll need to pay off their debt along with something for our financial pain and suffering... plus interest.
target: 他们需要还清债务 以及一些东西 来补偿我们的财政痛苦和痛苦 再加上利息

source: Then there's the matter of your compensation... the guild is generous to those whom champion its interests.
target: 还有你的补偿问题... 盾对维护其利益的人是慷慨的

source: Well, one can always find space for a new plaything. It's jolly fun to have a good... selection... to play with. After all, they tend to break so easily.
target: 玩得开心极了 选一个好 选一个好 玩的

source: If one tires of using them, one can always sell them on. We tend to get good prices from the Slavers, as long as they're able to stand.
target: 如果一个用过它们的人总是可以卖掉它们,我们往往从奴隶手中得到好价钱,只要他们能站得住。

source: You needn't worry, one shan't be out of pocket when one's done... if that's what you were wondering.
target: 你不必担心,一个人完成后 就不会出钱... 如果这就是你想知道的

source: Well, guess I better go catch that thief.
target: 好吧,我想我最好去抓那个贼。

source: It seems one's fears were misplaced. Grabbed that runt by the scruff, a safe pair of hands that promptly delivered the mewling quim.
target: 似乎人们的恐惧是错的。

source: A safe pair of hands indeed, one shall very much enjoy one's latest plaything. One hopes the Watch isn't unduly rough with her though...
target: 一只安全的双手,人们会非常享受自己最新的玩法。

source: It's a great deal less satisfying when someone else has eaten some of one's pudding, don't you think?
target: 当别人吃过布丁时,就更不满意了,不是吗?
我... 不太明白我是否理解你的意思 I'm... not sure I understand.

source: Quite, quite. Besides the point I suppose. To business then, one has a proposal for you. One can promise it will be very much worth your while...
target: 相当的,除了我想的一点外,对生意来说,有人对你有个建议,可以保证它很值得你...

source: One isn't certain whether to trust you or not. On the one hand you did snatch that runt by her scruff and haul her off.
target: 一方面,你抓住了她那颗矮子 把她拖走了

source: On the other hand it was your own toybox to which she was secreted away. Now now, that won't do, will it? That won't do at all.
target: 另一方面,这是你自己的玩具箱,她被秘密藏起来。现在,这不行,对吧?那根本行不通。

source: One is without a soft young thing to break, a soft young thing which would have balanced the scales.
target: 一个是没有柔软的年轻事物来打破, 一个柔软的年轻事物,它可以平衡天平。

source: The abacus tilts against us, beads sliding at your touch. This burden lies upon you now, a debt to the Merchant's Guild.
target: 算盘对着我们,珠子在你面前滑动,这个负担现在落在你身上了,这是对商行的债。

source: Oh, don't look so glum, you need not despair. One has a solution, a proposal with which you will be able to restore us and free yourself.
target: 哦,别看起来那么傻,你不需要绝望,有一个解决方案,一个你能够恢复我们并解放自己的建议.

source: One knew you weren't up to the task. Damnable Watch too. A failure that has left us... out of pocket.
