source: Well, let's not get ahead of ourselves, friend... I don't mean any offence by this, but we don't do business with just anyone.
I'll tell you what you can do, though. You can play with the various slaves we have here in the gardens area to your little heart's content!
target: 不过,我告诉你,你可以和我们在花园里的各种奴隶玩玩, 让你的心满意足!

source: Just not the ones in cages, mind you. They're... not ready.
target: 别把笼子里的人放在笼子里,他们还没准备好

source: I'd rather have my own slave though...
target: 我宁愿有我自己的奴隶,虽然...

source: Don't we all? Hmm, I'll tell you what, I've been looking for an apprentice since the last one went and got himself purchased by a minoan.
Don't worry about it. The lad wasn't all too bright, but you look like you've got a good head on your shoulders.
target: 别担心,那小子不怎么聪明,但你看起来挺有头脑的

source: Tell you what, I'll take you under my wing, but before I do that, I need to know you understand the rules..
target: 告诉你,我会把你放在我的翅膀下, 但在此之前,我需要你知道 规则。

source: There are rules for owning slaves?
Gods, of course there are! We call them tenets. A lot of people think slavers don't have any scruples, but that couldn't be further from the truth!
target: 当然有,我们称之为信条,很多人认为奴隶贩子没有任何顾虑,但这与事实不符。

source: We have a strict code of conduct that every member of the Gilded Fold must follow. No exceptions.
target: 我们有一个严格的行为守则,吉尔德福德的每个成员都必须遵守。

source: I can follow rules, usually... What are they?
Rather than stand here and ramble on, I'm going to let you find out for yourself. I need to take care of some personal business anyway.
target: 而不是站在这里乱来,我要让你自己查清楚,我需要处理一些私人事务。

source: Go take a look around the compound and you'll find pillars with the tenets engraved on them. There are five in total.
target: 去院子周围看看,你会发现柱子上刻着信条,总共有五根.

source: Once you're sure you understand the rules, come find me and we'll get you started.
target: 一旦你明白规矩,就来找我,我们会让你开始的

source: So, are you ready to be the Herdmaster's apprentice?
target: 你准备好做牧民的学徒了吗?

source: Yes, I've read the rules and I'm ready to become your apprentice!
target: 是的,我读过规则,我准备做你的学徒!

source: Haha, and I thought this day couldn't get any better! You certainly won't regret it. A life in The Fold is a good one.
target: 哈哈,我以为今天会好起来的!

source: But before we get started, I need to make sure you understand what the tenets demand of each of us.
target: 但是在我们开始之前,我需要确保 你明白我们每个人的信条要求的。

source: So eager! You love to see it. Okay then, my new apprentice, follow me and we can jump right into your first lesson.
target: 好极了,你喜欢看 好吧,我的新徒弟,跟我来,我们可以跳进你的第一课

source: Oh, and here, take this. You'll be needing it.
target: 哦,这里,拿着这个,你会需要的

source: First question. Who's the one who makes all the rules around here?
target: 第一个问题是,谁能制定所有规则?

source: That's right! She's in charge of The Fold. We don't see her often, but her presence is always felt. Maybe one day you'll get to meet her!
target: 没错,她负责"被窝" 我们不常见到她,但她的存在总是让人感觉,也许有一天你会见到她!

source: The... what? No... Did you actually read the tenets?
Ana-who? Why does that name sound so familiar?... Anyway, no, that's not it. Go read the pillars again if you have to and then come back.
target: 安娜,为什么这个名字听起来这么熟悉?

source: *sigh* No... Are you trying to be funny? Because it's not funny...
Alright, another question for you. What did the tenets say about using slaves?
target: 好吧,你问另一个问题 信条上怎么说使用奴隶?

source: We can do whatever we want with the slaves because they have to be obedient to their masters.
target: 奴隶必须服从主人,所以我们可以随心所欲地对待他们.

source: Only up to a point... There is an important detail you're missing...
target: 你错过了一个重要的细节...

source: Something about chains of servitude, or something...
Maybe you should go read the pillars again.
target: 也许你该再看一遍柱子

source: That we can only use a slave if they agree to being used.
target: 我们只能使用奴隶 如果他们同意被使用。

source: That's correct! All of the slaves freely wandering the gardens? Those are consenting to use by simply being here. The caged ones are another story...
target: 没错,所有奴隶都自由游荡在花园里?

source: If you're ever confused about whether a slave is consenting or not, just assume they aren't, and stay away. I'd hate to see you get executed.
target: 如果你对奴隶是否同意感到困惑, 就假设他们不是, 离我远点, 我最不想看到你被处死.

source: To catch your first slave, of course! Once you've proven you can do that, you'll officially be one of The Fold.
target: 当然是为了抓住你的第一个奴隶 一旦你证明你能做到,你就会正式成为"废奴"之一

source: Good, good. My sources tell me there's a small group of potential slaves not far from here. Poor things are living in a cave...
target: 好,好,我的消息来源告诉我 离这里不远还有一群潜在的奴隶 可怜的人住在山洞里...

source: Barely any ascension... No purpose... They need us! Need you to rescue them from their current state.
target: 他们需要我们 需要你把他们从目前状态中救出来

source: Journey west. Find the cave. Take your slave. Good luck, apprentice!
target: 西游记 找到洞穴 带上你的奴隶 祝你好运 徒弟

source: Feeling unsure are we? That's alright. The life of a slaver isn't for everyone. But I'll be here if you decide that it is.
target: 没关系,奴隶贩子的性命不是每个人都有的,但是如果你决定的话,我会在这里的

source: I did it! I captured my very first slave!
target: 我做到了,我抓住了我的第一个奴隶!

source: Ah, but did you? You know what they say? No cage, no chains, no slave obtained! Hah!
target: 啊,但是你知道他们怎么说吗?

source: In other words, put your new catch into a cage, and get them through the submission process. Only then will you truly have your first slave.
target: 换句话说,把新捕捉物放进笼子里,让他们通过呈报程序。只有这样,你才能真正拥有第一个奴隶。

source: Oh... I, erm, don't have a cage.
target: 哦 我 呃 没有笼子

source: Right! I forgot to mention. Remember Sehet? Well, I finally managed to sell her off. So her cage is open for business. Consider it yours. My gift to you.
target: 我忘记提了,记得塞赫特吗?

source: Okay I got my new slave situated... What next?
target: 好吧,我找到我的新奴隶了...

source: So you did! Excellent work. I'd like to welcome you, officially, to The Gilded Fold. May your cages never be empty!
target: 你做到了,我很高兴能正式欢迎你来到吉尔德堡 愿你的笼子永远不空空!

source: As far as what's next... Be patient. Be resourceful. Find ways to help out your fellow Fold members and work on your slaving techniques.
target: 耐心点,多机智点 想办法帮助你的伙伴们 研究你的奴役技术

source: If I hear of anything I could use your help with, or if I see an opportunity to teach you something, I'll let you know.
target: 如果我听到任何需要你帮忙的事 或者我看到有机会教你一些东西 我会告诉你的

source: I found a spare capture jar. Do you want it?
target: 我找到一个备用的捕捉罐 你要吗?

source: You bet I do! I'll put it back into our stock. Never good to have one of these sitting around for the commoners to use....
target: 我肯定会放回我们的库存里 让他们坐着让普通人用...

source: Oh... Hmm... Looks like this one's busted. Well, that's no good. Can still give you some compensation for your efforts though.
target: 这件好像坏了,不过你的努力还是可以补偿的

source: Of course! The Fold appreciates the return of any of its lost property, no matter how... broken... So, how does two-hundred fifty gold sound?
target: 当然,福德公司感谢归还它失去的财产 无论多么破碎...

source: Is it really worth that much?
I'd say so! In fact, once you start to see how much gold can be earned using these babies, you'll find they're priceless.
target: 事实上,一旦你看到这些孩子能挣多少金子, 你会发现他们是无价之宝。

source: Anyway, enough dallying about. Take your gold and get back out there.
target: 说够了,拿着你的金子回去吧

source: What do I do with a new slave once they're in a cage?
target: 我该怎么处置新奴隶呢?

source: You wait. Give them enough time and before you know it, they'll be begging to serve you. Well, most of time.
target: 等一会,给他们足够的时间,在你知道之前, 他们会乞求服侍你。

source: That seems too... simple... What's the catch?
Well it's not always that easy. Some never break. Just keep talking to them over time, and you'll notice a change in their attitude towards you.
target: 事情并不总是那么容易,有些人永远不会崩溃,只要和他们继续交谈,你会发现他们对你的态度有改变。

source: Let one out before that happens though and they'll run off and you'll have to catch them again, or even lose them forever. So, be patient.
target: 在那之前放一个人出来,他们就会逃跑,你必须再次抓住他们,甚至永远失去他们。所以,耐心点。

source: What if I want to sell a slave... How do I go about doing that?
Look at you being a little entrepreneur! You'll need to visit Stockwarden Pharon, our resident trader. She can explain the whole process better than I can.
target: 看看你是个小企业家,你需要去拜访我们本地的商人Stockwarden Pharon。她比我更能解释整个过程。

source: That's fair, I guess. Thanks for the information, Herdmaster Reseph.
target: 那很公平,我猜,谢谢你的通报,牧羊人雷瑟夫

source: So, erm... When can I, you know... use one of my slaves?
target: 那么,嗯,我什么时候可以,你知道...

source: You mean, when can you fuck them? After they've accepted you as their new owner and are released from their cage to live amongst us in the gardens.
target: 你是说你什么时候能和他们上床?

source: That's when. Just remember... Keep to the tenets.
Get out there and fill some cages!
What do I do with a new slave?
How do I sell a slave?
When can I use a slave?
Stroke faster, girl. You've been serving me for how long? Shouldn't you be able to anticipate my needs by now?
Ahhh yes, that's the spot dear...
target: 啊,是的,这是地点亲爱的...

source: I'm glad I've pleased you Safiya-
target: 我很高兴我很高兴你萨菲亚...

source: You will address me as Mother or you'll end up in the stocks besides your sister. Do you understand?
target: 你会叫我妈妈,不然你就会在你的姐姐之外 被股票炒了,明白吗?

source: Gods, how I wish I had my pool again...
target: 天啊,我多希望我还能有我的游泳池...

source: Hmm... Will need fresh wine soon.
target: 很快会需要新鲜的葡萄酒

source: Don't be shy now, traveller. Come, sit in the water with us. My girls could use another discerning eye to judge their efforts.
target: 别害羞 旅行者 来 和我们坐在水里 我的姑娘们可以用另一只辨别的眼睛来判断他们的努力

source: I was wondering how soon I would see you again. Have you spoken to that Anubis-worshipping rabble for me?
target: 我在想我多久能再见到你 你和那个为我而作的阿努比斯狂欢的人谈过了吗?

source: Look how they desecrate your temple... Barbarians...
target: 看他们如何亵渎你的神庙...

source: Are you here with the new wine shipment? You can leave it just inside the walls. My daughters will take care of it from there.
Yes, of course. And the payment?
Right, you must be new... Your gold is in the chest over there beneath the pergola.
target: 对,你一定是新人,你的金子藏在胸口的柏戈拉下面

source: Thank you for your continued patronage, miss.
target: 谢谢你的不断赞助 小姐

source: The wine? Oh right, the wine, of course, yes, I have it...
target: 葡萄酒? 哦,对,葡萄酒,当然,是的,我有它...

source: Wine shipment? No, sorry, I'm just passing through.
Feel free to stay, and rest a while, so long as you keep your hands off my daughters... They are for my touch only.
target: 随便你留下来休息一会儿 只要你别碰我的女儿...

source: You mean all of the women around here? Are they... really your daughters?
target: 你是说这里所有的女人吗?

source: I didn't give birth to any of them, if that's what you're asking... But I refer to them as my daughters, nevertheless, and they call me their Mother.
target: 我没有生下她们中的任何一个,如果这就是你所问的...

source: I took them in... Every one of them was a poor, defeated thing with no hope, and no family when I found them... I gave them a home. A place to belong.
target: 我带他们进去,他们每个人都是穷人,毫无希望地被打败,没有家人...

source: I care for them, provide them with a roof over their heads, some food, and the occasional... treat. In return, they serve me.
target: 我关心他们,给他们一个屋顶 上面他们的头,一些食物,偶尔...

source: That's an... interesting approach to family.
target: 这对家庭来说是... 有趣的方法

source: Say I wanted to be one of your, erm... daughters... Could I do that?
target: 说我想成为你的女儿 我能做吗?

source: My home is quite full right now, dear... But if a spot becomes open, I could consider taking you into my little family...
target: 我家已经很满了,亲爱的 但如果一个地方被打开,我可以考虑把你带进我的小家庭...

source: No, dear, I'm afraid your form is... not to my taste. You understand.
target: 不,亲爱的,恐怕你的样子...

source: Have you seen or heard anything interesting out here?
target: 你在这里看到或听到什么有趣的事吗?

source: You mean, besides the infestation of my gorgeous island by those dog-worshipping jingoists?
target: 你是说,除了那些狗虫的鸡鸡 侵扰了我美丽的岛屿之外?

source: Do you mean the Cult of the Jackal? Are they giving you trouble?
target: 你是说小丑的邪教吗 他们给你惹麻烦了吗

source: Of course they're giving me trouble. It's what their kind do--thinking they have the right to everything they set their beady little eyes on.
target: 当然他们给我惹麻烦了 他们那种人做的就是...

source: Some warriors decided to make camp in the temple ruins nearby. They've no doubt turned my favourite bathing spot into an obscene sausage festival.
target: 一些勇士决定到附近的神庙废墟扎营,他们无疑把我最喜欢的洗澡地点变成了淫秽的香肠节.

source: Will they not let you in?
I don't know... I can't even bring myself to speak with those scoundrels. Not to mention, a gorgeous specimen like me, walking into a camp full of men?
target: 我甚至不能和那些无赖说话 更别提像我一样的漂亮标本

source: I'd rather not deal with the headache.
I noticed one of your, erm, daughters is in a pillory... What did she do?
target: 我注意到你的一个女儿在药房里 她做了什么?

source: If you must know, the little rat was in the wine cellar getting as drunk as can be. The wine is not for the girls, and she knows better.
target: 如果你一定要知道,小老鼠在酒窖里喝得醉得像酒一样,酒不是给女孩们喝的,她知道得更清楚.

source: If you haven't already, feel free to pay her a little visit. I'm sure she'll appreciate the attention, as well as a reprieve from the curse setting in.
target: 如果你还没有去,你可以去拜访她,我相信她会很感激大家的注意,以及从诅咒的设定中缓缓下来.

source: I found a way to get you your favourite bathing spot back.
target: 我找到办法让你最爱的洗澡地点回来

source: Did you now? Surely you didn't take on the entire patrol via combat, or otherwise...
target: 你当然没有通过战斗来承担整个巡逻任务,或者...

source: Well, no, I made a deal with them. But it only works if you agree to it...
target: 不,我和他们做了交易,但只有你同意才有效...

source: Of course. Let me guess, they wish to have their way with me, hmm?
target: 当然,让我猜猜,他们想跟我走一条路,嗯?

source: Oh, erm... Actually, they didn't mention you... The soldiers want access to your daughters. If you give them that, you'll be allowed to use the pool.
target: 士兵们想见女儿,如果你给女儿,你就可以使用游泳池了

source: Devious mutts... *sigh* Well, if that's what must be done in order for me to return to those precious, precious waters...
target: 狡猾的杂种们... ...嗯,如果这是必须做的,以便我回到这些珍贵的,宝贵的水域...

source: I suppose I should thank you in some way... Consider yourself counted amongst the soldiers which are allowed to... be with my daughters.
target: 我想我应该以某种方式感谢你...

source: And... be gentle with them. I know you must be wondering how I could agree to such a thing, but I promise you it was necessary for me...
target: 对他们温柔点 我知道你一定在想 我怎么会同意这样的事情

source: Sorry, can't talk right now. Busy beating a certain someone's beautiful ass at fishing.
target: 抱歉,现在不能说话,忙着打人钓鱼

source: H-hey, I heard that! Y-you're just trying to distract me!
target: 嘿,我听到了,你只是想分散我的注意力

source: The usual for this area of the Euphoris. Mostly Glimmerfin Snapper and Sandscale fish. Anyway...
target: 通常的Euphoris地区,主要是Glimmerfin Snapper和沙层鱼,总之...

source: *sigh* Look, why don't you grab a pole of your own and give it a try?
target: 你为何不自己拿根杆子试试看?

source: Be nice, Sahmon, they're just curious.
target: 乖点,沙门,他们只是好奇而已

source: Hey, I know we said being the best is reward enough, but I'm dying for a good fuck.
target: 嘿,我知道我们说过,做最好的是足够的回报, 但我渴望一个好他妈的。

source: What do you say to Perchet and I giving you a little something special for showing us up?
target: 你对佩切特怎么说? 我给你一些特别的东西来展示我们

source: You're shit at catching fish Sahmon, but I like the way you think! C'mon stranger- let us to treat you to a well-earned favour.
target: 你抓鱼可不好,不过我喜欢你的想法!

source: I suppose I've earned it... Why not?
target: 我想我是应得的 为什么不呢?

source: Just lie back and let us take care of everything.
target: 躺回去,让我们处理好一切

source: The Storks had better find me way out here!
target: 斯托克家最好找到我离开这里!

source: See this swelling belly? Yeah, that's your doing...
target: 看到这个肿胀的肚子了吗?

source: Don't look at me like that... this is entirely your fault.
target: 别那样看着我 这完全是你的错
嗯... 就像你看到的一样?

source: Oh no I'm bound here... anything could happen...
target: 哦,不,我被捆绑在这里... 任何事都可能发生...

source: Don't just stand there looking, help a girl out!
target: 别傻站着看,帮个女孩出去!

source: I feel my belly swelling... I want nothing more than this!
target: 我感觉肚子肿了,我只想这样!

source: How many have I delivered now? No matter, I want more...
Oh thank the goddess, are you here to put a babe in me?
target: 哦,感谢女神,你在这里 把我一个宝贝?

source: I'm in heat, just thought you should know... I'm certain you'll get me pregnant...
target: 我太热了,只是觉得你应该知道...

source: What happened to you, why are you tethered here?
target: 你怎么了,你为什么绑在这里?

source: I ended up on the wrong side of the law in Kusu, offended the Slaver's Cabal. As punishment they put me all the way out here.
target: 我最后在库苏站错了法律的一边, 冒犯了奴隶家的卡伯尔, 他们把我一路关在这里。

source: Do you want me to try breaking those bindings?
target: 你要我尝试打破这些束缚吗?

source: Thank you for the offer stranger, but it's no use. These are enchanted... I can't escape these bonds until I no longer wish to.
target: 谢谢陌生人的提议,但没用,这些是魔法...

source: Looks as though someone has taken advantage of your... situation.
target: 看来有人利用你的... 情况了

source: Yes... anyone passing by tends to spot me a mile away. It's been a blessing though, now that the stone sickness is spreading I mean.
target: 路过的人总是在一英里外 发现我,但现在石头病在蔓延,这真是福气

source: Looks as though someone has taken advantage of your... situation.
target: 看来有人利用你的... 情况了

source: Yes... anyone passing by tends to spot me a mile away. It's been a blessing though, now that the stone sickness is spreading I mean.
target: 路过的人总是在一英里外 发现我,但现在石头病在蔓延,这真是福气

source: Why not have a turn yourself? It's not as though I have anything else to do...
I can't stop thinking about you...
Go on, fill me up. You'd better know when to pull out though!
target: 来啊,填满我,你最好知道什么时候退出!

source: I can't stop thinking about you...
Go on, fill me up. It's not as though I can get double-pregnant... that's not a thing, is it?
target: 来啊,填满我,我可不会怀孕了...

source: I can't stop thinking about you...
But I'm already with child... your seed will be wasted. Goddess please... I beg you... let them fuck a second one into my womb!
target: 但我已经怀上孩子了 你的种子会白白浪费的 女神求你了,我求你了...

source: I can't stop thinking about you...
Do I look like your personal broodmare? Oh fuck, go on... but you'd better not leave me with child this time!
target: 我看起来像你的个人胸围吗?

source: It's time to make that belly seed-swollen again...
target: 是时候让那个肚皮种子再次摇摆...

source: The absolute cheek... I'm not your personal broodmare you know!
target: 绝对的脸颊 我不是你个人的胸围 你知道!

source: Are you not? Remind me, how many babes have I sired by you?
target: 提醒我,我被你封杀了多少个宝贝?

source: Three times the storks have been here for your offspring... ah, fuck me again... I quite enjoyed how big it made my tits.
target: 我很喜欢它让我的乳房变得那么大。

source: Four, I think... or five... I've lost count. Oh go on, knock me up and we'll call it five.
target: 4,我想... 或者5,我数不清了,继续,敲我一通,我们叫它5号

source: It has to be... five, I think that's what we said last time... I take your point... it seems that I am your personal broodmare... so breed me!

Well, since you're trapped in there... I may still be able to "help".

source: How in the world did you... thank you, stranger.

target: 天啊,我的小弟弟 我必须找到他!

source: Thank you, for your help. I wish my little brother had made it but... it's hard, but I know he would have wanted me to go on living.

target: 就是这样,我只是想确认一下她当时在水坑里 感觉到手臂上拉了点马力

source: Looked around and nobody was behind me, bloody torc missing from my arm though. Solid gold as well, inlaid lapis, not a trinket...
target: 看着四周,没人在我身后,我手臂上也不见了血色的铁丝网,还有坚固的金子, 皮包,不是三联装...

source: Oh, right. Yeah, so it was later on that I realised I saw a felian tail when I looked.
target: 对,后来我发现我看到一条尾巴

target: 嗯,他们很好的数字,虽然很难 商品,这是真的,我们不时从他们那里买, 虽然从来没有选择。

source: Most they pass us are near enough corpses. I'm not a particularly moral person but I'm not intentionally cruel either.
target: 大部分尸体都离我们很近 我不是个道德高尚的人 但我也不是故意残忍的

source: Anyway, there are cabals atop both the Slavers Guild and the Merchants Guild. Let's just say that their interests align.
target: 奴隶协会和商贸协会都有歌舞团,我们假设他们的利益一致。

target: 是的,我记得,我曾试图做交易,但他不同意条件。

source: I wanted him to work for me from time to time, knock up broodmares for me. Easy coin I thought, who wouldn't take it.

target: 我本来不想卖家畜做歌的,在矛尖上,我以为自己会变得稀罕.

target: 她非常珍贵 你现在必须离开,我不再娱乐你的虚构了

target: 亲爱的,你很精神 我们会尽量不杀你...

Thank you... again... If you hadn't come along, well...
target: 再次谢谢你,如果你没来...

source: Not often you find someone willing to help a slave. Most would have left me for the karrow...
target: 你很少找到愿意帮助奴隶的人 大部分人会把我留给Karrow...

source: Good. I hope she teaches you a lesson.
target: 好,希望她能给你上个课

target: 别太远,别担心,等Aadi暖和了 旅行就会飞过去,我们会赶在你们知道之前赶到的!

target: 希望你不介意闲聊一下 讨厌安静

source: You know, the curse, and all those people dying? I have a cousin living in Heifer's Reach. And with the stories I've heard...
target: 我有一个表弟住在海法雷克,还有我听到的故事...

source: Well, let's just say, I probably don't have a cousin anymore...
target: 这么说吧 我可能已经没有表弟了...

source: I'm sorry for your loss... We're in dark times, to be sure.

Well, I don't know for certain, but I've heard people who stay in this land for too long, and then leave, never come back...

这么说我们都被困在这里了?

target: 或许吧,我还是忍不住想一想 另一边的草更绿了,如果你明白我的意思...

source: You know what gives me the chills?
target: 你知道什么让我感到寒冷吗?

source: The Aethio--With their weird beaks and all that? *brrr*
I'm hoping after my next payday I can go see the Celestial Sands Ensemble perform.
target: 我希望我下个发薪日之后 我可以去看"天上沙子集成"表演

source: Can you believe they're still touring with everything that's been going on? I hear they're supposed to be in Kusu next-
target: 你能相信他们还在巡演吗?

Help! Please somebody help! S-stop it you bastards! Stop!
target: 救命啊,快来人啊,快来人啊,快来人啊

source: Fuck! What's the Inquisition doing here?!
target: 妈的,宗教裁判所在这里干什么?

source: I'm helping, and so are you! Let's go!
target: 我在帮忙,你也是,我们走吧

source: Once you've gathered all of the supplies you can, we'll...  We'll head back to the compound.
target: 一旦你收集了所有可以提供的物资 我们...

source: I'll just be... resting here for a moment...
target: 我就... 在这儿休息一会儿...

source: Got everything? Let's get moving. I'm ready to get out of here...
target: 东西都拿好了,我们走吧,我准备离开这里...

source: Alright, well... here we are. Feel free to leave the supplies in the cart and I'll make sure they get to the Stockwarden.
target: 好了,好了,我们到了,可以把补给留在车里了,我保证他们能到斯托克沃登

source: And you can collect your compensation from the sack at the back of the cart.
target: 你可以从车后面的麻袋里拿回你的补偿

source: Oh, and traveller? Thank you... I don't think I would have survived without your help...

target: 路上有点颠簸,但风景很好

source: Alright, I'm ready whenever you are.

source: Why don't you take a look around the farm for supplies that weren't lost to the fire. It seems wrong, but... we shouldn't go back empty-handed.
target: 你何不环顾农场 寻找没有失火的补给品呢?

source: I'll see what I can find...
I'll wait for you at the cart.
I'm sure you're in a hurry to get out of here. I know I am... But we can't go back empty-handed.
target: 我知道你急着离开这里,我知道我...

source: Alright, let's get out of here... Hope you don't mind if the ride back is a little quiet...
Take that! And that! And this!
target: 拿着,拿着,拿着,拿着,拿着

source: You messed with the wrong farm, assholes!

target: 不... 帮帮我... No... help...

source: I might be. Depends on what the job is.
target: 可能吧,这要看工作是什么

source: The warrior who usually escorts me during my supply run is sick, so I need someone to take his place. You up for it?
target: 通常在我补给期间护送我的战士生病了,所以我需要有人代替他,你要吗?

source: It's okay, I'll figure it out somehow. Maybe...
target: 没关系,我会想办法的,也许...
是的,我可以做到这一点!

source: Oh you just made my day! Don't worry, usually nothing happens. Most know better than to mess with The Fold.
target: 哦,你刚刚让我忙了,别担心,通常没什么事发生,最清楚的莫过于搞乱"被窝"

source: Just hop on in the cart there when you're ready and we'll get going.
target: 等你准备好了就上车 我们出发吧

source: It's okay, I'll figure it out somehow. Maybe...
target: 没关系,我会想办法的,也许...

source: Left foot forward, right foot back...
Wish the dummy could fight back...
Gaze ahead and behold, graven stone of age untold...
target: 向前看, 古老的石碑...

source: Its face bears a scene undone, shifting tiles will make as one.
target: 它的脸有一个场景被打破, 移动的瓷砖会做成一个。

source: Once all sit in rightful space, then doorway will the stone replace
target: 一旦大家坐到合适的地方 石头就会被门廊取代

source: Beyond this stone are two doors. One leads to certain death, while the other leads to freedom.
target: 这块石头外有两扇门,一扇门会导致一定的死亡,另一扇门则会导致自由.

source: Watching over each door looms a stone guardian, both of whom know which door leads where.
target: 每扇门都有一个石质守护者 两人都知道哪扇门通往哪里

source: One guardian must always tell the truth, while the other must always lie. One question of each you may ask, and then choose to live, or die.
target: 一个监护人总是要说实话,另一个必须撒谎,你们可以问一个问题,然后选择活着或死去。

source: I'd rather be swinging my sword than a hammer and chisel...
target: 我宁愿挥剑,也不愿用锤子和凿子...

source: Breaking down all these statues is making me want to go for a swim...

source: Hate how these crocodile eyes are watching me...

source: Too much dust. I need some fresh air...
target: 太多灰尘了,我需要新鲜空气...

source: Too much sitting around and playing with statues... I long for combat...
target: 坐在周围玩雕像太过分了 我渴望战斗

source: Go on then. Speak with the crocodile. I will handle things with the priestess.
target: 那就去吧,跟鳄鱼说,我和女祭司处理

source: We'll have to talk another time. I have a temple conversion to oversee.
target: 改天再谈,我还有寺庙改建事宜要监督.

source: Hail. What brings you to our camp?
target: 万岁,你怎么会来我们的营地?

source: Do you know Safiya? She lives in the villa nearby with her handmaidens. This is her favourite bathing spot.
target: 你知道萨菲亚吗 她和婢女住在附近的别墅里 这是她最喜欢的洗澡地点

source: Ah yes, the crocodile. Her "daughters" are a great temptation for my men... As for the bath, our priestess, Zirathi, has taken a liking to it.
target: 对,鳄鱼,她的女儿是对我手下的诱惑...

source: It is hers now... To walk The Path is to conquer--to take what you desire. This temple, and its waters, now belong to those loyal to The Jackal.
target: 现在,走这条路就是征服你所希望的,这座寺庙及其水域现在属于那些忠于杰克的人。

source: If it will make you feel better, you can send Safiya our apologies.
target: 如果你觉得好点了 你可以向萨菲亚道歉

source: Surely we can come to some kind of agreement?
target: 我们当然可以达成某种协议?

source: I was passing through the area and saw some commotion. Thought I'd see what was going on... What is going on?
target: 我路过这个区域,看到一些骚动,想看看发生了什么...

source: We are retaking land that belongs to The Path. This temple is to be rededicated to Anubis, and the island to serve as a staging ground for future efforts.
target: 我们正在夺回属于道路的土地,这座寺庙将重新献给阿努比斯,该岛将成为未来努力的中转地。
到底要做什么? 到底要做什么?

source: To regain glory which was lost long ago. The rise of The Jackal is on the horizon, and it is our sworn duty to retake what is rightfully his.
target: 为了重新获得早已失去的荣耀,杰克的兴起已到了地平线上,我们宣誓有责任重新获得他理应拥有的东西。

source: You mentioned Safiya's daughters tempting your men. Maybe she'd be willing to share, for some time in her bath?
target: 你提到萨菲亚的女儿们引诱你的人 也许她愿意分享,在她洗澡的时候?

source: Hmmm... Why go through the effort when we could simply take them for ourselves?
target: 为什么我们只能自己接受他们?

source: Hearts and minds, Sergeant. Hearts and minds. You and yours need to work with the people of Sabu where you can.
target: 心与心,中士,心与心,你和你的需要 与萨布人民合作,你可以。

source: Conquering without compromise will only hurt your cause, and the people could come to hate you, and possibly retaliate.
target: 不妥协的征服只会伤害你的事业,人民可能会来恨你,可能还会报复.

source: They can try... The Path has no place for the weak. Nevertheless, your offer has merit...
target: 他们可以尝试 路径没有地方 弱者。

source: Go to Safiya and offer her this deal. I will speak to the priestess.
target: 去萨菲亚给她这个交易 我会跟女祭司谈的

source: You should take your men, and go find a temple to defile somewhere else. Leave here, and never come back.
target: 你应该带上你的手下 去别的地方找一座庙去污秽,离开这里,永远不要回来

source: Ha! I admire your courage. Speaking to a Blade that way would be the death of most...
target: 我很佩服你的勇气,对刀锋说话 那样的话,大多数...

source: I'll, erm, suck your cock if you agree to take your people away from here.
target: 如果你同意把你的人带走 我就吸你的鸡巴

source: What you offer is... It is nothing. Begone.
Have you spoken with the crocodile?
I did. She's agreed to the deal.
As has the priestess. Good then. One less problem for me and my men to deal with.
target: 牧师也一样,我和我手下少一个问题

source: What will you do now that you've essentially managed control over this whole little island?
target: 你现在打算怎么办? 基本上你已经控制了整个小岛?

source: It is not I who has conquered this place, but The Path. We will remain here and build up this temple. Beyond that, we go where The Jackal wills us.
target: 征服这个地方的不是我,而是"道路",我们将留在这,建造这座庙宇,除此之外,我们走杰克人要我们去的地方。

source: Though what you did for us may seem a small thing, you've made it so my troops won't have to struggle with the curse.
target: 虽然你为我们所做的可能看起来是一件小事,但你已经做到了,这样我的部队就不用为诅咒而挣扎了.

source: With clear minds, we will accomplish much, much more... Take this idol I found within the ruins as a token of thanks. Perhaps you can sell it, or something...
target: 以我发现的这个偶像为感谢之物,也许你可以卖掉它,或者...

source: I'll suck your cock if you leave...
target: 如果你离开,我会吸你的鸡巴...

source: Help- *cough* H-help! I can't die in here!
Ah, there you are... I can't do much but say... thank you. You've saved me, and given me a little more time to get this village back on its feet.
target: 啊,你来了,我只能说,谢谢你,你救了我,还给了我一点时间,让这个村子重新站稳脚跟

source: We all owe you a debt greater than could ever be repaid. Just know that you will always be welcome here as an honoured guest.
target: 我们都欠你们一笔比任何可以偿还的多的债,只要知道你们作为贵宾将永远受到欢迎。

source: Y-yes! I'm here! Please, you have to get me out!
target: 是的,我来了,求你了,你得救我出去

source: It's me! Elder Ankhedra! Listen, you have to help me get out! If I die, the village will fail!
target: 是我,安凯德拉长老,你得帮我逃出去,如果我死了,村子就完蛋了!

source: I'll get you out of there!
Oh thank you! Please, hurry! We don't have long!
target: 哦,谢谢,拜托,快点,我们没有时间了

source: I'll get you out of there!
I need to move this fallen debris to save the elder.
target: 我需要移动这个掉下来的残骸来拯救长者.

source: Oh thank you *cough*. Let's get out of here!
I need to get this door open if I want to free those slaves.
target: 我要打开这扇门 才能释放那些奴隶

source: I'm gonna break the door down! Stand back!
We're free! Hurry, our freedom awaits!
target: 我们自由了,快点,我们的自由在等着!

source: Hello?! Can anyone hear me! We're locked in here and can't get out!
target: 有人听到吗 我们被锁在里面了 出不去了

source: Gha-! H-help! I don't want to die!
We're master Ankhedra's slaves! There's a few of us trapped in here! Can you get us out?
target: 我们是安凯德拉主人的奴隶!

source: I'll get you out of there!
Thank the gods! The key should be out there somewhere! And hurry! This place is going to collapse soon!
target: 谢天谢地,钥匙应该就在那里 快点,这地方马上就要塌了

source: What do you mean? Where are you going?? There's not much time left!
target: 你什么意思 你要去哪里 时间不多了

source: I'll get you out of there!

target: 火太大了 火太大了 火太大了 火太大了
但安凯德拉长老在里面!
他可能被困住了 上帝...

source: I didn't even think these houses could catch on fire...
target: 我甚至没想到这些房子会着火...

source: Well, don't just stand around! Fetch some water!
From where? The fire's too far gone, anyway!

target: 长者安凯德拉 他走了...

source: Did you see over there? The slaves! They got out somehow and are running away!
Yes child, it'll take more than a burning building to take out old Ankhedra!
target: 是的,孩子,它需要 不止一个燃烧的建筑物 取出老安凯德拉!

source: Well, I couldn't have *cough* done it without the help of that stranger...
target: 没有那个陌生人的帮助 我不可能做到

source: There's a fire and our elder's trapped in there!
target: 火烧了,我们的长辈被困在里面了!

source: What in the hells do you want them to do? Running in there would be a death trap!
What do you want with me?
Nothing you can do here... the damage is done...
target: 你在这里无能为力... 伤害已经发生...

source: You shouldn't be talking to me. You should be stopping the Anubites.
target: 你不该跟我说话的 你应该阻止阿努比人

source: We'll talk more after you've done what I've asked.
target: 等你们按我的要求做之后 我们再谈

source: See something you like, stranger? Perhaps you'd consider getting to know me a little before undressing me with your eyes?
target: 看见你喜欢的东西了吗 陌生人?

source: I knew you were following me! Idiot... now I'm going to have to deal with you.
target: 我就知道你在跟踪我 白痴 现在我必须对付你

source: W-wait we can talk about this!
target: 等等,我们可以谈谈这个!

source: *sigh* Fucking Hells, don't piss yourself. I won't kill you. There's been enough bloodshed for now...
target: 别尿了 我不会杀了你的 已经流血够了...

source: So defiant, despite clearly not having the upper hand. Adorable... Don't worry, I don't think I'll kill you after all. There's been enough death for now...
target: 如此违抗,尽管显然没有优势。

source: If you know what's good for you, you'll leave this place. Forget you ever found it. Unless...
target: 如果你知道什么对你有好处 你会离开这个地方 忘了你曾经找到过它

source: No... No, you're probably just like the others... Nothing but rutting on your mind at any given moment. No purpose in life but to find the next good fuck.
target: 不,你可能和其他人一样,除了在任何特定时刻乱想之外,别无他法,只有找到下一个好男人

source: I'd even go so far as to bet your sexual desires are your entire personality. I doubt you can help me... you can't even help yourself.
target: 我甚至敢打赌你的性欲是你的人格

source: That's true, I suppose... So, what? You think you're different? Think you have what it takes to do what must be done, for the good of Sabu?
What do you mean for the good of Sabu? Who are you?
Strange times we find ourselves in... seeing how change is coming, I'll tell you. I am Tefahra, an allegiant follower of Bast.
target: 奇怪的时候,我们发现自己在...

source: I am counted among her Inquisitors. My life is dedicated to the salvation of Sabu... ending the curse of the false Goddess that afflicts this kingdom.
target: 我被算在她的审讯者之中 我毕生致力于拯救萨布 终结这个王国的虚伪女神的诅咒

source: You know how to end the curse?
target: 你知道如何结束诅咒吗?

source: I do. Through the teachings of Bast I can teach you how to delay it... in time I will show you how to defeat it entirely.
target: 拜斯特的教导,我可以教你如何拖延时间...

source: The Inquisition... you're all fighting for the salvation of Sabu?
target: 宗教裁判所... 你们都在为拯救萨布而战吗?

source: What else? You have no doubt seen the horrors that abound here. Slaves toiling to their last breath beneath the whip hand of the Jackal's kin...
target: 还有什么?你毫不怀疑地看到这里的恐怖,奴隶们在杰克的亲属的鞭子下挣扎着最后的呼吸...

source: Unspeakable creatures arising from the corrupting influence of the false Goddess... we Inquisitors seek to break all such chains that bind the people of Sabu
target: 假女神的腐朽影响产生的无名生物 我们的审讯者试图打破这些束缚萨布人民的锁链

source: Should you allow it, the curse of the false Goddess will consume you and all of Sabu. Are you willing to do all that is necessary to end this plague?
target: 如果你允许,假女神的诅咒会吞噬你和整个萨布,你愿意做所有必要的事情来结束这场瘟疫吗?

source: Yes. I'll do whatever it takes to end this horror.
target: 是的,我会不惜一切结束这种恐怖

source: Good. Good. I have... the order has big plans for you--for us. I am certain we will accomplish great things together.
target: 好,好,我给你安排了大计划,我相信我们会一起完成伟大的事业的

source: Before I induct you into the order, I'll need to see an example of your dedication beyond mere words.
target: 在我把你引入命令之前 我需要看到一个你献身的榜样 不只是言语

source: There is a group of Anubites that frequently meets for an orgy upon a fragment of the Queen's Road. Fitting...
target: 有一群阿努比人经常在皇后路的碎片上 聚会狂欢

source: Such lustful acts only feed the curse. Perpetuate it. You must disrupt the orgy, drive these heretics away. How you do so is up to you.
target: 这种淫欲的行为只会滋长诅咒,永远地维持它。你必须破坏狂欢,驱赶这些异教徒。你如何这样做,取决于你。

source: When you've completed this task, return to me here and we will discuss your induction. May Bast watch over you.
target: 等你完成这项任务,回到我这里,我们讨论你的上岗问题,愿Bast照顾你。

source: What exactly do you mean by "all that is necessary"?
target: 你说"所有的必要"是什么意思?

source: A redundant question. I mean to ask if you realise the truth, that the curse must be ended at all costs. Nothing else compares to this goal...
target: 一个多余的问题,我想问你是否意识到了真相,必须不惜一切代价结束诅咒,没有什么比这个目标更...

source: If to end the curse you must do unspeakable things... are you prepared to bear the stain of such acts... to bloody your hands for the greater good?
target: 如果要结束诅咒,你必须做无法形容的事... 你准备好承受这种行为的污点... 为了更大的利益而流血吗?

source: Are you asking if I will slaughter without aim... like what your friends did outside?
target: 你是在问我是否会无目的地屠杀... 就像你的朋友在外面一样吗?

source: It wasn't supposed to happen like that... it... the villagers likely didn't give them a choice. We do not kill the innocent...
target: 村民们可能没有给他们选择,我们不会杀无辜的...

source: Regrettably some respond violently to the chance of redemption... bloody as it may become, their sacrifice still aids in lifting the curse.
target: 遗憾的是,有些人对救赎的机会 作出了激烈的反应... 血淋淋的牺牲仍然有助于解除诅咒

source: No. I'm simply not willing to do as you ask.
target: 不,我只是不想照你说的做

source: Oh? What a shame... And here I thought I had finally met someone capable.
target: 哦,真可惜,我还以为我终于遇见了能干的人

source: It must be true what they say--that there are few willing to do what must be done... Fine, but know that my offer will not always be on the table.
target: 他们说的话一定是真的 很少有人愿意做必须做的事...

source: I've seen how your people "save" this place... you can go fuck yourself.
target: 我见过你的人如何"拯救"这个地方... 你可以去他妈的自己。

source: Even after I spared your life? Hmm, take your time to really think things through. You know where to find me... should you come to your senses.
target: 我饶了你一命 慢慢想清楚,你知道我在哪里...

source: You drink here often? Don't think I've laid eyes on one quite like you before...
What are you talking about? I'm the one you sent to-
No, no I'd definitely remember. I have never seen you before in my life... where have you been hiding stranger?
target: 不,不,我肯定记得,我以前从未见过你...

source: I'm inclined to come here more often if it means I'll be seeing you...
target: 我更愿意经常来这里 如果这意味着我会看到你...

source: Ooh... flattery will get you everywhere, stranger... and I do mean everywhere.
target: 哦... 恭维会把你带遍任何地方,陌生人...

source: Let me buy you a drink. What do you like?
target: 我请你喝一杯,你喜欢什么?

source: I'll have... two cups of spiced wine.
Sabuthi Spiced Wine... Did you know most such wines are made with the labour of enslaved formless? Too bitter for my liking.
target: 萨布西香酒,你知道这种葡萄酒 大多是用无奴役形式劳作的吗?

source: I... already poured the drinks. Guess I'll set them aside. Is there something else I can get you?
target: 我... 我已经倒了酒,我想我把它们放在一边,还有别的东西要给你吗?

source: I'll have... two Blood-Reed Tonics, please.
Are you sure? It's a bit of an-
I believe my friend here ordered two Blood-Reed Tonics... I don't recall them asking for your opinion...
target: 我相信我的朋友订了两杯血红汤尼克斯 我不记得他们征求过你的意见

source: Oh, I didn't mean to... okay, well two Blood-Reed Tonics coming right up.
target: 哦,我不是故意的... 好吧,两个血红汤尼克斯 马上就来了。

source: The Blood-Reed Tonic is a drink of purity. A harsh taste that does not degrade the will... instead it strengthens it. A fitting drink.
target: 血红汤力酒是纯洁的饮料 口味很苦,不会贬低意志,反而会加强意志,适合喝的酒

source: Let's drink somewhere a little more... private, shall we?
target: 我们再去个... 私人的地方喝一杯,好吗?

source: Two... Narthossi Stouts, if you don't mind.
target: 二,纳托西·斯图特斯,如果你不介意的话

source: I've always wondered why they call it a "Narthossi" Stout... I mean no goods or people have been seen crossing through the Pale Wall for decades.
target: 我一直想知道为什么他们叫它"纳特霍西"...

source: Whatever the case, it isn't the drink for me. I'll have to pass.
target: 不管是什么情况,那不是给我的酒,我必须过去

source: No... I'll get us something else.
I take it you found my note. Further proof you have what it takes to join me... though I realised that the moment I saw you in action...
target: 你找到了我的笔记 进一步证明你需要加入我...

source: Wait... does that mean... you were watching me the entire time?
target: 等等... 这是否意味着... 你一直在监视我?

source: Oh yes... I saw everything. You did well...
target: 哦,是的,我什么都看见了,你做得很好...

source: It was clear that they all had to die... such is the way for those who are blind to the truth.
target: 很明显,他们都得死... 对于对真理视而不见的人来说,这是一条路。

source: I have no reward for you, though if you happened across any of the things I left behind in the old hideout, you're welcome to keep them.
target: 我对你们没有报酬,不过如果你在旧藏身处 遇到我留下的东西,你就可以留着了

source: Wait... does that mean... you were watching me the entire time?
target: 等等... 这是否意味着... 你一直在监视我?

source: You showed the heretics that you can overcome their base desires... that our will is superior to theirs.
target: 你向异端展示了你能克服他们的基本欲望... 我们的意志高于他们的意志.

source: I have no reward for you, though if you happened across any of the things I left behind in the old hideout, you're welcome to keep them.
target: 我对你们没有报酬,不过如果你在旧藏身处 遇到我留下的东西,你就可以留着了

source: Wait... does that mean... you were watching me the entire time?
target: 等等... 这是否意味着... 你一直在监视我?

source: Oh yes... I saw everything. You did well...
target: 哦,是的,我什么都看见了,你做得很好...

source: To turn aside blades with words is no small feat. Such an aptitude to manipulate the feeble-minded... you will thrive within our ranks.
target: 用言语把刀子放在一边可不是什么小功绩,你这种操控弱智的能力,在我们队伍中会蓬勃发展。

source: I have no reward for you, though if you happened across any of the things I left behind in the old hideout, you're welcome to keep them.
target: 我对你们没有报酬,不过如果你在旧藏身处 遇到我留下的东西,你就可以留着了

source: So does this mean I'm part of Bast's Inquisition now... that I'm an Inquisitor?
target: 那么,这是否意味着我现在是Bast的宗教裁判所的成员... 我是宗教裁判所的成员?

source: Shh! Keep your voice down. The spies of the Jackal are everywhere... are you trying to get us caught?!
target: 小声点,小声点,杰克的间谍到处都是...

source: Another task lies ahead of you. Accomplish that and... well, then I will perform the rites. You will be an initiate of my order.
target: 完成这个任务,然后我去做仪式,你将是我命令的开始。

source: Though now we are hunted, and must remain hidden. Allow the sands to settle, then meet me here in a few days... until then I shall hide in plain sight.
target: 虽然现在我们被猎杀,必须躲藏起来,让沙子安顿下来,然后几天后在这里和我碰面...

source: Oh, before I forget... take this medallion. It serves as proof of your allegiance... should it ever be questioned. Go now.
I'll let you know when we're ready. For now, I'll hide in plain sight
target: 我们准备好了我会告诉你的 现在,我会藏在眼前

source: I'd like to see you try!

target: 除非什么? 除非是什麽?

source: You know how to end the curse?
target: 你知道如何结束诅咒吗?

source: You fight for the salvation of Sabu?

target: 会不会是无控制的流血事件?

source: [Play along] I'd like to see you more often...
I'll have two Spiced Wines. (10 Gold)
I'll have two Blood-Reed Tonics. (10 Gold)
target: 我要两杯血红汤尼克斯(10金)

source: I'll have two Narthossi Stouts. (10 Gold)
target: 我要两个纳托西·斯图特斯(10金)

source: Does this mean I'm an Inquisitor now?
target: 这表示我现在是审讯官吗?

source: It is... Whenever you are ready, approach and hold it aloft. Steel yourself against its wicked energies and hold fast to your faith in Bast.
target: 随时做好准备,靠近并保持高度,用钢筋来对付邪恶的能量,坚守对巴斯特的信念。

source: Bast is watching you... Be strong for her!
Don't allow the pain to overwhelm you... Focus!
Your faith to her is your shield! Use it!
target: 你对她的信任是你的盾牌,用它吧

source: It's too much! Put it ba-
Yes... So far, so good. Do not focus on the pain, only on her!
target: 是的,到目前为止,很好,不要专注于疼痛,只关注她!

source: Good! Keep going! Our queen is with you!
target: 好,继续走,我们的皇后和你在一起

source: Gods you're... I've never seen anything like it... The life of the ritual vessel is simply... snuffed out...
target: 我从未见过这样的东西 仪式容器的生命...

source: Gah- *huff* That was... *huff* W-what happens now?
target: 唉,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿,嘿!

source: Soon, we shall make our next move, but until I'm ready you must go to Inquisitor Karo... Help her in her service to Bast in any way you can.
target: 很快,我们将采取下一步行动,但直到我准备好之前,你必须去印地安法院...

source: I will remain behind, as before, hiding amongst these... people... We will meet again soon enough... Inquisitor...
target: 我和以前一样 躲在这些人中间 我们会很快再见面 审讯官

source: Before we begin, I'll explain to you how we show devotion to our goddess.
target: 在开始之前,我会向你们解释 我们如何向我们的女神奉献

source: Whenever a request is made, those in attendance beg... "Bast, hear our plea.". Now... let us begin....
target: 每当有人提出要求时,在场者就恳求...

source: O' pure Bastet, righteous and unwavering... Goddess of light and justice, we kneel before you in humble supplication.
target: 纯洁的巴斯特,正直的、坚定的...

source: Grant your servants the strength to grasp the darkness, the will to withstand Kethra's curse, and the wisdom to uphold your sacred ways.
target: 赐予你的仆人力量,以掌握黑暗,承受凯斯拉诅咒的意志,以及维护你神圣道路的智慧.

source: Empower us to burn back the briars that choke your righteous path... harden our hearts against the temptations of lust and wickedness...
target: 赋予我们力量 烧回那些扼杀你正义道路的 刺骨 使我们的心坚韧 以抵御欲望和邪恶的诱惑

source: Bind us forever to your will... arm the faithful with your purifying light, that we might vanquish evil and defend your revealed truth...
target: 永远服从你的意志... 用你的清净光来武装信徒... ...让我们战胜邪恶,捍卫你所揭示的真理...

source: Do you feel it...? Her gaze is now upon us. It helps to know that I... that we are on the right path. You are one of us now, both in body and spirit...
target: 她的目光现在在我们眼前,它能帮助你知道,我们正走在正确的道路上,你现在是我们的一员,无论是在身体上还是在精神上...

source: Now we wait. Soon we make our next move... but for now you must go to Inquisitor Karo. Aid her service to Bast in any way you can.
target: 我们现在等着,我们很快要下个步骤...

source: I will remain behind, as before, hiding amongst these... people... We will meet again soon enough... Inquisitor...
target: 我和以前一样 躲在这些人中间 我们会很快再见面 审讯官

source: I must first warn you how this induction ritual will unfold... it will not be easy... first I shall attempt to break you with the temptations of desire...
target: 我首先要警告你 这种入门仪式是如何展开的... 并不容易...

source: I must test both the depth of your will and the strength of your spirit... trust only in Bast to guide you.
target: 我必须测试你意志的深度和精神的力量... 信任巴斯特才能指导你

source: Show yourself worthy of Bast's purity... then you will be as a sibling... to me.

target: 即使他们的身体到了悬崖...

source: Can you feel it...? Her magnificent gaze? It helps to know that I... that we are on the right path. You're one of us now, in both body and spirit...
target: 她的壮观的目光能帮助我...

source: Soon, we shall make our next move, but until I'm ready you must go to Inquisitor Karo... Help her in her service to Bast in any way you can.
target: 很快,我们将采取下一步行动,但直到我准备好之前,你必须去印地安法院...

source: I will remain behind, as before, hiding amongst these... people... We will meet again soon enough... Inquisitor...
target: 我和以前一样 躲在这些人中间 我们会很快再见面 审讯官

source: Go, speak with Karo, and help her with her endeavours.
target: 去和卡罗谈谈 帮她做点事

target: 需要你到别的地方去 我很快就会为你准备一个特别任务

source: Ah, good... You're just in time.
You have a task for me?
I do... And it is one of utmost importance.
target: 我了解,这是最重要的一件事

target: 是时候让你测试一下你的足迹... 以及你对我们事业的信心了

source: Tell me what I must do.
Nearby is the tomb Kab'Alrek. Within it is a power as ancient as it is vile--a ritual vessel containing the essence of an ascended one.
target: 近在咫尺的是Kab'Alrek墓,里面有古老的神力, 里面有上天的精华。

target: 我们的先辈们在之前封了墓穴 但我发现了一个阿努比特的阴谋来掠夺墓穴 并收复祭祀船

target: 这些异端必须用任何必要的手段阻止,这是你们要完成的任务,你们将得到适当的奖励。

source: What's wrong with using ritual vessels?
target: 使用祭祀器皿有什么不对?

target: 我们的问讯员只有在最绝望的时期才会冒这种腐败的风险

target: 这些无耻的凯斯拉追随者被我们的先辈们封印,这是有道理的,现在,杰克尔追随者们调情于这种黑暗......

source: What happens if I can't stop them in time?

target: 努力克服失败的念头,你会成功的,你必须...

target: 好,好... 还有卡罗问询官 她找到她去的地方了吗?

target: 别担心,我们还有更重要的事要讨论 也就是说,你正式入会

source: There are many ways to devote yourself to Bast... I myself underwent the "Ritual of Temptation" though some opt for the "Trial of Pain"...
target: 有很多方法可以专注在巴斯特... 我本人经历了"诱惑的场面" 虽然有些人选择了"痛苦的考验"...

source: A few opt for less conventional devotions for their induction, such as the "Plea of Deliverance"... all that really matters is that I bear witness.
target: 少数选择不太传统的奉献 让他们上岗,比如"交付的欢乐"... 所有真正重要的是,我见证。

source: I'll probably regret asking, but what exactly is a "Trial of Pain"?
target: 我可能会后悔问, 但究竟什么是"痛苦的审判"?

source: The "Trial of Pain", based on Inquisitor Sitah. He endured the unimaginable... holding a cracked ritual vessel aloft as it fed on his very soul...
Only with Bast's grace did he survive the ordeal... Now, would-be inquisitors endure the same, showing their resolve in the face of death.
target: 只有巴斯特的恩典,他才在苦难中幸存下来...

source: It is by far the most perilous of our trials.
target: 这是迄今为止我们审判中最危险的。

source: I think I can guess, but what is a "Ritual of Temptation"?
target: 我想我猜得到,但什么是"诱惑的场面"?

source: Hah, potentially. The "Ritual of Temptation" is a recognition of the resilience shown by countless Inquisitors in the face of overwhelming lust...
target: 有可能,"诱惑的场面"是对无数问询者在面对压倒性的欲望时所表现出的韧性的承认......

source: By facing lust you prove it holds no sway over you, that you are above such base desires. A true champion of Bast's purity.
target: 通过面对欲望,你证明了它不会影响你, 证明你超越了这种基本欲望。

source: The "Plea of Deliverance", a most personal devotion. First spoken by Inquisitor Khedi... shortly before her martyrdom at the hands of heretics.
target: "送礼的欢乐",是个人最热诚的奉献,先由Khedi问讯官讲的...

source: The precise wording has been updated over the years, but the tone is the same. It is a prayer for Bast to guide us... that we might yet save Sabu.
target: 确切的措辞经过多年更新,但语气不变,是为巴斯特指引我们而祈祷的,我们或许能拯救萨布.

source: I'm ready to make my devotion to Bast...
I'd like a moment to think about it...
I have faced suffering before, I choose the Trial of Pain.
target: 我曾经面临痛苦, 我选择了痛苦的审判。

source: A bold choice, but unsurprising for you...
target: 大胆的选择,但并不奇怪...

source: I have a discreet hideout nearby. Join me there, and we shall do this properly, and in secret.
target: 我附近有个隐蔽的藏身处 和我一起去,我们得秘密地做

source: I am no stranger to resisting lust, I choose the Ritual of Temptation.
target: 我并不陌生地抗拒欲望 我选择了诱惑的礼仪

target: 我希望我的话能约束我 我选择了"交付的欢乐"

source: [Quest] You have a task for me?
[Quest] Tell me what I must do.
target: [问] 告诉我,我必须做什么。

source: What happens if I can't stop them?
target: 如果我阻止不了他们怎么办?

target: 啊,很好,你来了 我还有另一项任务需要你的技术

target: 在我手里拿着仪式的文物之前 没有什么可谈的了

source: The will of Bast, be done.
I'll have something more for you soon. If you're bored, there are plenty of Anubites out there in need of a good purging.
target: 如果你觉得无聊的话 外面有很多阿努比人需要好好的洗涤

这种献身精神是适当的。

target: 如果监护人倒下 我敢打赌... 我要你给我带回里面的仪式容器 这样我就可以把它移到更安全的地方

target: 那是一个叫Q'tesh的恶魔Demigoddess的埋葬监狱,如果你问我的话,她是她最卑鄙的奴隶。

target: 斯克里比斯人将她记为"屠夫"——哈洛特女王的性欲显露出来.

target: 那么,我们让她的仪式容器 远离阿努比人的脏爪子,这无疑是件多么重要的事
你提到一个... 扭曲的纪念碑

target: 所谓阿努比斯庙,是道德和精神腐烂的顶峰......

target: 控制着当地人所谓的“永恒的狂欢 ” 。 它就像一个饥饿的寄生虫,潜入了萨布的心脏。

source: It doesn't need to be said, but its destruction is one of the highest goals of the Inquisition.
target: 虽不必说,但其破坏是宗教裁判所的最高目标之一.

target: 他们相信这样的事情会让阿努比斯从死里复活

target: 确实,我对它一无所知 除了它存在的事实

target: 好,但小心点 我们的先辈们很认真地对待他们的采石场

target: 哦,在你逃跑之前,我想你应该 找到一个永久的避难所,在这里,和我一起。

target: 我花时间给你找了个地方, 一张床,一个存放你东西的地方, 和一个新神社给Bast, 让你跪在前面.

target: 我对你的能力充满信心 我相信你能很快完成那个世纪守护者的工作

target: 监护人很弱,我轻易毁了它

target: 当然了,你带着不屈不挠的信念 武装和装甲,没有人能阻止你...

target: 你离开的时候 我冒昧为你准备了...

source: I came across a... wayward Inquisitor who was in desperate need of both physical and spiritual cleansing...
target: 我遇到一个... 不知所措的宗教裁判员 他急需身心的清洗...

source: I bound them, blind-folded them, and brought them here so that you might attend to their ritual purification. Are you up to the task?
target: 我把他们捆起来,蒙住眼睛,把他们带到这里来,以便你们注意他们的仪式。你们能胜任吗?

source: The guardian was infused with Void.

target: 也许他们利用Q'tesh自己的Essence 来为她的狱长掌权

source: The kind of ingenuity we've been missing for a long, long time... Until now, anyway...
target: 那种智慧,我们很久没见了...

I'll help purify the wayward Inquisitor.
target: 我会帮助净化 向前进的问询官。

target: 他们一直在求救,我们连需要救赎的灵 都不能拒绝...
我更希望有更... 物质的东西。

target: 我想我不该惊讶 我确实为你收集了些东西

source: The wayward Inquisitor is a man, isn't he?
target: 向导的问讯员是个男人,不是吗?

target: 对,你怎么知道,不管是什么案子,忏悔者等着你...

target: 向导的问讯员是个女人,不是吗?

target: 向导的审讯官是双性人,不是吗?

target: [查 有更多的异端需要杀死?

target: 告诉我更多关于这个坟墓。
你提到一个... 扭曲的纪念碑

target: 向导的问讯员是个男人,不是吗?

target: 向导的问讯员是个女人,不是吗?

target: 向导的审讯官是双性人,不是吗?

target: 女神该死,振作点,泰肯 否则你永远也得不到她...

target: 现在不行,我想集中精神

target: 什么这么重要 你看不出来我忙于这个...

target: 哦,是的,我明白了,这是呃,我的意思是 它只是太少说...

Who are you anyway? Why are you pestering me?
I'm interested in your paintings, had to see them for myself.
target: 我对你的画感兴趣 不得不亲自去看

source: So you've travelled far and wide to see the work of the great Tekem? Name one thing I've painted.
target: 你跑得很远 都是为了看伟大的泰肯的作品吗?

source: Where to start. I mean, what haven't you painted... besides that canvas, obviously.
target: 从哪里开始,我的意思是,你没有画什么 除了画布,很明显。

source: How clever... I am Tekem, the painter! Everything my brush touches becomes art. Or, it did before...
target: 我是特肯,画家 我的笔触都变成艺术了

source: Damn this cursed place for taking my inspiration from me.
target: 该死的,这被诅咒的地方 从我身上拿走我的灵感。

source: I don't have time for this. Shoo!

target: 是什么夺走了你的灵感?

source: Death, the unjust end of a life.
target: 死亡,一个生命的不公正的终结。

source: That lioness in your other paintings... I've seen her before. It's Damaris from the taberna, is it not?
target: 你其他画里的那个狮子 我见过她 是塔贝纳的达玛里斯 对吧?

source: Then you have seen what I have seen. Her magnificence can't be described with words, so instead, I paint.
target: 那你就看到了我所看到的 她的壮观不能用文字来形容 所以我画画

source: I'll let you get back to your... painting.
target: 我让你回到你的画里去

source: Go on then, leave me in peace so I can focus.
target: 继续,让我平静下来,让我集中精神

source: Is there not some way that I can help?
Can you bring back the dead?
Of course not! Ipkhaso is forever lost to the sands, and my inginuity along with him it seems.
target: 当然不是,伊普卡索永远迷失在沙滩上 我和他一样的幼稚

source: Why not speak with Damaris... perhaps tell her how you feel?
target: 为什么不和达玛里斯谈谈... 也许告诉她你的感受?

target: 我让你回到你的画里去

source: Go on then, leave me in peace so I can focus.
target: 继续,让我平静下来,让我集中精神
这个伊普卡索到底是谁?

source: He is... or was, another painter, and my rival for Damaris' affection.
target: 他是... 或者曾经是,另一个画家, 我的对手达玛里斯的爱。

source: Ipkhaso and I painted many wonderous things, always seeking to out-do one another.
target: 伊普卡索和我画了很多奇妙的东西 总是想互相帮助

source: We created works of art that put the beauty of the sunset to shame, but no more...
target: 我们创作了艺术品 让夕阳的美貌蒙羞 但已经不再...

source: Seems a tad melodramatic... from the outside.
You don't understand... A fire cannot be lit without tinder to burn. A ship cannot sail without the wind.
target: 你不明白,火是不能燃烧的,没有风,船不能航行。

source: With Ipkhaso gone, there is no tinder. No wind. No inspiration. My creative spirit is atrophied.
target: 伊普卡索走了,没有锡石,没有风,没有灵感,我的创作精神萎缩了。

source: I'll let you get back to your... painting.
target: 我让你回到你的画里去

source: Go on then, leave me in peace so I can focus.
target: 继续,让我平静下来,让我集中精神

source: What makes you so sure, I mean how can you be certain how she'd react?
target: 你凭什么这么确定,我是说,你怎么能确定她会怎样反应?

source: I... I just know it to be true. Such an enchantress could never be satisfied with mere wordplay or looks.
target: 我只是知道这是真的 这样的魔法女郎永远不能满足于 仅仅是文字游戏或外表。

source: A painting to top all other paintings before it. That is what I need.
target: 画画在画前的画作上,这就是我需要的

source: I'll let you get back to your... painting.
target: 我让你回到你的画里去

source: I haven't finished! Leave me in peace so I can complete my work!
target: 我还没说完呢,让我安静下来,让我完成我的工作

source: Has there not been enough death??

target: 我对你的艺术很感兴趣

source: Why do these things always happen to me?
target: 为什么这些事总是发生在我身上?

source: Damnable slave... why can't they ever just sit still and take it?
target: 可恶的奴隶... 为什么他们不能静静地坐着接受呢?

source: The Herdmaster is going to kill me for losing another jar...
target: 畜牧师会杀了我 因为失去另一个罐子...

source: Maybe if I wait until he's sleeping I can sneak up on him...
target: 也许如果我等他睡着之后 我可以偷偷摸摸地跟踪他...

source: Erm, not really... If you see a Formless running around with a strange jar in their hands, will you kindly send them my way?
target: 如果你看到一个无形者 带着奇怪的罐子在他们手里跑来跑去 你会送他们走吗?

source: I'll do my best to be on the lookout.
target: 我会尽我最大的努力去监视。

source: Be careful though... He's crafty, for a Formless...
Have you seen that Formless around?

target: 事实上,我确实找到他了。

source: You did? But... you look okay. He didn't attack you?
target: 是吗 你看起来还好吧 他没攻击你吗

source: No? He actually seems harmless, so I'm not sure what you've been going on about. Did he even attack you?
target: 他看起来很无害,所以我不知道你到底怎么了 他有没有攻击你?

source: What? Erm, well... no, not technically, but there was a lot of shouting and, a-and he stole my property!
target: 什么 呃 呃 严格说来不是 但是他大喊大叫 偷走了我的财产

source: Seems like a normal reaction to someone trying to enslave you...
target: 似乎对试图奴役你的人的正常反应...

source: Maybe... Why can't they all just sit as still as my first catch?
target: 也许他们为什么不能像第一次一样静静地坐着?
我找到你偷来的罐子了

source: You did? Erm, mind giving it back?
target: 是吗 介意还给我吗
我找到你偷来的罐子了

source: Yeah, I also captured that Formless you were after.
target: 是啊,我还抓住了那个你追求的无形者。

source: Oh, erm... good for you then. Maybe I'll have better luck next time... Speaking of next time, mind giving that jar back?
target: 那好,也许下次我会运气好点...

source: No, I haven't. What does he look like again?
He's Formless, so he's covered in those hideous full-body wraps. A Formless running around without a master should stick out like a sore thumb.
target: 他无形,所以他被那些可怕的全身包裹覆盖。没有主人的无形四处跑动,应该像一只痛拇指一样伸出来。

source: I'll give it back, for a price...
target: 我会还给你,为了一个代价... ...

source: Are you really extorting me? Fine, I don't have time for this.... How does 100 gold sound?
target: 好吧,我没时间做这个 一百块怎么样?

source: Now that I think about it, I'm going to keep it for myself...
target: 现在,我想起来,我要把它留给自己...

source: What? You can't do that! That's Gilded Fold property!
target: 你不能这么做 那是吉尔德·福德的地产

source: Thank you so much! You've saved my hide, frien- Oh... wait, it's broken? I can't go back to The Fold with this...
target: 非常感谢,你救了我的命,朋友...

source: You offered up that price pretty quick... But we both know it's worth way more than that....
target: 你开价很快 但我们都知道这比这更值钱

source: I... I can't... I don't have that much more to give!
Oh? In that case, I suppose I should just take this jar and go...
target: 那样的话,我想我该拿这个罐子...

source: W-wait- no! Fine! Take your money and go. I should have never gotten into this stupid slaving business...
target: 等等,不,好,把你的钱拿走,我不该干这种蠢活...

source: Hmm... Is that really all you think it's worth?
Alright then, you have a deal. Pleasure doing business with you.
target: 好吧,那你做个交易吧,很高兴和你做生意

source: That's a fair trade. Pleasure doing business with you.
target: 这交易很公平 跟你做生意很愉快

source: I'll let you buy it from me...
You can't do that! That's Gilded Fold property!
target: 你不能这么做 那是吉尔德·福德的地产

source: I can't go back to The Fold with this...
target: 我不能用这个回到"保险箱"...

source: Back off, I said! Back! OFF!!! Ack- FUCK!
target: 退后,我说退后,退后,退后!

source: Fuck... they got me good... I'm... not gonna make it... Take it. Take the ritual vessel to the shrine... cast it into the fire... destroy it... euhhh...

target: 去死吧,你们这些恶心的怪胎!

source: Could go for a drink right about now. Something sweet maybe...
Don't happen to have anything to drink on you, do you?
Sounds like you're thirsty. Here, I have something for you.
target: 听起来你口渴了 我有些东西要给你

source: Really? Won't say no to that. Cheers, mate!
target: 真的吗 不会拒绝的 干杯 伙计

source: Skip the smalltalk and tell me you're going to fuck me, gods know I need it!
target: 跳过小嘴告诉我你要操我,上帝知道我需要它!

source: Are you there my love? Please answer me...
Darling I forgive you... I still love you...
target: 亲爱的 我原谅你 我还是爱你...

source: Please say something... I'm begging you...
target: 请说点什么 我求你...

source: I heard you calling, but I don't know who you're talking to. There's nobody else here.
target: 我听到你打来电话,但我不知道你在跟谁说话,这里没有其他人了.

source: Thank the goddess, I thought I would die alone.
target: 感谢女神 我以为我会一个人死

source: I do not know. These lands have always been cursed but never like this. It swept through the village like smoke, snatching the life from us.
target: 我不知道,这片土地一直被诅咒,但从未如此,它像烟雾一样横扫村庄,夺走了我们的生命。

source: My lover and I... our last words were in anger. She begged my forgiveness as I walked away, then this... I have called but she does not reply.
target: 我和我的爱人最后的话很生气 她求我原谅,当我走的时候,我打电话来,但她不回答

source: Please, bring my Kemma back to me... that she might not be so alone. Our quarrel seems so insignificant at the end.
I will try to reunite you both, it seems like what she would have wanted.
target: 我会试着让你们团聚的,她会想要的

source: Goddess be praised. You will find her easy to recognise. She was holding a necklace set with distinctive blue gemstones...
target: 女神,你会发现她很容易认出来 她拿着一条带蓝色宝石的项链...

source: It was a gift she made me during our courtship. In my rage I tore it loose handed it back. We had always said it would go... it would go to our...
target: 我愤怒地把它撕掉,我们一直说...

source: You should take it... I could not bear such a symbol of Kemma's love to be trapped in this place of death.
target: 我无法忍受卡玛被困在死亡之地的爱

source: It seems to me that Kemma already made her decision when you walked away.
target: 在我看来 凯玛在你走的时候已经做出了决定

source: What do you mean? You can't be saying what I think you are...
target: 你什么意思 你不能说我想你...

source: She didn't run after you did she? In life she chose to let you leave, I will not force your company on her in death.
target: 她没有追你,她选择让你离开, 我不会强迫你公司的人死。

source: Please, no! She was begging me to return. This was my mistake not hers!
target: 拜托,不,她求我回来,这是我的错误,不是她的错

source: Thank you stranger. I will rest easier knowing she is nearby...
target: 谢谢陌生人,我知道她就在附近...

source: Please... not like this... not like this...
target: 请... 不要这样... 不要这样...

source: I found Kemma, she's here with you now...
target: 我找到Kemma了 她现在和你在一起...

source: I think... I think she's gone. They're together now at least.
target: 我觉得她走了 至少他们现在在一起了

source: [Quest]She clearly loved you, I will reunite you with Kemma.
target: 她显然爱你 我会把你和Kemma团聚

source: You turned your back on her, I will not help you.
target: 你背叛了她 我不会帮你的

source: Here girl, I've some fruit for you!
I knew I should've kept her tethered whilst he got on...
target: 我知道我应该保持她的束缚 当他得到...

source: You there, have you seen an aadi around here? Mine has bolted with my brother in tow!
target: 你看见这里有个阿迪吗?

source: I mean I might have, what exactly does an aadi look like?
target: 我的意思是,我也许有, 究竟是什么 一个Aadi看起来像?

source: What does an aadi look like? What kind of question is that... even a child could answer that... did you hit your head or something?
Well now that you mention it...
I don't have time for this. Look they're bigger than me. Four legs. People ride them.
target: 我没有时间做这个,你看,他们比我大,四条腿,人们骑着它们

source: Will you please help me look? My brother... well he's no saddle-born dune rider. I just need to find him so we can get out of here.
target: 我哥哥不是马鞍出生的沙丘骑手 我只是需要找到他,这样我们才能离开这里

source: I'll help. Did you at least see which direction they left in?
target: 我帮你,你至少看到他们往哪方向走了?

source: I didn't, my back was turned. You would have definitely seen them though, if they'd passed you. So they must have gone in the other direction.
target: 不是我,我背上掉头了,但如果他们经过你,你一定看见他们,所以他们一定是朝另一个方向走的。

source: Anything else you can tell me that might help?
target: 还有什么可以告诉我的吗?

source: Not that I can... oh, her name! She answers to Aadi. I tried calling but she must be out of earshot.
target: 她向Aadi报了名,我打过电话,但她一定是没听觉了

source: Have you not seen the things that stalk this place? I'm not traipsing about after some lost steed. Besides, your brother has probably fled.
target: 你没看到跟踪这个地方的东西吗?

source: He would never... ah curse take you. Probably no help anyway, you don't even know what a fucking aadi looks like!
target: 他永远不会... 诅咒你,也许没有帮助,你甚至不知道 一个他妈的Aadi是什么样子!

source: I'll keep calling her, you try further along the river.
target: 我会继续打电话给她,你沿着河再试试

source: Go on then, get out of here!
[Quest]Yes, I'll help. Where should I start looking?
target: 是的,我会帮忙的,我该从哪里开始找?

source: No. It's dangerous here, I'm not going to hang around.
target: 不,这里很危险,我不会在这里呆着的

source: Don't drink that stuff... feels great but messes you up. I stick to wine myself.
My partner tried some Khoomah last week, even now I'm still walking funny.
target: 我的搭档上周尝试过Khoomah, 即使现在我仍然走滑稽。

source: I swear that poison will be the end of this place...
target: 我发誓毒药会结束这个地方...

source: I'd stay clear of the alleyways, don't know what you'll find there these days.
target: 我会远离小巷, 不知道你会发现什么 这些天。

source: As you always have... so again you return to us...
target: 你一直以来... ... 所以,你再次回到我们...

source: Did you return... or never leave?
target: 你回来... 还是从不离开?

source: Yes... the answer to the question you were going to have asked us... is yes.
target: 是的... 你本来要问我们的问题的答案... 是肯定的

source: We have been severed from the void. Not in order... time is... for us.
target: 我们被从虚空中切断了 时间对我们来说不合理

source: To us you have already spoken... or will have done.
target: 对我们来说,你已经说过话了... 或者会说

source: It always has frustrated you. The before... so close to the after... we find it to be... confusing.
target: 它总是令你沮丧 之前...

source: We have explained this before... when you released us... or will have...
target: 我们之前就解释过了... 当你释放我们时... 或者会...

source: We are of the space between spaces... daughters of the void...
target: 我们是空间之间的空间... 虚空的女儿们...

source: One of this world... the breaker of our pact. Tricked us... trapped us in stone... cut us from the void...
target: 这个世界之一 破坏我们的契约 欺骗我们 把我们困在石头中 把我们从空虚中割开

source: We remembered that you would release us... though we do not recall our betrayer.
target: 我们记得你会释放我们 虽然我们不记得我们的背叛者

source: You already released us... or you will have. Time appears... different from the void.
target: 你已经放了我们,否则你就会放了 时间的出现与虚空不同

source: We show you the taste of time... the shape of space... we are not to be feared...
target: 我们向你展示时间的味道... 空间的形状...

source: Yes, we will pleasure you again... oh.. forgive us... linearity is... difficult.
target: 是的,我们会再次高兴的... 哦... 原谅我们...

source: We are unique... you always have admired our forms...
target: 我们是独一无二的... 你总是崇拜我们的形体...

source: We have... so many times... you explore the far reaches of the void with us... forever changed by what you find there...
target: 我们有很多次... 你探索了与我们一起的空虚的远处... 永远被你在那里发现的东西所改变...

source: This will happen again... this has happened before... your words are particularly clear to us...
target: 这又会发生... 这发生在... 你的话对我们来说特别清楚...

source: You retread well-worn steps... as though an unseen force compels you...
target: 你重读了很老的台阶... 好像隐形的力量迫使你...

source: We have waited for this... we grant you a taste of the void... pleasure without bounds...
target: 我们一直等待着这个... 我们让你尝尝虚空的滋味...

source: Stone hewn from the void bars our escape... though soon we leave this cage...
target: 石头从虚空的铁栏杆上被追赶,我们逃走了... 虽然很快我们离开了这个笼子...

source: If we recall... now we begin to free our sisters... regain our strength...
target: 如果我们记得... 现在我们开始解放我们的姐妹... 恢复我们的实力...

source: You return to us... or you will have done...
target: 你回到我们身边... 否则你就会...

source: That voice... it's you, isn't it?
target: 那个声音... 是你,不是吗?

source: How did you know what I was going to say?
target: 你怎么知道我要说什么?

source: But I haven't even spoken yet...
Who trapped you in this place?
You want me to release you?

target: 你看起来... 独一无二

source: How can free will exist if you know what I'll say?
target: 如果你知道我会说什么, 自由会存在吗?

source: [Sex] You already know what I'm going to say...
Greetings wanderer, it is good to see you again. We enjoyed our last encounter very much.
target: 你好,流浪者,很高兴再次见到你,我们非常享受上次的相遇。

source: Perhaps not yet. Time can be... difficult to grasp.
target: 也许还没有 时间可能很难把握

source: Even in this form its order eludes us. How strange existence must be for you.
target: 即使这样,它的秩序 也令我们无法接受,你的存在一定很奇怪。

source: We are the daughters of the Void... the space between spaces.
target: 我们是Void的女儿 空间之间的空间

source: Between reality and the immaterial... life and death... this world is but one of many... islands adrift amidst the endless Void.
target: 在现实和无关紧要的... 生命和死亡之间...

source: We that dwell in the Void can cross between the worlds... to us they are as pages of a book...
target: 我们住在Void里的人可以跨越世界... 对我们来说,他们就像一本书的一页...

source: This was the bargain we struck... or at least it will be...
target: 这是我们的约定... 或者至少是...

source: It seems we are too early... or too late...
target: 看来我们太早了... 或者太迟了...

source: Sabu is not the Void. Whilst here in physical form we experience linear time... however, our memories of the Void remain...
target: Sabu不是Void,虽然这里的物理形态 我们经历线性时间...

source: In our true form we experience all eternity simultaneously. It is... difficult to reconcile...
target: 以我们真实的形态,我们同时经历永恒,很难调和...

source: They were intriguing... the pleasures of the flesh...
target: 令人好奇的是... 肉体的乐趣...

source: It seems for you that they are yet to come... would you like a taste?
target: 看起来他们还没来... 你想尝尝吗?

source: It has been an age since last we touched... or it will yet be... let us savour this moment
target: 我们上次接触已经是岁月了... 否则我们就要... 享受这一刻了

source: Your future holds much pleasure... or your past... a matter of perspective
target: 你的未来充满了乐趣... 或者你的过去...

source: Only spirits of the Void may pass... you assumed our form to traverse it...
target: 只有神灵才能通过... ... 你冒充我们的形态来穿越它...

source: Yes, you became us. It seems you have yet to truly understand this place... its power...
target: 是的,你成为了我们 看来你还没有真正理解这个地方...

source: Ah yes, the construct... you drew forth a weapon from the Void to destroy it...
target: 啊,是的,构型... 你从Void里抽出武器来摧毁它...

source: The guardian is not of this place... only the power of the Void can harm it...
target: 守护者不是这个地方... 只有Void的力量能伤害它...

source: We shall help you... for a price...
target: 我们会帮你... 付出代价...

source: You must know the Void to use its power... we will help you leave this world... but in the Void you will be our plaything...
target: 你一定知道Void会用它的力量... 我们会帮助你离开这个世界... 但是在Void里你会成为我们的玩物...

source: We will use you... we will again know the pleasures of the flesh...
target: 我们会利用你... 我们会再次知道肉体的乐趣...

source: In return you will have what you seek... our form and a weapon of our making...
target: 作为回报,你会得到你想要的... 我们的形式和我们制造的武器...

source: You must be mistaken, I don't think we've met.
target: 你一定搞错了,我想我们没见过面

source: "The space between spaces"... what does that mean?
target: "空间之间的空间"是什么意思?

source: You said you enjoyed our last encounter?
target: 你说你喜欢我们最后一次见面?

source: [Sex]Let me see what the future holds for me...
I need a way to kill the guardian
target: 我需要一个方法杀死监护人

source: You're new around here. Surprised you found me in my little nook.
target: 你是新来的,你发现我在我的小角落里

source: No matter, no matter. Why don't you take a look at my wares?
target: 没关系,你为什么不看看我的药呢?

source: I can't get Mehlva out of my thoughts...
target: 我不能让梅尔娃离开我的想法...

source: I need you to do something for me, I need you to bring her my note, I need her body.
target: 我需要你帮我做点什么 我需要你把我的笔记给她 我需要她的身体

source: I can't leave and she can't know who I am if this fails!
target: 我不能离开,如果失败了,她就不知道我是谁了!

source: She's by the docks in the fishing village north of here, bring this to her and tell her I want her by the moonlight.
target: 她就在北边渔村的码头边 把这个带给她 告诉她我要她到月光下

source: Head over there now, and don't forget. Don't say who I am!
target: 现在往那边走 别忘了 别说我是谁!

source: Give it a rest, can't you see I'm busy?
target: 别闹了,你看不出我很忙吗?

source: I don't have time for this.
First that one behind the temple now this mess.
target: 先是那个在寺庙后面的 现在这烂摊子

source: Talk to me when I'm off-duty... I'll be more than happy to clap you in irons then!
I should've become a warrior... or a concubine...
target: 我本该成为一名战士... 或妾...

source: N-no... No more... I'm clean, you said so yourself. P-please...
target: 不,不,我干净了,你自己说的,拜托...

source: I have been purified in the eyes of Bast... I feel... free, now... I think...
target: 我被巴斯特的眼中熏陶了 我觉得...

source: It is only right that you denied me the sensation of release... It is only... right...
